title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个系统性的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）幻觉评估框架，包含细粒度基准UniHall和自适应的多模态模糊测试方法SAMF，揭示先进MLLM在动态测试下性能显著下降，并发现帮助性-幻觉之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉评估多基于静态基准，存在分类覆盖狭窄和性能饱和的问题，无法反映模型在真实动态场景中的鲁棒性。需要更全面的评估框架来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 1) 提出UniHall，一个基于统一分类体系（涵盖对象、指令、知识三个维度）的细粒度数据集；2) 提出SAMF（自适应用多模态模糊测试），采用进化突变策略探索模型幻觉边界；3) SAMF集成结构化度量套件，由多模态预言机集合驱动，确保动态输入评估的可靠性。
AI.result: 实验表明，先进MLLM在模糊测试下相比常规设置出现显著的性能退化，暴露了推理能力与事实基础之间的脱节；同时发现帮助性-幻觉权衡，即强化学习对齐在指令跟随任务中无意中加剧了谄媚行为。
AI.conclusion: 该框架、代码和基准已开源（https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall），为动态评估MLLM幻觉提供了系统化工具，揭示了现有模型在事实基础方面的薄弱环节及对齐策略带来的潜在副作用。

title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
summary: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.

AI.tldr: DocAtlas是一个将长文档理解建模为可变状态信息检索过程的系统，通过外部可变文档环境（harness）控制搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾等工具，在固定上下文预算下结合自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆。在MMLongBench-Doc上，GPT-5.4达到71.4%（超人类专家基准65.8%），而经端到端强化学习训练的Qwen3.5-4B达到63.7%（对比54.4%的基线）。
AI.motivation: 长文档理解需要跨多页、布局、表格、图表检索和整合证据。现有检索增强系统依赖静态索引在生成前选择证据，而智能体系统虽引入多轮工具调用但多依赖提示词驱动的冻结专有模型，缺乏对信息获取过程的主动控制和状态管理，导致证据选择不灵活、上下文效率低下。
AI.method: DocAtlas将长文档理解视为可变状态的信息寻求过程，实例化为一个"可变文档环境"（mutable document harness）：一种外部环境，决定每一步搜索、阅读、存储、回顾和展示哪些文档信息。该环境暴露搜索、阅读、笔记和回顾工具，维护分层树和笔记存储，并随智能体记录证据而更新。DocAtlas结合了自改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆，在固定上下文预算下运行。该环境既支持与大VLMs的推理时使用，也支持紧凑VLM智能体的端到端强化学习训练。
AI.result: 在MMLongBench-Doc基准上：使用GPT-5.4，DocAtlas达到71.4%准确率，超越人类专家参考值65.8%；使用经DocAtlas环境端到端RL训练的Qwen3.5-4B VLM达到63.7%，显著高于54.4%的直接输入基线，证明可变文档环境设计能大幅提升紧凑文档智能体的性能。
AI.conclusion: DocAtlas验证了将文档理解建模为可变状态过程的范式有效性：外部可变文档环境能从架构层面智能体化信息获取流程，而非依赖提示词控制模型行为。其同时提升了大模型推理性能和小模型训练上限，为长文档理解系统设计提供了新方向。

title: WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WuYuEval，一个面向固体废物管理（SWM）领域的大语言模型多层级评估基准，包含4,590道封闭式基础题（覆盖6种任务类型和8个领域类别）和247道基于场景的开放式专家题。在33个LLM上的评估显示，顶尖模型基础模块准确率达94.64%，但平均准确率从简单题的84.14%降至困难题的42.50%，推理型Thinking模式并非对所有模型都有正向提升，唯有锚定于单位、假设和工程约束的深思熟虑才有效。WuYuEval为SWM领域基础模型的开发提供了评估资源和实证依据。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准偏重通用知识，难以评估其在工程、环境和政策约束下进行专业SWM决策的能力，缺乏专门针对该领域的多层级评测体系。
AI.method: 构建WuYuEval两级基准：Foundation Module包含4,590道封闭式多选题（6种任务类型×8个领域类别），Expert Module包含247道开放式场景题（涉及多目标优化、约束权衡与系统设计）；对专家题采用锚定校准的LLM-as-a-Judge评分结合Elo成对比较，并在33个LLM上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 顶尖模型在基础模块达到94.64%准确率，但平均准确率从简单题84.14%下降到困难题42.50%；性能低下集中在计算、实验设计、城市规划和开放式专家任务；Thinking模式对多数模型配对有提升但并非普遍正收益，效果取决于基线能力。
AI.conclusion: 可见的推理只有在锚定于单位、假设和工程约束时才有助于决策，否则可能偏离决定性答案边界；WuYuEval既提供了评估资源，也为开发具有专业推理链和显式约束控制的SWM领域基础模型提供了实证基础。

title: Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards
summary: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

AI.tldr: Search-G1 是一个基于表示的内部奖励框架，通过两个干预校准的读数（prompt-state 读数和 answer-commit 读数）衡量智能体回答的操作性接地（operational grounding），在无需过程标注或 LLM 裁判的情况下改善搜索增强语言智能体的检索必要性判断与证据依赖度评估，从而优化接地-搜索成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的搜索增强语言智能体奖励机制存在两难：外部奖励要么只提供稀疏的结果监督，无法区分有依据的检索与冗余搜索；要么依赖过程标注或 LLM 裁判，训练成本高昂。内部奖励（如熵、似然、信息增益）虽然廉价且可分级，但主要反映模型置信度而非证据接地情况。因此需要一个既能衡量证据接地、又无需昂贵标注或推理的奖励信号。
AI.method: Search-G1 提出两个干预校准的读数：（1）prompt-state 读数预测闭卷充分性（closed-book sufficiency），其补集定义策略相对的检索必要性；（2）answer-commit 读数通过答案阶段对证据删除的敏感性估计证据依赖度。奖励在检索被判定为必要且答案对证据敏感时，对正确搜索轨迹给予额外奖励；当闭卷知识充分时偏爱正确的直接回答；并惩罚重复搜索。由于 RL 会改变策略表示，Search-G1 定期在最新检查点的轨迹上重新拟合两个读数，使奖励与策略共同演化。评分过程不需要过程标注或 LLM 裁判推理。
AI.result: 在多个基于搜索的问答基准和两种模型规模上的实验表明，Search-G1 改善了接地-搜索成本的权衡，在保持竞争力的任务准确率的同时产生了更短的响应侧轨迹。
AI.conclusion: Search-G1 证明可以通过表示层面的干预校准读数来构建廉价且可分级的内部奖励，有效区分必要检索与冗余搜索，在不依赖昂贵外部信号的情况下实现更好的接地与搜索成本平衡，且奖励可与策略共同演化。

title: Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI
summary: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张将（计算）论辩（argumentation）作为评估型AI（Evaluative AI）的形式化与可计算基础，以实现可解释、可争辩的分布式人本智能决策系统。
AI.motivation: 评估型AI（EAI）作为一种新兴的AI辅助决策范式，不提供单一推荐，而是呈现竞争性假设及其正反证据。然而，EAI缺乏一个形式化的计算基础来实现可解释性和可争辩性，需要寻找合适的范式来支撑这一目标。
AI.method: 本文采用立场论文（position paper）的方法，论证计算论辩（computational argumentation）是EAI的恰当形式化基础，并提出一个面向分布式和人本EAI系统的长期研究议程。
AI.result: 论文从概念和形式上论证了计算论辩范式与EAI的核心需求（呈现竞争假设、提供正反证据、支持解释与争辩）高度契合，为EAI提供了严谨的计算基础。
AI.conclusion: 计算论辩为可解释、可争辩的EAI提供了合适的形式化地基，并奠定了面向分布式和人本EAI系统的长期研究方向。

title: PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings
summary: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

AI.tldr: 本文提出PragyaDoc，一个通用文档智能框架，通过四层流水线（并行集成OCR、几何-词汇融合、确定性领域结构化、双LLM医学推理与本地化）将英文医学文档转化为印度22种官方语言，解决乡村患者、ASHA工作者及病人家属无法理解英文医疗信息的关键访问障碍。
AI.motivation: 印度22种官方语言造成严重的医疗信息可访问性障碍——大多数医学文献仅以英文存在，而最需要这些信息的群体（乡村人口、ASHA工作者、患者家属）却在功能上被排除在理解之外。
AI.method: 提出一个四层流水线的通用文档智能框架PragyaDoc：1）并行集成OCR提取层；2）几何-词汇融合层；3）确定性领域结构化层；4）双LLM医学推理与本地化层。
AI.result: 论文尚未给出具体实验结果，核心贡献在于提出该框架的架构设计与方法论。
AI.conclusion: PragyaDoc通过分层流水线方案，旨在弥合印度多语言环境下医学文档的语言鸿沟，使医疗信息能够触达最需要它的群体。

title: Differentiate the Solver, Not the Equation: Reverse-Sweep Adjoints for Block Implicit Simulation
summary: Differentiable simulation is a key component in learning, control, and inverse problems, where gradients through nonlinear implicit solvers are required. Existing approaches either rely on unrolled automatic differentiation, whose memory grows with solver depth, or on equation-level implicit differentiation, which assembles global Jacobians and solves large sparse adjoint systems, discarding the locality of the forward solver -- and differentiating the converged equation rather than the finite computation that actually ran. We propose solver-level differentiation, which differentiates the executed solver itself. When a solver is composed of block implicit updates, its discrete adjoint is obtained by applying the corresponding adjoint updates in reverse order, yielding a reverse-sweep formulation whose backward pass mirrors the forward solver. From an operator perspective, the forward pass realizes an approximate inverse through ordered local solves, and the backward applies its transpose through reverse local adjoint solves, constructing no global system. We instantiate this idea on Vertex Block Descent, yielding a differentiable solver whose reverse colored Gauss-Seidel sweeps are composed entirely of local $3\times 3$ adjoint solves. The backward matches automatic differentiation through the identical executed forward to machine precision at every solver depth, where the equation-level adjoint is off by 37% after one sweep; in a controlled same-codebase, same-GPU comparison it is 33x faster and uses 71x less memory than unrolled automatic differentiation; and the same construction is exact on projective dynamics and extended position-based dynamics. We scale differentiable elastodynamics to $10^6$ contact-coupled soft bodies (8M vertices) on one GPU. Overall, this work highlights solver structure as a practical organizing principle for efficient differentiable simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出求解器级微分（solver-level differentiation）方法，直接对实际执行的求解器进行微分，而非对收敛方程或展开计算图求导。以Vertex Block Descent为例，其反向传播通过逆序执行局部3×3伴随求解，无需求解全局大规模稀疏伴随系统，相比展开自动微分快33倍、省71倍内存，可扩展到单GPU上100万接触耦合软体的可微弹性动力学仿真。
AI.motivation: 可微仿真在学习、控制与逆问题中至关重要，但现有方法存在根本缺陷：展开自动微分的内存随求解器深度线性增长；方程级隐式微分需要组装全局Jacobian并求解大规模稀疏伴随系统，丢弃了前向求解器的局部性，且微分的是收敛后的方程而非实际执行的有限计算。
AI.method: 提出求解器级微分：当求解器由块隐式更新组成时，其离散伴随可通过逆序应用相应的伴随更新获得，形成与前向求解器镜像的反向扫描。从算子角度看，前向实现通过有序局部求解近似求逆，反向通过局部伴随求解的转置实现，无需构建全局系统。将该思想实例化在Vertex Block Descent上，反向计算完全由局部3×3伴随求解组成的反向彩色Gauss-Seidel扫描构成。
AI.result: 该方法在任意求解器深度下与相同前向计算的自动微分精确匹配到机器精度；方程级伴随在单次扫描后误差达37%；在同一代码库同一GPU下比展开自动微分快33倍、内存减少71倍；该方法同样精确适用于投影动力学和扩展位置动力学；可扩展到单GPU上100万接触耦合软体（800万顶点）的可微弹性动力学。
AI.conclusion: 研究工作证明了求解器结构可作为高效可微仿真的实用组织原则，为大规模可微物理仿真提供了新范式，解决了现有方法在内存、计算效率和准确性上的固有权衡。

title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
summary:
Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.
  We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"可解释性是能力的税负"这一传统观念，提出将可解释性作为训练管线的约束条件而非事后逆向工程。作者在三个数量级的计算规模上验证了可解释性与能力同步扩展的结论，并实例化出Steerling-8B模型——一个带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型，支持对生成token进行输入归因、概念归因和数据归因，并实现无需重训的概念引导闭环干预。Steerling-8B在与训练计算量多2-16倍的开源模型对比中保持竞争力，表明可解释性可以内置于训练并随规模提升。
AI.motivation: 当前可解释性方法通常事后进行，其可靠性难以验证。作者质疑这一前提，主张应当将可解释性作为训练目标的一部分进行优化，而非对已训练好的黑箱模型进行逆向分析。
AI.method: 将可解释性作为训练管线中的约束条件，与语言建模目标联合优化。在自回归和扩散两类语言模型上，跨越三个数量级的计算规模进行验证。具体实例为Steerling-8B，采用带因果注意力掩码的扩散语言模型架构，为生成token提供输入token、人类可理解概念和训练数据的归因能力。
AI.result: 可解释性随模型规模扩展而非与能力对立；模型表征变得更解耦且与人类可理解概念对齐。Steerling-8B在计算量少2-16倍的情况下与开源同类模型保持竞争力，且支持闭环干预：通过概念/特征归因诊断输出、检索相似训练数据并通过概念引导修正行为，无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性可以作为一种设计原则融入训练流程而非事后补救，且其质量随规模提升，这提出了一种新的缩放范式。

title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains
summary: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，解决AI输出速度与人类认知能力不匹配导致的监督失效问题。核心洞察是真正的约束不是输出速度V本身，而是V×L（每项认知负荷），且AI能力提升不会减少认知负荷而是重构其结构。Flow-by-Flow通过基于形式化可计数特征的认知成本评分和不依赖内容评估的制度容量上限来控制监督负荷，并推导出四个设计不变量。模拟分析显示该范式在90.8%的试验中优于传统监督强化。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明，在高损失场景下，当AI输出速度V超过人类认知能力C_max时，人机回环监督在结构上不可持续。但真正的约束是V×L（每项认知负荷），而非V单独。理解L的构成（分诊、判断、响应）及其对AI能力改进的非对称响应，是设计可行治理机制的前提。
AI.method: 将认知负荷L分解为分诊成本、判断成本和响应成本，分析三者对AI能力改善的非对称响应。提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，包含两个控制机制：基于可计数形式特征的非线性认知成本评分，以及将处理量维持在C_max内的制度容量上限。推导出内容判断绕行超限路径的四个设计不变量，并通过参考实现和1,000次参数抽取的蒙特卡洛分析验证。
AI.result: 研究表明分诊成本不随模型能力增强而下降（因为语义不确定性是通用设计的固有属性），响应成本对准确性改进不敏感，只有判断成本面临下行压力且往往通过遗漏而非真正减少来实现。蒙特卡洛分析显示，复合多指标流程控制（Flow-by-Flow）在90.8%的试验中优于仅监督强化方案。四个设计不变量被证明可以联合满足。
AI.conclusion: 传统的以"评估AI输出是否正确"为基础的治理机制存在根本缺陷：委派给AI则继承幻觉风险，委派给人类则受V×L上限约束。Flow-by-Flow通过完全绕开内容评估来控制监督负荷，为高损失领域的AI治理提供了新的范式方向，其实践困难也被明确承认。

title: NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages
summary: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

AI.tldr: NeuroPilot是一个多智能体系统，将神经影像处理的三大阶段（数据标准化、模态特定预处理、质量控制）数字化为三个可调用的LLM技能（dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill、qc-agent-skill），实现自动化工作流编排。系统已在17个队列（>123,000名受试者，涵盖婴幼儿到老年人、多种MRI模态）中部署验证，将传统2-3个月的处理训练时间压缩至一周。
AI.motivation: 原始神经影像归档转换为分析就绪数据依赖三个脆弱环节（数据标准化、模态特定预处理、QC），现有工具虽各自成熟，但编排需要项目特定脚本、环境适应性调参和大量人工QC，缺乏端到端的自动化协调方案。
AI.method: 构建多智能体系统NeuroPilot：1) 将数据转换、预处理、QC专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用技能；2) LLM驱动智能体自动编排工作流，将异构基础设施统一为单一配置；3) QC智能体采用基于证据的半自动QC，通过3D浏览器仪表盘和分层验证系统处理失败案例并升级复杂问题供主管检查。
AI.result: 系统在17个队列（>12.3万受试者，覆盖婴幼儿至老龄、多种MRI模态）中验证泛化性。QC智能体筛查了558个生产受试者，自动标记与FreeSurfer拓扑缺陷指标一致；婴幼儿处理流水线在QC验证输入上实现100%（201/201）完成率；处理时间从2-3个月压缩至一周。
AI.conclusion: NeuroPilot证明LLM驱动的多智能体系统能够有效协调神经影像处理全流程，以单一配置实现跨队列、跨模态的规模化扩展，显著提升处理效率与自动化水平，并已部署于公开平台。

title: Adaptive Volumetric Parameterization of Simply Connected 3-Manifolds with Applications
summary: Volumetric parameterization, the process of mapping a 3-manifold onto a simplified volumetric domain, is important for many tasks in computer graphics and imaging science. However, most prior volumetric parameterization approaches have only utilized standardized domains such as a solid ball regardless of the overall shape of the given 3-manifolds, which introduces significant geometric distortion and affects the subsequent shape processing and analysis tasks. To overcome this issue, in this work we propose a novel volumetric parameterization framework for simply connected 3-manifolds. Specifically, the proposed framework jointly controls local shape and mass distortions, while adapting the target domain during the optimization process. It enables three progressively more flexible target-domain settings for the parameterization: a prescribed solid ellipsoid, a volume-normalized adaptive ellipsoid with variable radii, and a sea-embedded free-boundary domain. For each setting, the parameterization algorithm consists of a 3D quasi-conformality shape update, a diffusion-based density-equalizing update, and a geometric correction procedure for removing element foldings, thereby allowing for volumetric parameterizations with different desired effects. Experimental results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework. Moreover, our framework can be easily applied to multiresolution and localized adaptive volumetric remeshing, volumetric registration, and volumetric morphing. Altogether, our work provides a new way for the representation, processing, and analysis of 3-manifolds.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对单连通三维流形的体积参数化新框架，通过联合控制局部形状与质量畸变，并自适应优化目标域（固定椭球、自适应椭球、自由边界域三种设置），显著降低了几何畸变，可应用于多分辨率自适应体积重网格化、配准和形变等任务。
AI.motivation: 已有体积参数化方法大多局限于标准化域（如实心球），不考虑输入三维流形的整体形状，导致显著几何畸变，影响后续形状处理与分析任务。因此需要一种能适应目标域形状的体积参数化框架以降低畸变。
AI.method: 提出一种针对单连通三维流形的体积参数化框架，联合控制局部形状和质量畸变，并在优化过程中自适应调整目标域。框架支持三种递进式目标域设置：预设实心椭球、变半径的体积归一化自适应椭球、以及海面嵌入的自由边界域。每种设置下算法包含三步：三维拟共形形状更新、基于扩散的密度均衡更新、以及去除单元折叠的几何修正步骤。
AI.result: 实验结果表明所提出的框架有效性，能生成具有不同期望效果的体积参数化，并已成功应用于多分辨率与局部自适应体积重网格化、体积配准和体积形变等任务。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为三维流形的表示、处理与分析提供了一种新途径，通过自适应目标域与多畸变联合控制显著改善了体积参数化的质量。

title: Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation
summary: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多语言嵌入初始化的方法，用于在不支持的语言（Limbum，喀麦隆草场班图语）上进行多语言神经机器翻译模型（NLLB-200）的微调。通过将多个类型学相关语言token的嵌入取平均值作为新语言token的初始化，在Limbum到英语的翻译任务上取得了与最佳单语言代理token相当的性能（chrF2++=46.7 vs 47.3），远超从零训练的Transformer基线（14.5）和零样本（12.5），证明了多语言迁移对于极低资源班图语翻译的决定性作用。
AI.motivation: NLLB-200等多语言神经机器翻译模型虽覆盖200种语言，但仍有数千种语言（包括喀麦隆大部分草场班图语）不受支持。当为这些未见语言微调模型时，实践者必须选择代理语言token，但目前缺乏选择代理语言的原则性方法，这成为低资源语言翻译的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种语言token嵌入初始化策略：将模型中多个类型学相关语言的嵌入取平均值，作为新语言token的初始嵌入。在8,837对句子的平行语料（源自新约文本和双语词典）上对NLLB-200进行微调，实现Limbum到英语的翻译，并与零样本、从零训练的Transformer以及使用斯瓦希里语作为代理token的NLLB-200微调基线进行对比。
AI.result: 多语言平均嵌入初始化达到chrF2++=46.7，与最佳单语言代理token（Swahili，chrF2++=47.3）性能相当；两种NLLB-200变体均比从零训练基线高出32个chrF2++点（14.5）；所有系统均未能保留声调变音符号。数据集和代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 多语言迁移是极低资源班图语翻译性能的主导因素，多语言嵌入初始化可以消除对启发式代理token选择的依赖，同时达到与最佳代理类似的性能。然而，声调信息的丢失仍然是所有系统面临的开放性挑战，亟需进一步研究。

title: Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility
comment: Formal framework paper on canonicalization and determinization in structure theories; version v2.16.4; 29 pages
summary:
We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于从复数结构理论构建规范解释，区分了三层规范化程度（闭包稳定、全局完成、确定化），并将非确定性分类为认知多样性（E型）和结构多样性（S型），提出了两种规范化机制（算子基完成和选择器基构造），并证明了相关充分条件与分类定理，还将其应用于LLM辅助推理中的幻觉现象。
AI.motivation: 结构理论中的解释建构缺乏统一的形式化框架，非确定性的来源和规范化的条件尚未被系统刻画。本文旨在建立一个普适的数学框架，以区分不同类型的非确定性，并给出在各种条件下能否达成规范化（乃至唯一确定解释）的判定依据，同时为LLM推理中的幻觉现象提供理论视角。
AI.method: 本文通过三元组T=(Σ,A,I)形式化结构理论，定义了可容许解释族。在此基础上区分三层规范化：闭包稳定（逐种子收敛）、全局完成（与种子无关的收敛）和确定化（唯一可容许解释）。分类了E型（认知非确定性）与S型（结构非确定性）非确定性，并进一步细分S-strong子类。提出两种规范化机制：算子基完成（基于推理算子的迭代闭包）与选择器基构造（基于选择函数的规范选择），并给出了两种机制存在的充分结构条件。利用阶段算子展示多层规范化的非交换性，并证明了将理论内在机制归约为闭包或选择的条件分类定理。
AI.result: 证明了纯推理基完成在正性、非撤回规则及额外可靠性条件下可归约为饱和闭包算子；E型理论可建立闭包稳定性，而完全确定化依赖于一个仍待解决的全局合流性质；S-strong理论可通过规范选择实现确定化；多层规范化构成结构上非交换的分阶段算子系统。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个统一的规范解释形式化框架，指出不同类型非确定性需要不同的规范化策略：E型依赖闭包收敛，S-strong型依赖规范选择。框架同时揭示了LLM幻觉可被理解为不支持的规范化操作，为理解和治理AI推理中的幻觉现象提供了理论工具。

title: Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps
summary: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用PRIME数据集（包括白光和窄带成像图像）评估了5种多模态大语言模型（Claude Opus 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o、GPT-5）在结直肠息肉分类和组织学预测中的诊断准确性，结果显示所有模型在区分肿瘤性vs非肿瘤性息肉时F1>0.9，其中Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro表现最佳，但敏感性和特异性未达到ESGE标准。
AI.motivation: 结肠息肉的准确光学诊断是指导切除策略和监测方案的关键，而多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的诊断中展现出潜力。本研究旨在客观评估不同MLLMs在结直肠息肉分类和组织学预测中的诊断准确性，以判断其是否达到临床部署标准。
AI.method: 这是一项回顾性诊断性能研究。使用PRIME数据集（包含132例白光和窄带成像NBI图像），评估了Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o和GPT-5五种模型。针对Paris分类、窄带成像结直肠内镜（NICE）分类和预测组织学，计算了F1分数、正确百分比和准确率，并与专家应答进行比较。使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验确定各MLLM预测值之间的差异。
AI.result: 所有MLLMs在区分肿瘤性vs非肿瘤性息肉时F1分数均>0.9。Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分侵袭性vs非侵袭性息肉和低级别vs高级别腺瘤方面F1分数最高（分别为0.560和0.492）。Claude Opus 4和GPT-5使用Paris分类时正确百分比显著高于其他模型（均为41.7%）。
AI.conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面准确率最高，最接近专家共识。然而，模型整体的敏感性和特异性未达到欧洲消化内镜学会（ESGE）标准，提示在临床部署前需要进行前瞻性多中心试验以及设计人机协同（human-in-the-loop）工作流程。

title: Smooth Motion Stitching via Laplacian Optimization in Rodrigues Vector Space
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Presented at NICOGRAPH International 2026
summary: This paper presents a motion editing framework for smooth motion stitching based on Laplacian optimization in Rodrigues vector space. By representing joint rotations as continuous Rodrigues vectors, motion stitching is formulated as a temporal Laplacian optimization problem, enabling smooth transitions between motion segments while preserving characteristic temporal variations of reference motions. The proposed approach supports both intra-category replacement and cross-category motion stitching without relying on learning-based models or complex manual tuning, and is computationally efficient for interactive editing. Through a series of stitching experiments and comparisons with linear interpolation, we demonstrate that Laplacian editing produces stable and visually coherent transitions under a wide range of motion differences. Furthermore, an analysis of rotational continuity clarifies that rotation-axis inversions are rare in real motion data and explains why numerical instabilities observed in synthetic axis-flipping scenarios do not arise in practical motion stitching. These results highlight the importance of rotational representation in stabilizing temporal optimization and suggest that the proposed framework is well suited not only for animation authoring but also for motion analysis and future extensions incorporating perceptual or physiological cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Rodrigues向量空间中拉普拉斯优化的运动拼接框架，通过将关节旋转表示为连续Rodrigues向量并将运动拼接形式化为时间拉普拉斯优化问题，实现运动片段间的平滑过渡，同时保留参考运动的特征性时间变化。该方法支持类别内替换和跨类别拼接，无需学习模型或复杂手动调参，计算高效适合交互式编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有的运动拼接方法依赖于学习模型或复杂的人工调参，缺乏计算效率和普适性；同时运动拼接中的平滑过渡需要稳定的旋转表示，而旋转奇异性问题（如轴翻转）可能导致数值不稳定，需要深入分析旋转连续性对时域优化的影响。
AI.method: 将关节旋转表示为连续Rodrigues向量，将运动拼接建模为时间拉普拉斯优化问题，通过拉普拉斯编辑实现运动片段间的平滑过渡并保留参考运动的时序变化特征。
AI.result: 通过系列拼接实验与线性插值的对比，拉普拉斯编辑在多种运动差异下均能产生稳定、视觉连贯的过渡。旋转连续性分析表明真实运动数据中轴翻转现象罕见，解释了合成轴翻转场景下的数值不稳定在实际拼接中不会出现。
AI.conclusion: 旋转表示的选择对稳定时域优化至关重要，所提出的框架不仅适用于动画创作，还可扩展到运动分析及融合感知或生理线索的未来研究方向。

title: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address this gap, we propose SurveyReview, a reviewer-aligned, multi-dimensional benchmark and dataset for survey evaluation. We collect and annotate 675 survey papers with 1,630 review reports. We structure authentic peer-review reports by converting free-form comments into four-dimensional scores (Readability, Criticalness, Comprehensiveness, Structure) paired with supporting rationales. We further release standardized train/test splits and an evaluation protocol to measure alignment between automatic evaluators and human reviewers. To validate the benchmark, we develop SurveyAlign, a strong baseline evaluator by fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with LoRA on our annotated data, augmented with external knowledge for knowledge-intensive dimensions. On the test set, SurveyAlign substantially improves reviewer alignment over prompt-based judging with GPT-5.2, reducing average MSE from 2.28 to 1.38 and MAE from 1.15 to 0.69 across all four dimensions. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we establish the first multi-dimensional, reviewer-aligned dataset with a reproducible evaluation framework for survey reviewing; (2) we develop a strong baseline evaluator that substantially improves alignment with human reviewers, providing a competitive reference for future research. Our code and data are available at https://surveyreview.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurveyReview，一个与审稿人对齐的多维度综述论文评审基准数据集，包含675篇综述论文和1,630份评审报告，并开发了SurveyAlign评估器（基于Qwen3-32B微调）以显著提升自动评估器与人类审稿人的对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型自动生成综述论文的规模化发展，可靠评估成为瓶颈。现有的LLM-as-a-judge评估方法缺乏与人类审稿人的系统性对齐，且缺少量化评估器与人类审稿人对齐度的系统框架。
AI.method: 论文提出SurveyReview基准：收集并标注675篇综述论文的1,630份评审报告，将自由文本评论转化为四个维度的评分（可读性、批判性、全面性、结构）并配以支持性理由。同时开发SurveyAlign强基线评估器，基于Qwen3-32B使用LoRA微调，并融合外部知识以支持知识密集型维度。提供了标准化的训练/测试划分和评估协议。
AI.result: 在测试集上，SurveyAlign较基于提示词的GPT-5.2评估方法显著提升了与人类审稿人的对齐度，四个维度的平均MSE从2.28降至1.38，MAE从1.15降至0.69。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的贡献包括：(1)建立了首个多维度、与审稿人对齐且可复现的综述评审数据集和评估框架；(2)开发了强基线评估器，显著提升与人类审稿人的对齐程度，为未来研究提供竞争性参考。

title: Emotion in an active inference model of human driving
summary: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在连续状态空间的主动推理驾驶模型中提取效价（valence）和唤醒度（arousal）情感信号的方法，将情感估计不仅基于当前状态还基于预测的未来结果，并在两个交互驾驶场景中验证了其与真实情感模式的对应性。
AI.motivation: 现有主动推理驾驶模型未考虑情感状态对驾驶决策的重要影响；已有将情感（效价和唤醒度）纳入主动推理的研究仅局限于离散状态空间的简化场景，无法应用于连续状态的真实驾驶环境。
AI.method: 提出一种扩展的效价和唤醒度公式，可从此前开发的连续状态主动推理驾驶模型中提取；情感估计同时条件于当前状态和预测的未来结果（而非仅当前状态）；在两个交互式驾驶场景中进行评估。
AI.result: 在两个交互驾驶场景中的实验结果表明，所提出的情感信号与类似场景中报告的真实情感模式（affective patterns）相一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展效价和唤醒度的定义并结合未来结果预测，可以在复杂的连续状态主动推理驾驶模型中有效提取与人类情感体验一致的情感信号，弥补了该领域对情感因素建模的空白。

title: Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space
summary: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LayoutDSL，一个基于LLM的室内场景布局生成框架，将布局推理建模为域特定语言(DSL)动作空间中的策略学习，通过监督微调和强化学习实现可解释、可验证的智能布局设计。
AI.motivation: 现有多数室内布局生成方法将任务简化为粗粒度3D包围盒条件，忽视门窗等结构要素；更关键的是，这些方法将空间推理建模为直接坐标预测的连续回归，阻碍了模型学习智能布局设计背后的推理逻辑。
AI.method: 提出LayoutDSL框架：(1) 将布局信息以DSL显式符号表示，作为结构化动作空间，每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策；(2) 构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，包含房间结构标注和配对合成DSL动作序列用于监督微调；(3) 设计基于室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励，通过强化学习优化策略，实现更泛化、可扩展且具有可验证反馈的策略学习。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性上显著优于强基线和现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将布局生成从连续坐标回归转变为DSL动作空间中的策略学习，能够有效提升模型学习可解释设计推理逻辑的能力，同时通过带验证反馈的强化学习进一步提升策略的泛化性和可扩展性。

title: A Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering
comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, conference, project page see https://ubisoft-laforge.github.io/world/hybridrdf
summary: Over the past decade, microfacet-based BRDF models have formed the foundation of real-time rendering pipelines. Despite their widespread use, they often fail to reproduce subtle appearance effects arising from complex light-surface interactions, which have led to the emergence of specialized physics-based models for specific optical phenomena (e.g., diffraction, iridescence, multilayers). Although more accurate, these models lose versatility and lack performance for real-time rendering. Recently introduced, neural models have demonstrated their ability to approximate BRDF reference data coming from measurements, simulations, or even complex shading networks. However, most current neural models require relatively large networks, making them costly for real-time rendering. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid model that combines a GGX-type microfacet model and a neural model to leverage the best features of both representations. The neural component corrects the appearance approximated by the microfacet component, allowing much smaller network than in existing neural models. We show that, at identical memory cost, our model approximates measurements better than state-of-the-art neural models for a low evaluation overhead compared to a microfacet-based model. Furthermore, our hybrid model remains easily editable by artists and benefits from an important sampling scheme, making it attractive for both offline and real-time rendering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合BRDF模型，将GGX微表面模型与神经网络模型结合，用小型神经网络修正微表面模型的近似外观，在相同内存成本下比现有神经模型更好地逼近测量数据，且评估开销低、可编辑、支持重要采样，适用于实时和离线渲染。
AI.motivation: 基于微表面的BRDF模型（如GGX）虽然在实时渲染中被广泛使用，但难以捕捉复杂光-表面交互产生的细微外观效果（如衍射、虹彩、多层膜）。专门针对这些现象的物理模型虽然更准确，但缺乏通用性且不适合实时渲染。现有神经模型虽能逼近BRDF参考数据，但需要较大的网络，计算成本高，难以用于实时渲染。
AI.method: 提出一种混合模型，将GGX型微表面模型与神经网络模型结合。神经组件负责修正微表面组件近似的外观误差，从而只需很小的神经网络即可达到良好的逼近效果，显著减小了网络规模。该模型支持艺术家编辑，并设计有重要采样（importance sampling）方案。
AI.result: 在相同内存成本条件下，该混合模型比现有最先进的神经模型能更准确地逼近测量数据，同时其评估开销相比纯微表面模型仅有少量增加，兼顾了精度与性能。
AI.conclusion: 混合模型成功结合了微表面模型的高效性和神经模型的表达能力，在保持低评估开销和可编辑性的同时，实现了对BRDF测量数据的高精度逼近，使其对离线与实时渲染场景都具有吸引力。

authors: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka
title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages
summary: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了达罗毗荼语系（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语和马拉雅拉姆语）在多语言语言模型中的表现。作者从头训练了5个GPT-2架构模型：4个单语模型（每种语言一个，各配32K词表子词分词器）和1个共享64K词表子词分词器的多语言模型，并在困惑度、每字节比特数、分词器效率及微调性能上与mGPT进行对比。结果表明，单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上优于mGPT，且其分词器在所有测试语言上比共享多语言模型更高效。
AI.motivation: 达罗毗荼语系语言在多语言语言模型的训练数据中占比很小，因此这些模型对每种单语的实际能力不明确。作者希望通过从头训练单语模型进行系统对比，探究单语模型是否比多语言模型在这些低资源语言上表现更好。
AI.method: 从头训练5个GPT-2架构模型：4个单语模型（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语各一个，每个使用独立32K词表子词分词器）和1个共享64K词表子词分词器的多语言模型。所有模型在清洗后的CC-100、Wikipedia和Samanantar数据上训练，并通过困惑度、每字节比特数、分词器效率及微调任务与mGPT基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上均优于mGPT基线；此外，单语模型的分词器在所有测试语言上都比共享多语言模型的分词器更高效。
AI.conclusion: 对于达罗毗荼语系这类低资源语言，训练专用的单语模型比依赖多语言模型更为有效，至少在分词效率和下游任务性能方面展现出明显优势。

title: Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel
summary: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据中心并行（DCP）方法，通过让数据本身驱动运行时，根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整并行大小、梯度累积和重计算等运行时设置，打破变长序列训练中效率与易用性之间的权衡，在32个H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速，且仅需10行代码即可集成到任意模型中。
AI.motivation: 变长长序列上的深度学习训练面临显著的计算挑战。现有方法要么使用静态配置导致工作负载不均衡和低效率，要么引入复杂方法带来大量的代码改动和实现复杂度，难以在效率与易用性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: DCP的核心思想是让数据本身驱动运行时系统。具体地，它根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整直接运行时设置（如并行大小、梯度累积、重计算等），从而在不同长度的序列之间实现计算资源的自适应分配。
AI.result: 在32个H200 GPU上实现了最高2.88倍的加速比，并且该方法具有良好的泛化性，可以仅用10行代码集成到任意模型中。
AI.conclusion: 作者预期这种简单而有效的方法能够作为一个稳健的基线，促进变长长序列分布式训练领域未来的发展。

title: P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization
summary: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

AI.tldr: P2Voxel是一个金字塔枢轴体素化框架，将网格三角化tokenization重定向为局部表面证据采样问题。通过局部平面性假设的枢轴体素化、空间复杂度假设的金字塔枢轴体素化以及块可重建性假设的金字塔VAE，将网格转化为紧凑、结构化、可学习的金字塔枢轴token，实现高效网格重建。
AI.motivation: 三角网格提供显式精确的表面几何，但拓扑连接不规则使3D网格tokenization成为几何采样问题：如何将几何证据采样并组织为紧凑、结构化且可学习的token。现有方法主要依靠field-centric体积采样和edge-intersection表面采样，缺乏对局部表面证据的高效利用。
AI.method: P2Voxel基于三个关键创新：(1) 局部平面性假设下的枢轴体素化——每个活跃体素用一个表面枢轴和方向符号表示，诱导确定性重建所需的角值；(2) 空间复杂度假设下的金字塔枢轴体素化——根据真实表面的空间非均匀性，对几何复杂区域分配更精细的枢轴token，平滑区域保持粗粒度；(3) 块可重建性假设下的金字塔VAE——在局部可重建枢轴块上学习紧凑多分辨率潜码，避免将整个高分辨率体素形状建模为稠密全局场。
AI.result: 该方法将网格转化为紧凑、结构化、可学习的金字塔枢轴token，实现高效网格重建，可支持下游3D任务。
AI.conclusion: P2Voxel通过重新定义网格tokenization为局部表面证据采样，以三层次假设构造金字塔枢轴体素化框架，在紧凑性、结构性和可学习性之间取得平衡，为3D网格重建提供了有效的token化方案。

title: XClipGS: Exact Half-Space Clipping for Medical Volume Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian-splatting proxies enable interactive rendering of volumetric medical scans, but a clipping plane exposes anatomy not constrained by external-view training and intersects primitives that conventional splatting can only keep or drop whole. We present XClipGS (eXact Clipping), which treats these as two separate problems: the render-time clip operator and supervision of the hidden interior. Under the local affine model used by EWA splatting, the ray integral of a half-space-restricted Gaussian factorizes exactly into its ordinary 2D footprint and a conditional Gaussian CDF whose argument is affine in pixel coordinates. The resulting closed-form per-pixel operator introduces no learned clipping parameters or auxiliary network and remains differentiable with respect to the primitive and plane. We use multi-distance reference views with varied clipping-plane axes and offsets to supervise the interior through the same operator. We also introduce a paired clipped/unclipped cut-face protocol with difference-referenced cut error (CDE) and culled-side leakage (Leak), because global image metrics dilute errors near the plane. On eight CT and MRI volumes with plane offsets not used for training, XClipGS attains the highest PSNR on every volume (33.56 versus 32.34 dB for ClipGS) while rendering at over 650 FPS, far above real time, versus 278 FPS. On voxel-axis cut-face views, it raises average band SSIM from 0.809 to 0.860 and leaks roughly 40 times less. Without retraining, it also achieves the best average across all four metrics on arbitrary-normal planes; on a fixed interior, it matches RaRa's face fidelity with about 16 times less leakage. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/XClipGS/

AI.tldr: XClipGS提出一种基于高斯泼溅的精确裁剪方法，将裁剪问题分解为渲染时裁剪算子与内部监督两个部分。在EWA泼溅的局部仿射模型下，半空间受限高斯的射线积分可精确分解为普通2D足迹与条件高斯CDF的乘积，得到无学习参数、可微的闭式逐像素算子。通过多距离参考视图和裁剪面监督内部，并引入成对裁剪/未裁剪切面对协议与差值参考裁剪误差和剔除侧泄漏指标。在八个CT/MRI体数据上，PSNR达33.56dB，渲染超650 FPS。
AI.motivation: 高斯泼溅代理能够实现医学体扫描的交互式渲染，但裁剪平面会暴露外部视图训练未约束的解剖结构，并与基元相交，而传统泼溅只能整体保留或丢弃基元，无法精确裁剪。
AI.method: 将裁剪视为两个独立问题：渲染时裁剪算子与内部监督。在EWA泼溅的局部仿射模型下，半空间受限高斯（half-space-restricted Gaussian）的射线积分可精确分解为普通2D足迹与条件高斯CDF（其参数为像素坐标的仿射函数）之积，得到闭式逐像素算子，无学习参数和辅助网络，对基元和平面可微。使用多个距离参考视图，采用不同裁剪面轴和偏移来监督内部；同时提出成对裁剪/未裁剪切面对协议及差值参考CDE和剔除侧泄漏（Leak）指标。
AI.result: 在八个CT/MRI体数据上、使用训练未用过的平面偏移，XClipGS在所有体数据上PSNR最高（33.56 dB vs ClipGS的32.34 dB），渲染速度超650 FPS（远超实时的278 FPS）。体素轴切面视图平均带SSIM从0.809提升至0.860，泄漏量约减少40倍。无需重训练，在任意法线平面上四个指标平均最佳；在固定内部与RaRa面保真度相当，泄漏量约减少16倍。
AI.conclusion: XClipGS通过精确闭式裁剪算子与差异参考监督协议，在保持实时渲染的同时大幅提升裁剪面处解剖结构的渲染质量并显著降低泄漏，为高斯泼溅医学渲染提供了高精度、高效的裁剪解决方案。

title: The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic
summary: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建阿拉伯语非连续形态学的形式化数学模型，证明后现代主义关于"无限制语义不确定性"的主张及其索绪尔任意指称公理与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构不相容。文章建立形态对应定理和语义定位定理，并利用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化索绪尔的相对任意性概念，证明阿拉伯语的相对任意性是递归可判定的且严格小于1，与印欧语系形成系统复杂度不对称性。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在检验后现代哲学中关于语义完全不确定性的主张以及索绪尔语言学中"任意指称"这一基础性公理，是否在形式层面与古典阿拉伯语的结构特征兼容。这一检验将语言学、数学与哲学问题交汇，期望为语义确定性问题提供严格的形式化论证。
AI.method: 本文采用形式化数学建模方法：1) 构建阿拉伯语非连续形态学的数学模型，其中词汇意义由不变词根与形态句法模式之间的相互作用决定；2) 建立形态对应定理（每个词项由词根-模式对唯一生成）和语义定位定理（词汇意义在派生层面先于表层实现被决定）；3) 用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化索绪尔的相对任意性，将任意性算法化定义为"无规则性"；4) 通过可判定性证明与复杂度计算对比阿拉伯语与印欧语的相对任意性。
AI.result: 研究证明了：一般相对任意性在形式上是不可判定的（不可计算），而阿拉伯语的相对任意性是可判定的，且其动机化能指（W层和M层）的相对任意性可证明严格小于1。由此确立了阿拉伯语相对于印欧语系的严格系统复杂度不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：后现代主义主张的无限制语义不确定性在古典阿拉伯语的结构中不成立，索绪尔任意指称公理的绝对版本也不与阿拉伯语兼容；但索绪尔的较弱版本"相对任意性"可以经算法化处理后，在阿拉伯语中得到严格的形式验证，且阿拉伯语显示出比印欧语言更高的形式可预测性与较低的任意性。

title: The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses
summary: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现线性探针能以近完美准确率检测语言模型中的受损上下文，但这一能力无法转化为可靠的失败预测，形成"知道但不说话"的解离现象。探针分数无法区分最终答案的正确性，结构化置信格式坍缩为两个难以区分的值，且探针跨步骤的持续性也无法预测结果正确性。探针干预的效果高度依赖模型与错误类型：branch-and-pick在多个模型上净收益为正且是Llama-3.1-8B上唯一不破坏正确轨迹的方法，而reprompt和replace-prior破坏正确轨迹与挽救错误轨迹的比率相当。作者主张探针监控是口头置信度的必要补充，但需要模型感知、错误类型感知的路由策略。
AI.motivation: 线性探针能够以近完美精度检测语言模型中的上下文损坏，但这种检测能力是否能够转化为对模型最终输出正确性的可靠预测尚不明确。这一解离现象对部署监控有直接而重要的影响——即便探针能"看见"问题，也不代表模型会"说"出问题。
AI.method: 在多跳算术链上采用线性探针检测上下文损坏，系统性地比较探针检测精度与最终答案正确性预测之间的关系；测试结构化置信格式的行为；验证预注册的"持久性胜过峰值"假设；并评估branch-and-pick、reprompt和replace-prior三种探针干预策略在多种模型族（含推理模型）上的表现。
AI.result: 探针检测损坏的准确率接近完美，但对最终答案正确性的预测完全无信息量；结构化置信输出坍缩为两个错误率难以区分的值；探针跨跳的持久性无法区分正确与错误结果，推翻了预注册假设。Branch-and-pick在所有模型上净收益为正，在Llama-3.1-8B上独特地表现出非破坏性（4次挽救，0次破坏）；reprompt与replace-prior则在大致相同的比率上破坏正确轨迹和挽救错误轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 探针监控是口头化置信度的必要补充，但不存在单一主导性干预方法。可部署的解决方案应是模型感知、错误类型感知的路由策略，而非一刀切的监控或干预方案。

title: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions
summary: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种生成式视觉-语言模型在三个机构的胸部X光影像数据集上、六种发现、两种提问协议下超过34.5万条发现级预测的参考标准一致性估计。结果显示，在完全排除接收机构数据的严格留出评估下，简单固定估计器（Beta-二项经验贝叶斯和仅目标机构逻辑回归）优于自适应选择策略，但两者差异极小且各占约半数情境优势，无法推荐默认方案；跨机构合并的估计器优势仅集中在单一站点且经机构聚类后不再显著；名义95%的后验预测区间覆盖率仅87.0%。结论为参考一致性须按站点和接口逐例重新评估。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型输出结构化胸部X光发现但未提供置信度分数，接收机构无法量化对单条判断的信任程度。既有证据缺乏对跨机构、跨发现类型、跨预测方向和跨提问格式的一致性迁移是否成立的测量，因此亟需系统性评估一致性估计策略在严格机构留出条件下的可靠性。
AI.method: 在三个机构胸部X光语料库上评估三种生成式视觉-语言模型，考察六种发现、两种提问协议，产生超过34.5万条发现级预测。用少量本地标签估计各机构-发现-方向组合的参考一致性，比较七种估计器（含Beta-二项经验贝叶斯、仅目标机构逻辑回归、跨机构合并估计器等），并在严格机构留出评估下进行重复压力测试；同时测评名义95%的经验贝叶斯后验预测计数区间覆盖率。
AI.result: 自适应选择七个估计器未能优于简单固定方案：平均Brier分数0.1083，而固定使用Beta-二项经验贝叶斯为0.0853、仅目标机构逻辑回归为0.0855；两者差0.0003，小于该族对求解器版本变化的敏感度，且各在约半数设定中领先，无法推荐默认。跨机构池化优势集中在一个站点，经机构聚类后不具确认性。plug-in经验贝叶斯后验预测计数区间名义95%实际覆盖率仅87.0%，在最困难机构更低。
AI.conclusion: 参考一致性必须在每个站点和每个接口上重新评估，不存在可跨机构移植的默认估计策略；这些结果衡量的是与机构标签的一致性，而非临床正确性。

title: When Does An Extra View Help? Adapting Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
summary: Reconstruction of 3D objects from a single image is a challenging research problem in computer vision. The key challenge is the lack of critical information from viewpoints to complete 3D structures. Using an additional view may help to resolve the issue. However, there is no mechanism that can integrate the extra view into the single-view 3D reconstruction principle. We address this challenge by proposing ASV3D, a framework for adapting single-view 3D object reconstruction to test-time data with support from one additional image. We introduce two adaptation strategies: (i) a zero-shot adaptation scheme that leverages the auxiliary image to improve the reconstruction quality of an object without retraining, and (ii) an optimised adaptation scheme that further enhances visual fidelity and cross-view consistency via contrastive learning. We apply our ASV3D to improve two state-of-the-art single-view 3D reconstruction pipelines on both benchmark and real-world datasets. Results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under unconstrained multi-view inputs, outperforming the baselines in both quantitative metrics and human preference. We publish our code and the real-world object dataset in our project page at https://github.com/YNhuHuynh/ASV3D/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASV3D框架，利用一张额外图像作为辅助信息来改进单视图3D物体重建。通过零样本适配和对比学习优化的两种适配策略，在基准和真实数据集上提升了两个SOTA单视图重建管线的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 单图像3D重建的核心挑战在于缺乏关键视角信息，难以完整恢复3D结构。虽然增加一个视角可能有助于解决该问题，但现有方法缺乏将额外视图整合进单视图重建框架的机制。
AI.method: 提出ASV3D框架，包含两种适配策略：(i) 零样本适配方案，无需重新训练即可利用辅助图像改进重建质量；(ii) 基于对比学习的优化适配方案，进一步提升视觉保真度和跨视图一致性。框架应用于两个SOTA单视图3D重建管线。
AI.result: 在基准数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，ASV3D在非约束多视图输入下持续提升重建精度和鲁棒性，在定量指标和人工偏好评估方面均优于基线方法。代码与真实物体数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: ASV3D成功将额外视图整合到单视图重建框架中，提供了一种可插拔的自适应机制，在不重新训练（零样本）或通过对比学习优化两种模式下均能有效提升重建质量，为单视图3D重建在辅助信息下提供新的解决方案。

title: Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoVisLE，一个面向波兰语的单文化视觉语言基准数据集，包含1,117张图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA对，用于在扎根评估范式下评估模型对文化情境化多模态理解的能力，超越了表层识别层面。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）主要基于英语中心化数据进行训练，在处理特定文化背景下的视觉理解时表现不佳，无法解读地区特定的符号意义和情境相关的视觉线索。已有的文化能力基准多基于模板驱动且聚焦于表层识别，难以深入评估模型在文化情境下的语言和语用理解能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个名为PoVisLE的单文化（波兰）视觉语言基准数据集，采用扎根评估范式（grounded evaluation paradigm），即语言在视觉上下文的交互中被解读。数据集包含1,117张图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA（视觉问答）配对。
AI.result: 该数据集提供了受控且具有挑战性的资源，用于评估文化扎根的视觉语言理解能力，强调超越表面识别（surface-level recognition）的深层理解。
AI.conclusion: PoVisLE作为波兰文化的单文化基准，填补了现有文化能力基准在深层语用和情境理解方面的空白，为评估VLM在文化情境下的多模态理解提供了更严格的测试资源。

title: NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation
summary: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NL2SHACL-Bench，一个用于自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的基准测试套件，并评估了四种最先进的大语言模型在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: SHACL是验证RDF知识图谱一致性的核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要技术专长，领域专家通常缺乏这种能力。将自然语言需求翻译为SHACL（NL2SHACL）可以降低门槛，但目前没有专门的基准测试，且评估生成的形状需要超越字符串比较的方法，因为语义等价的形状在序列化和结构上可能不同。
AI.method: 构建NL2SHACL-Bench基准测试套件，用于自然语言到SHACL翻译的评估；使用该基准对四种最先进的大语言模型进行NL2SHACL任务的系统评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，当前的大语言模型在生成语法有效的SHACL方面能力很强，但对于复杂的逻辑和结构模式，仍难以生成语义等价的约束。
AI.conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域的技术进步提供了有意义的评估基础，揭示了当前LLM在该任务上的能力边界，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models
summary: The development of vision-based wildfire detection systems for unmanned aerial vehicles is constrained by the limited availability of diverse real-world training images. This paper investigates the impact of dataset composition on embedded real-time UAV wildfire detection using compact YOLO models as a controlled validation family. Four training configurations were evaluated: real non-augmented, real augmented, hybrid non-augmented, and hybrid augmented, where the hybrid sets combine real wildfire images with AI-generated samples. The objective is to determine whether synthetic data mixing and image augmentation improve practical detection performance under resource-constrained deployment conditions. Experimental results show that the best overall operating point was obtained with the real non-augmented dataset, which achieved the strongest balance between recall and mean average precision for UAV-based wildfire detection. The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在嵌入式实时UAV野火检测中，数据集组成对紧凑型YOLO模型性能的影响。通过对比四种训练配置（真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强、混合增强），发现真实非增强数据集取得了最好的检测性能，表明数据真实性和领域对齐比通过合成数据扩充训练集更为重要。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉野火检测系统的开发受限于真实世界训练图像的多样性不足。作者希望探究在资源受限的嵌入式部署条件下，数据扩充和AI合成数据的引入是否能够改善实际检测性能，从而为数据集构建策略提供指导。
AI.method: 使用紧凑型YOLO模型作为受控验证家族，设计了四种训练配置：真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强（真实+AI生成样本）和混合增强。在嵌入式实时UAV野火检测场景下系统评估每种配置的性能，比较召回率与平均精度均值（mAP）的平衡关系。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，真实非增强数据集在所有配置中取得了最佳的综合性能，实现了召回率与mAP之间最强平衡。混合合成数据或进行图像增强均未产生更优的最终部署选择。
AI.conclusion: 对于嵌入式UAV野火检测任务，数据集的真实性和领域对齐比通过合成数据扩展训练集规模更有价值。建议在实际部署中优先确保训练数据的真实代表性，而非盲目追求数据集规模。

title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation
summary: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinuities across generated viewpoints, leading to inaccuracies in reconstructed 3D models. Current solutions either incur significant additional computational burdens or fail to adequately resolve practical inconsistencies between synthesized views. To address these limitations, we propose a novel viewpoint-adaptive neural rendering framework that enables robust 3D reconstruction even when given partially inconsistent multi-view inputs. Our approach introduces view-adaptive neural renderers that independently correct viewpoint-dependent errors while simultaneously sharing a global feature backbone to preserve structural coherence. Furthermore, we propose a self-attention fusion module that adaptively integrates multi-view information, ensuring geometric consistency without relying heavily on indirect regularizations or computationally intensive methods. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method consistently improves 3D reconstruction fidelity. Importantly, our approach achieves near state-of-the-art performance without diffusion-based SDS supervision, relying primarily on photometric rendering loss with lightweight attention regularizers. This balance between accuracy and efficiency makes the proposed framework highly practical for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种视角自适应神经渲染框架，通过视角自适应渲染器与自注意力融合模块，在部分不一致的多视角输入下也能鲁棒地进行单图像3D重建，无需扩散SDS监督即可接近最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 传统单目3D生成流程先由单图合成多视角再经NeRF重建，但固有的投影歧义导致生成视角间存在视觉不连续，影响重建精度。现有方案要么计算开销大，要么无法充分解决合成视角间的不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出一个视角自适应的神经渲染框架：(1) 引入视角自适应神经渲染器，独立纠正与视角相关的误差，同时共享全局特征骨干以保持结构一致性；(2) 设计自注意力融合模块，自适应整合多视角信息，确保几何一致性，无需依赖间接正则化或高计算量方法。训练主要依靠光度渲染损失配合轻量注意力正则项。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法持续提升3D重建保真度，在无需扩散SDS监督的条件下达到接近最先进的性能，同时兼顾精度与效率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在重建精度与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，具有很高的实际应用价值。

title: On the use of foundation models in cognitive science
summary: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四阶段推理框架，用于评估基础模型作为认知与发展模型的适切性，强调仅凭行为对齐不足以使FM成为解释性的认知模型，必须嵌入明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务和系统性的对比评估中。
AI.motivation: 近年来大量研究评估了基础模型（FMs）在认知和发展维度上与人类的对齐性，但使用FMs作为候选认知模型面临重大的方法论和概念挑战。核心问题在于：在什么条件下，行为对齐足以证明FMs可以作为认知的解释性模型？现有研究缺乏一个系统性的推理框架来指导这一评估。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个四阶段推理框架：(1) 将人类实验任务改编为模型兼容格式；(2) 明确指定将模型输出映射到人类行为测度的链接假设（linking hypotheses）；(3) 评估行为对应性；(4) 在候选模型或操纵之间进行比较评估。文章还澄清了链接假设在映射模型输出到人类行为测度中的角色，识别了约束对齐主张的挑战，并提出了理论驱动和对比性评估的原则。
AI.result: 文章论证了行为拟合本身不足以支持FM作为认知模型的合法性。对齐仅在嵌入明确的理论承诺、采用理论诊断性任务、以及在候选模型之间进行系统性的对比评估时，才具有科学意义。
AI.conclusion: 行为对齐不能单独作为FM作为解释性认知模型的充分条件；科学上有意义的对齐必须建立在明确的理论框架、理论诊断性任务设计和系统性对比评估的基础之上。

title: Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems
summary: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将多智能体LLM系统中的智能体选择与通信建模为合作博弈，通过边际价值路由和贪心策略优化智能体激活与通信边的选择，在合成实验中达到99.5%的暴力最优效用，同时仅激活平均1.96/8个智能体，远优于全广播的38.8%。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体AI系统结合多个异构LLM智能体，但大多数架构要么预先固定通信结构，要么允许全广播。两者都会因token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播随活跃智能体数量和通信链路增加而效率低下。因此需要一种动态、任务条件化的方式来选择性激活和通信。
AI.method: 将智能体选择与通信建模为带任务条件净效用的合作博弈U(C|x)=V(C|x)-Σc_i，分离联盟级成本与智能体激活成本；提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由；扩展模型以在每边成本下优化通信边；使用估计的Shapley值预测执行前和执行中应联系哪些智能体；连接子模最大化问题并证明相关保证。
AI.result: 贪心路由在合成实验中达到暴力最优效用的99.5%，平均激活8个智能体中的1.96个（全广播仅达38.8%）；性能对激活成本和冗余权重具有鲁棒性，但在子模性严重违反或价值估计有噪声时降至66%；提供曲率精化界、紧的1/2近似保证（含符号目标修正），以及Shapley-子模三明治界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效减少多智能体系统中的冗余通信和成本，与Shapley定价、享乐联盟形成和通信图剪枝等方法有明确区分；主要路由仍是启发式方法（理论上限不直接适用），需在真实多智能体LLM基准上进一步验证。

title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection
comment: This work has already published at WACV 2025, just want more accessibility
summary:
In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes.
  The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.
  Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVMD，一种多视图镜子检测方法，并构建了首个多视图镜子检测数据库，利用跨视图与视图内注意力机制捕捉物体在镜子内外的关联，相比单图像检测方法在准确率和IoU上分别提升最高2.6%和11.1%，有效改善镜子密集环境下的3D重建精度。
AI.motivation: 在3D重建中，镜子会引入扭曲和碎片化的空间，导致重建模型不准确。现有镜子检测方法仅针对单图像，忽略了多视图设置中丰富的跨视角信息，无法从多视图图像中有效利用物体在镜子内外、不同视角间的关联来提升检测精度。
AI.method: MVMD由三个关键模块组成：Inter-Views Block跟踪因视角变化引起的镜中物体位移；Intra-View Block检测镜面内的物体反射；Refinement Block锐化镜子边界并增强细节。核心思想是通过跨注意力与自注意力机制学习不同视角的物体与镜内反射物体之间的内在关联。此外，作者构建了首个多视图镜子检测数据库。
AI.result: 与单图像镜子检测方法相比，MVMD在准确率上提升最高2.6%，IoU上提升最高11.1%，显著提升了镜子密集环境下的3D重建精度。
AI.conclusion: MVMD通过多视图信息的有效利用，显著优于单图像镜子检测方法，尤其适用于镜子密集环境下的计算机视觉任务及3D重建精度提升。

title: "Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的中间层特征，系统研究了语言模型内部如何表征"说话者"（Assistant、Roleplay角色扮演、Story故事角色），发现Assistant与Roleplay共享核心特征且逐层分化，而Story角色缺乏该核心；并引入了Immersive Simulation Mode来区分不同生成模式。
AI.motivation: 尽管语言模型已广泛用于角色扮演、故事叙述和助手对话等多种生成场景，但模型内部如何表征"谁在说话"这一问题仍未得到充分探索。理解说话者身份的神经表征机制对于解释模型行为、控制生成风格以及诊断幻觉或角色漂移等问题具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究使用用户表达情绪文本及对应模型回复的数据集，将三种生成设置（Assistant、Roleplay、Story）分解为在句边界和代词token位置提取的稀疏自编码器特征，并通过过滤pipeline在不同深度选择特征；对每个存活特征通过steering效应和激活分布进行刻画。
AI.result: 主要发现是：Assistant与Roleplay角色并非相互独立的替代方案——角色扮演保留了Assistant关联的特征核心，并随层数加深逐渐与之分化（从操作机制特征到行为与风格特征）；而故事角色缺乏Assistant关联的核心。Story和Roleplay可通过Immersive Simulation Mode与Assistant区分，但Assistant在默认设置下有时也会进入或缓慢漂移进入该模式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了大语言模型中说话者身份表征的结构性特征：角色扮演是建立在Assistant表征基础上的渐进式分化，而故事角色则是更独立的表征路径。同时，不同生成模式之间存在潜在的边界模糊性（Assistant可漂移进入Immersive Simulation Mode），这对可控生成和模型对齐具有启示意义。

title: MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents
comment: 30 pages, 17 figures. Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (OOPSLA1)
summary:
An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaSpace框架，利用蜕变测试原理自动评估具身智能体的空间认知能力，通过逻辑规则（Prolog编码）将物理法则和逻辑规则转化为可执行测试用例，在三个具身场景中检测出90,422个空间认知错误，SOTA智能体得分仅0.44-0.52，远低于人类基准0.96。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体评估方法存在两大缺陷：基于人工标注的VQA对既昂贵又受标注质量波动影响；基于高层任务完成指标（如导航/操作成功率）可能掩盖关键漏洞，允许智能体通过次优手段或违反安全规则完成任务，从而隐藏安全风险和效率问题。由于空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，亟需一种评估智能体在执行任务过程中是否具备稳健空间认知的方法。
AI.method: 受软件工程中蜕变测试原理启发，提出MetaSpace框架。它从真实执行轨迹中提取时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理法则预定义的蜕变关系（MRs）自动生成测试用例，并将这些MRs编码为Prolog可执行规则。通过检测关系的违反情况来判断空间认知失败，并提出空间认知（SC）评分量化性能。
AI.result: 在三个具身场景中进行实证评估，MetaSpace成功在SOTA MLLM驱动的智能体中检测出90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的平均SC得分介于0.44到0.52之间，显著低于人类基准的0.96。
AI.conclusion: 当前SOTA具身智能体的空间认知能力与人类水平仍存在显著差距，MetaSpace作为一种自动化、可扩展的评估框架，能够有效揭示现有高层任务指标所掩盖的空间认知缺陷，为具身智能体的安全性和可靠性评估提供新范式。

title: XEns-CKD: An Explainable Ensemble-Based Approach for Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Detection
