AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenVisTool框架，用于构建具有因果效用的视觉工具使用轨迹数据。核心观点是：教师模型生成的轨迹即使答案正确，也不一定能提供有效监督——只有当工具观测对答案产生因果贡献时轨迹才值得保留。基于此构建了OpenVisTool-42K数据集和OpenVisTool-Bench基准，在四个骨干模型（4B-27B）上微调均提升视觉工具使用性能，并有两个OOD基准的收益。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉工具学习方法从教师生成的成功轨迹中学习，默认每个成功示范都提供有效监督。但这一假设存在缺陷：强教师模型往往不依赖工具调用也能得到正确答案，模仿这类轨迹教会学生"工具调用伴随正确答案"而非"工具观测支撑正确答案"，导致学习的工具使用能力缺乏因果根基。
AI.method: OpenVisTool框架采用三阶段流程：(1)难度筛选——挑选不依赖工具无法可靠回答的查询；(2)领域特化轨迹合成——生成连贯的工具使用轨迹；(3)监督验证——联合检验轨迹的答案正确性（结果有效性）和工具观测对答案的因果贡献（因果效用）。只有同时满足两个条件的轨迹才被保留作为训练数据。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖五个视觉推理领域的OpenVisTool-42K数据集和同域基准OpenVisTool-Bench。在四个不同规模骨干（4B-27B）上微调均一致提升视觉工具使用性能，在两个分布外基准上也有增益；较大的模型性能接近领先的闭源系统。
AI.conclusion: 有效视觉工具使用能力应源于因果有依据的监督，而非单纯的工具调用模式模仿。这一证据支持了"以因果有效性为核心的监督信号"对多模态智能体工具学习的关键作用。

title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
summary: An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. With no change to the judge, the candidates, or the budget, EL-DGR reaches 58.2% on GSM8K (vs. 56.8% judge, 55.8% majority, 55.4% first candidate) and 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1 on HotpotQA (vs. 15.67/23.49, 15.33/23.19, 15.33/22.97), improving on first-candidate GRPO by +2.8 pp (exact McNemar p=0.0026) and +2.00 EM (p=0.070, borderline). A decision audit shows why: EL-DGR overturns consensus on only 8 of 30 pilot questions and never converts a correct consensus into an incorrect answer. We also report what did not work: the same seven-channel decomposition used as a step-level gated training reward is null, and corrected channel-drop ablations show no channel is individually necessary (p=1.0 throughout). The practitioner-facing finding is negative about judges and positive about admissibility, bound the judge's blast radius rather than trying to make it accurate.

AI.tldr: 本文证明LLM裁判在推理管线中的价值主要取决于其嵌入的决策规则而非其自身准确性。在冻结候选池上，无约束的DeepSeek-R1-7B裁判相对多数投票几乎无增益，甚至在某些场景下更差；而采用任务自适应的非补偿性规则EL-DGR（证据锁定-推导-门控-修复）后，在GSM8K和HotpotQA上均显著提升，且决策审计显示其几乎不破坏正确共识。作者还报告了七个通道分解作为step-level训练奖励无效，且没有单一通道是必要性的。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多以裁判（LLM judge）本身的准确率衡量其价值，但作者指出：部署在推理管线中的裁判不仅测量质量，更决定最终输出哪个答案，其决策影响取决于嵌入的决策规则。为了量化并改进裁判在管线中的真实作用，作者提出应关注"裁判的爆炸半径"（blast radius）而非单纯追求裁判准确性。
AI.method: 在四个GRPO策略的冻结候选池上，先评估无约束标量裁判（DeepSeek-R1-7B）与多数投票的对比；随后提出EL-DGR（Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair）任务自适应非补偿性决策规则，该规则要求裁判偏好只有在具备可提取证据证书时才能覆盖证据支持的共识，且修复仅在双方均未获证书且修复项获证书时执行。同时进行决策审计和通道消融实验。
AI.result: 无约束裁判在GSM8K上仅比多数投票高1.0pp，在HotpotQA上高0.34 EM，且在30题确认集上比多数票差10分。EL-DGR在GSM8K达到58.2%（vs.裁判56.8%、多数55.8%、首候选55.4%），HotpotQA达到17.33 EM/25.46 F1。GSM8K改进+2.8pp（p=0.0026），HotpotQA +2.00 EM（p=0.070边缘显著）。审计显示EL-DGR仅推翻8/30共识且从不将正确共识转为错误答案。七通道作为训练奖励无效，通道消融显示无单通道必要（p=1.0）。
AI.conclusion: 对从业者的核心启示是：关于裁判的结论是负面的（单纯提升其准确性用处有限），关于可接纳性（admissibility）的结论是正面的——应限制裁判的决策爆炸半径，而非试图使其更准确。决策规则而非裁判本身决定了推理管线的输出质量。

title: CosmosAlign: Adapting a World Foundation Model for Generative Traffic Video Forecasting
summary: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

AI.tldr: CosmosAlign是一个基于预训练Cosmos3-Nano世界基础模型的生成式交通视频预测框架，通过两阶段LoRA适配和训练无关的推理优化，在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准上以76.49分位列榜首。
AI.motivation: 将大型预训练世界模型适配到下游预测任务的成功关键主要在于分布对齐而非增加模型容量。
AI.method: 提出两阶段LoRA适配策略：首先将条件模式分布与目标预测任务对齐，然后通过基于LLM的重标定流水线将训练标题与模型原生结构化提示接口对齐。推理阶段采用全训练无关流程，包括基于共识的中位数样本选择和运动自适应静态场景区域混合。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准上取得76.49分的最终成绩，在最终排行榜上排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将预训练世界模型适配到下游任务时，分布对齐策略优于增加模型参数规模，且训练无关的推理优化方法能有效提升预测质量。

title: Mitigating Gender Bias in English to Romanian Machine Translation
summary: Machine translation (MT) systems often fail to correctly translate gender, especially when converting from a gender-neutral language like English to a gendered target language such as Romanian. This bias results in translations that default to masculine forms or reinforce gender stereotypes. We propose a hybrid pipeline to mitigate this issue by combining large language model (LLM)-based gender classification with neural machine translation (NMT). Our system uses a fine-tuned LLM to detect the intended gender of target words in English sentences and insert inline gender hint tags. These tagged sentences are then passed to a Transformer model fine-tuned to generate morphologically correct Romanian translations. To support this, we introduce three novel datasets for gender disambiguation and translation. Our approach improves gender accuracy on the WinoMT and WinoGender benchmarks by over 40 percentage points compared to a baseline MT system. This is the first method to explicitly address and evaluate gender bias in English-Romanian MT using both LLM inference and tag-aware translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合流水线，结合微调LLM的性别分类与NMT翻译，通过插入性别提示标签来解决英语到罗马尼亚语机器翻译中的性别偏见问题，在WinoMT和WinoGender基准上性别准确率提升超过40个百分点。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译系统在从性别中性语言（如英语）翻译到性别标记语言（如罗马尼亚语）时经常无法正确翻译性别，导致默认使用阳性形式或强化性别刻板印象。
AI.method: 采用混合流水线：首先使用微调的大语言模型检测英语句子中目标词的预期性别并插入内联性别提示标签，然后将带标签的句子传递给微调后的Transformer模型以生成形态学上正确的罗马尼亚语翻译。同时引入三个新的性别消歧与翻译数据集。
AI.result: 在WinoMT和WinoGender基准上，与基线MT系统相比，性别准确率提高了超过40个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个同时利用LLM推理和标签感知翻译来显式解决和评估英语-罗马尼亚语MT中性别偏见的方法。

title: Counterfactual Benchmarking and Training for Factuality Consistency and Order-Robust Grounded Reasoning in LLMs over Heterogeneous Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have increasingly supported response generation grounded in user-provided knowledge spanning heterogeneous structures. However, existing benchmarks provide limited assessment of whether LLMs can faithfully perform multi-hop reasoning chains across such knowledge contexts while remaining robust to variations in their input order. We introduce TKFQA, a factuality consistency benchmark comprising 10,130 question-answering (QA) pairs grounded in tables, texts, and knowledge graphs (KGs). Each example is constructed from an explicit counterfactual reasoning chain, enabling the joint evaluation of answer correctness, reasoning-chain accuracy, and robustness to different input-order. An extensive evaluation of 14 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals that state-of-the-art models exhibit limited reasoning-chain accuracy and remain sensitive to variations in the input order of heterogeneous knowledge contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ORLF, an LLM-agnostic training framework that models cross-context topological relations through knowledge-specific latent vectors. ORLF integrates context-wise position encoding, a latent-bridge attention mask, and topological knowledge bias to preserve knowledge-specific bias and encode topological semantics. Experiments across four LLM backbones show that ORLF outperforms competitive training-free and LoRA-based baselines, improving average Exact Match and Reasoning-Chain Accuracy by 2.15% and 4.29%, respectively, while reducing order-induced performance standard deviation by 0.04% to 3.01%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TKFQA基准（10,130个QA对，覆盖表格、文本和知识图谱），用于评估LLM在多源异构知识上执行多跳推理的忠实性和对输入顺序的鲁棒性；并提出ORLF训练框架，通过知识特定潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系，在四个LLM骨干上提升EM 2.15%和推理链准确率4.29%，同时降低顺序敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对LLM在异构知识上下文中执行多跳推理链忠实性以及输入顺序鲁棒性的联合评估，需要新的基准和方法来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 构建TKFQA基准，每个样例基于显式反事实推理链构建，联合评估答案正确性、推理链准确性和输入顺序鲁棒性；2) 提出ORLF框架，通过知识特定潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系，集成上下文位置编码、潜在桥接注意力掩码和拓扑知识偏置。
AI.result: 14个开源和闭源LLM的评估显示最先进模型推理链准确率有限且对输入顺序敏感；ORLF在四个LLM骨干上平均EM提升2.15%、RCA提升4.29%，并将顺序导致的性能标准差降低0.04%~3.01%。
AI.conclusion: 异构知识上下文下的多跳推理仍是LLM的关键挑战，ORLF通过建模拓扑关系有效提升了推理忠实性和顺序鲁棒性，且为LLM无关的通用训练框架。

title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
summary: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Reference code is publicly available at https://github.com/Oooorca/SpikeWorld.

AI.tldr: SpikeWorld是一个1.45M参数的稀疏脉冲模型，联合训练用于异构传感预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时所有训练参数冻结，通过延迟下一状态残差更新两个外部路径（固定银行损失累积选择有界动作校正、路线特定残差矩阵细化下一状态预测），两者均不使用标签、教师输出、奖励或成功信号。联合优化使动作下一状态MSE提升17.10%，同时改善多模态预测、语义准确率和图像-文本检索。在六个Meta-World实验臂中，SpikeWorld将冻结策略奖励提升7.90分。
AI.motivation: 预测模型在观察到动作后果时会收到自监督信号，但部署后利用该信号面临困难：当动力学和语义共享参数时，冻结参数阻止自适应，而权重更新需要优化器状态且可能改变已学习表示。作者旨在解决部署阶段无法在不破坏冻结模型的情况下利用自监督信号进行自适应的问题。
AI.method: 提出SpikeWorld架构：(1) 1.45M参数稀疏脉冲模型，联合训练异构传感预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学；(2) 部署时完全冻结训练参数；(3) 外部有两个路径接收延迟的下一状态残差：累积固定银行损失选择有界动作校正路径，路线特定残差矩阵细化下一状态预测；(4) 两个外部路径均不依赖标签、教师输出、奖励或成功信号；(5) 使用16字节RLS估计器在消融研究中验证知识贡献来源。
AI.result: 联合优化使动作下一状态MSE降低17.10%，同时改善多模态预测、语义准确率和图像-文本检索。在留置剪切和衰减流上，组合外部状态使聚合预测分别提升5.48%和30.01%；固定银行动作路径使跟踪分别提升24.20%和3.94%。六个Meta-World实验臂（450条轨迹）中冻结策略奖励提升7.90（95% CI [2.48, 14.06]），成功差异13.33点（CI [0, 40]）为描述性结果。对于相同感官输入，模型参数和继承的语义输出保持逐位不变。16字节RLS估计器在线性衰减上获得最高非oracle奖励，证明贡献并非来自优越的线性识别，而是与冻结多模态脉冲检查点的集成。
AI.conclusion: SpikeWorld证明了在完全冻结所有训练参数的情况下，通过两个外部自监督路径即可实现部署后的在线自适应，且不会改变已学习表示。其性能提升并非源于外部线性识别的优越性，而是源于与冻结多模态脉冲检查点的有效集成，表明该方法在资源受限的部署场景中具有实用性。

title: North Africa's Missing Framework: NLP-Driven Mental Healthcare in Algeria and Implications for Low-resource Settings
summary: Mental health disorders are a leading cause of disability worldwide, yet Natural Language Processing (NLP) research for mental healthcare has remained concentrated in high-income, English-language settings. North Africa, and Algeria in particular, is largely absent from this literature despite its unique linguistic, historical, and healthcare context. We present the first conceptual framework examining the potential role of NLP within Algeria's mental healthcare system. Drawing on narrative synthesis of global NLP mental health research, Algerian healthcare literature, and low-resource NLP methodologies, we identify four structural barriers to mental healthcare: the language-of-care gap, geographic inequities in access, stigma-related barriers to help-seeking, and the absence of research and digital infrastructure. We then map existing NLP capabilities to each barrier, outlining their potential applications, implementation constraints, and the technical, institutional, and governance requirements necessary for deployment. Based on this analysis, we propose a research and policy roadmap that prioritizes data resources, multilingual language technologies, evaluation frameworks, and regulatory capacity. Although grounded in the Algerian context, the framework addresses challenges common to many multilingual, low-resource, and post-colonial settings. This work provides a foundation for future research on culturally and linguistically appropriate NLP for mental healthcare and offers a practical roadmap for developing responsible AI-enabled mental health systems in underrepresented regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个探讨NLP在阿尔及利亚精神卫生保健系统中潜在作用的概念框架，识别了四大结构性障碍（语言照护鸿沟、地理可及性不平等、污名化求助障碍、研究与数字基础设施缺失），并将现有NLP能力映射到各障碍上，提出研究政策路线图。
AI.motivation: 精神健康障碍是全球残疾的主要原因，但NLP精神健康研究集中在高收入英语国家，北非尤其是阿尔及利亚在该领域几乎缺席。尽管阿尔及利亚具有独特的语言、历史和医疗背景，却缺乏相应的NLP研究，亟需一个概念框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过叙事综合方法，整合全球NLP精神健康研究、阿尔及利亚医疗保健文献和低资源NLP方法论，识别四大结构性障碍，并将现有NLP能力逐一映射到各障碍，分析其潜在应用、实施约束及部署所需的技术/制度/治理要求。
AI.result: 识别出语言照护鸿沟、地理可及性不平等、污名化求助障碍和基础设施缺失四大障碍；提出优先关注数据资源、多语言语言技术、评估框架和监管能力的研究与政策路线图。
AI.conclusion: 该框架虽以阿尔及利亚为背景，但所面对的挑战在许多多语言、低资源、后殖民环境中普遍存在，为在代表性不足地区开发负责任AI精神健康系统提供了基础和实践路线图。

title: Back to the Future: A workbook time machine for spread sheet creation benchmarks
summary: We introduce the workbook time machine, a pipeline that automatically creates benchmarks evaluating the ability of language models to create derived objects in spreadsheets (formulas, charts, pivot tables, and conditional formatting). Applied to public workbook corpora, it produces wtmcorpus--a collection of (input workbook, output workbook, query) triples spanning four artifact types and varying complexity. From this corpus we curate wtmbench, a 150-task evaluation benchmark with queries at three levels of specificity. We evaluate existing spreadsheet manipulation agents and baselines on wtmbench across artifact types, step complexity, and instruction granularity. Our evaluations show that query specificity, agent orchestration, and interface API used to control spreadsheets play a big role in LLM performance on Excel tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"工作簿时光机"(Workbook Time Machine)流水线，自动创建用于评估语言模型在电子表格中创建派生对象（公式、图表、透视表和条件格式）能力的基准测试。基于该流水线构建了wtmcorpus数据集和wtmbench基准（150个任务），并评估了现有电子表格操作代理，发现查询特异性、代理编排和接口API对LLM在Excel任务上的表现有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格相关基准测试缺乏对"创建派生对象"这一核心能力的系统评估。需要一个自动化、可扩展的流水线来生成包含（输入工作簿、输出工作簿、查询）三元组的高质量基准，以衡量LLM在真实电子表格任务中的表现。
AI.method: ①提出Workbook Time Machine流水线，自动从公开工作簿语料库中生成基准任务；②构建wtmcorpus语料库，包含四种工件类型（公式、图表、透视表、条件格式）且复杂度各异的三元组数据；③从中筛选出wtmbench基准，包含150个任务，查询分为三个级别的特异性（模糊、中等、精确）；④在wtmbench上评估现有电子表格操作代理和基线模型。
AI.result: 实验表明查询特异性（指令粒度）、代理编排方式以及用于控制电子表格的接口API这三个因素对LLM在Excel任务上的性能有显著影响。不同工件类型和步骤复杂度下模型表现存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 查询特异性、代理编排和接口API是影响LLM电子表格任务性能的关键因素，wtmbench为未来电子表格智能体的研究提供了系统化、可复现的评估平台。

title: Tokenizer Generator Coupling in Medical Image Generation
summary: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation is valid in a controlled ChestMNIST study at 64x64, crossing discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We retrain the vocabulary-1024 interaction block at three seeds and the interaction survives (6 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceed three seed standard deviations), and we scope the wider single-seed grid accordingly. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. On LFQ-1024, retuning D3PM and SE-D3PM (selected on a held-out validation split) moves them from default FID-192 0.44/0.41 to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds; the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. We report FID-192 as an internal ranking metric; it ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.80) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.78). We interpret these results through a rate-distortion-modelability framing, where modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. All experiments are at 64x64 on low-resolution medical-style images, unconditional, and evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and we scope every claim to that setting. Code: https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medtokenizers and https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medlatents.

AI.tldr: 本文在64x64 ChestMNIST受控实验中系统研究潜在医学图像生成器中tokenizer、生成器与采样器之间的交互作用，发现三者排名相互依赖；提出生成器无关的统计量"邻居条件预测增益"以替代重建PSNR进行量化器选择，并通过重调D3PM/SE-D3PM实现FID-192从0.44/0.41降至0.09/0.10，最后以率失真-可建模性框架统一解释。
AI.motivation: 潜在医学图像生成器通常将tokenizer视为固定的预处理步骤，但这种分离假设的有效性未经严格检验。作者希望验证tokenizer、生成器和采样器之间的耦合关系，并寻找更可靠的下游生成质量选择标准（而非仅依赖重建PSNR）。
AI.method: 在64x64 ChestMNIST上设计受控交叉实验：离散tokenizer与生成器家族、采样器设置共享潜在网格，并以连续潜在为参考。引入邻居条件预测增益（neighbour-conditional predictive gain）作为生成器无关统计量；对LFQ-1024上的D3PM和SE-D3PM在验证集上重新调参。采用FID-192作为内部排名指标，并与FID-2048（Spearman 0.80）及无标签分类器双样本检验（0.78）验证一致性。
AI.result: (1) 排名取决于tokenizer、生成器和采样器的联合作用，最优量化器随生成器变化；(2) 跨三个种子重训后交互效应仍存在（9对量化器比较中6对超过三个种子标准差）；(3) 重建PSNR单独作为选择标准不可靠，邻居条件预测增益能以rank-AUC 1.00区分量化器家族；(4) 重调D3PM/SE-D3PM后FID-192从0.44/0.41降至0.09/0.10且种子间可复现。
AI.conclusion: tokenizer与下游生成器的解耦假设在受控条件下不成立，应通过率失真-可建模性框架理解三者（tokenizer、生成器、采样器）的联合影响；重建PSNR不是充分的评价标准，需引入生成器无关的下游质量统计量。所有结论限于64x64低分辨率医学风格图像的非临床评估场景。

title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
summary: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TdSciNER，一种类型驱动的科学命名实体识别方法，通过实体类型过滤模型、多任务学习辅助类型分类任务和基于句子相似度与实体类型多样性的演示选择策略，有效解决大型语言模型在面对过多候选实体类型时识别准确率下降的问题，在三个数据集上达到与全监督模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在科学命名实体识别中已展现出竞争力的性能，但科学文本的实体类型比通用领域更复杂，当提示词中提供过多候选实体类型时，LLM难以准确识别和标注实体。现有研究虽强调候选实体类型信息的重要性，但尚未解决类型数量过多带来的性能退化挑战。
AI.method: TdSciNER包含三个核心组件：(1)实体类型过滤模型，用于识别给定句子中最可能出现的实体类型；(2)多任务学习框架，引入辅助的多类别实体类型分类任务以获得更丰富的上下文表示；(3)基于句子相似度和实体类型多样性的新型演示选择策略，激活LLM的上下文学习能力。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了与全监督模型相当的性能。进一步的分析验证了TdSciNER中每个类型驱动组件都对SciNER性能的提升有所贡献。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为未来科学命名实体识别及更广泛的科学文本挖掘中信息抽取任务的改进提供了有价值的见解。

title: SurgLAT: Surgical Latent Attention Tracking for Depth-Aware Robotic Laparoscope Control
summary: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control requires continuous understanding of the surgeon's operative intent in dynamic surgical scenes, where the target operative region is not a stable physical object but a latent and temporally evolving attention state. In this work, we present Surgical Latent Attention Tracking (SurgLAT), a causal online framework for latent surgical attention modeling and autonomous laparoscopic view control. SurgLAT uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a state-conditioned spatial token mixer to extract operative evidence under a memory-guided spatial prior, while a selective causal latent memory module jointly models short-term motion continuity and long-horizon surgical intent evolution through dynamic retrieval of current, recent, and historical latent states. The learned latent surgical attention state is decoded into a probabilistic attention heatmap and operative region for downstream endoscope guidance. Beyond perception, we further introduce a robotic deployment framework with explicit laparoscopic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) constrained control based on virtual-axis formulation, together with redundancy-aware null-space initialization for stable and smooth manipulator motion. We validate the full system on real laparoscopic surgical videos and a physical robotic laparoscope platform. Experimental results demonstrate robust online operative-region tracking and stable autonomous endoscopy adjustment under occlusion, rapid motion, and target transitions, highlighting the effectiveness of latent surgical intent modeling for surgical autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurgLAT，一种用于自主腹腔镜相机控制的因果在线框架，通过冻结的DINOv3编码器和状态条件空间令牌混合器提取手术证据，使用选择性因果潜在记忆模块联合建模短期运动连续性和长期手术意图演变，将学习到的潜在手术注意力状态解码为概率注意力热图和手术区域；此外，引入基于虚拟轴公式的RCM约束控制和冗余感知零空间初始化的机器人部署框架，在真实手术视频和物理机器人平台上验证了系统在遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自主腹腔镜相机控制需要持续理解外科医生的手术意图，但目标手术区域并非稳定的物理对象，而是一种潜在且随时间演变的注意力状态。现有方法缺乏对这种动态潜在注意力的显式建模和在线跟踪能力。
AI.method: SurgLAT框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 使用冻结的DINOv3编码器和状态条件空间令牌混合器，在记忆引导的空间先验下提取手术证据；(2) 选择性因果潜在记忆模块，通过动态检索当前、近期和历史潜在状态，联合建模短时运动连续性与长期手术意图演变；(3) 将潜在手术注意力状态解码为概率注意力热图和手术区域用于内窥镜引导。同时提出基于虚拟轴的RCM约束控制及冗余感知零空间初始化的机器人部署框架。
AI.result: 在真实腹腔镜手术视频和物理机器人腹腔镜平台上验证，系统在遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换条件下实现了鲁棒的在线手术区域跟踪和稳定的自主内窥镜调整。
AI.conclusion: 潜在手术意图建模对手术机器人自主性具有显著有效性，SurgLAT为自主腹腔镜视野控制提供了一种从感知到机器人控制的端到端完整解决方案。

title: Vision Meets WiFi: Physics-Grounded Estimation of Volumetric Mechanical Properties
summary: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Existing approaches predict these properties independently across voxels, overlooking the piecewise-constant material structure of real objects and producing noisy or inconsistent estimates for voxels that share the same material, while lacking an explicit mechanism to resolve visual ambiguity. We introduce ViWi (Vision Meets WiFi), an object-centric framework for volumetric mechanical-property estimation. ViWi represents each object using a compact set of material slots that aggregate evidence from voxels with a shared material identity and produce coherent slot-level property predictions. To complement visual appearance, ViWi incorporates a compact RF descriptor generated through WiFi-band electromagnetic simulation using permittivity and conductivity. The RF descriptor conditions the material slots with global composition cues that may be unavailable from images, while visual features preserve voxel-level spatial localization. Across volumetric mechanical-property and mass-estimation benchmarks, ViWi improves over the prior state of the art on four of six per-voxel metrics, while its vision-only variant improves all mass-estimation metrics. These results demonstrate that combining object-centric material structure with complementary RF evidence enables more accurate and physically coherent volumetric property estimation beyond what is possible from visual appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViWi框架，通过材料槽（material slots）聚合同一材质体素的证据，并结合WiFi频段电磁仿真生成的RF描述符补充视觉信息，实现更准确且物理一致的体素级机械属性估计。
AI.motivation: 仅从视觉估计每个体素的体积力学属性（杨氏模量、泊松比、密度）本质上是病态的，因为视觉相似物体可能具有完全不同的材料组成和物理行为。现有方法独立预测各体素属性，忽视了真实物体分段恒定的材料结构，产生噪声大、不一致的估计，且缺乏显式机制解决视觉歧义。
AI.method: ViWi采用物体中心框架，使用一组紧凑的材料槽表示每个物体，通过共享材料身份的体素聚合证据，产生连贯的槽级属性预测。同时引入由介电常数和电导率经WiFi频段电磁仿真生成的紧凑RF描述符，条件化材料槽提供图像中可能不可得的全局组成线索，而视觉特征保留体素级的空间定位。
AI.result: 在体积力学属性和质量估计基准上，ViWi在六项体素级指标中的四项优于此前最先进方法，其仅视觉变体改进了所有质量估计指标。
AI.conclusion: 将物体中心的材料结构与互补的RF证据相结合，能够实现比仅依靠视觉外观更准确、物理更一致的体积属性估计。

title: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in Large Language Models: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism
summary: Mixture-of-Experts models increase parameter capacity while keeping the computation activated by each token bounded, but their architectural evolution cannot be explained by a chronological list of model releases alone. This technical survey synthesizes primary papers, official technical reports, and prior surveys to organize modern Mixture-of-Experts systems along five coupled dimensions: expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, the scope of load balancing, and execution structure. We describe eight architectural milestones as a dependency graph with six mainline developments and two orthogonal branches, rather than as eight successive generations. We then analyze individual systems through four control planes: Expert Topology, Routing, Balance, and Expert Parallelism. These planes specify which experts exist, which experts process each token, how aggregate load is controlled, and how selected computation is mapped onto physical devices. The framework connects algorithmic choices such as Top-k routing, shared experts, fine-grained experts, and dynamic expert composition with systems concerns including token dispatch, device placement, all-to-all communication, and communication-computation overlap. We conclude with equal-budget pretraining experiments, quality and systems metrics, and open research questions. The main trend is a shift from merely activating more sparse parameters toward decoupling semantic routing, computational budgets, and physical execution.

AI.tldr: 本文对现代Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）系统进行技术调研，提出了一个五维耦合分析框架（专家粒度、专家拓扑、路由自由度、负载均衡范围和执行结构），并将八个架构里程碑组织为依赖图而非年代顺序列表。论文通过四个控制平面（专家拓扑、路由、均衡、专家并行）分析各系统，揭示出从激活更多稀疏参数向语义路由、计算预算和物理执行解耦转变的主要趋势。
AI.motivation: MoE模型通过增加参数容量同时保持计算开销可控来提升模型能力，但其架构演化无法仅靠时间顺序的模型发布列表来理解，需要一个系统化的分析框架来组织、比较和解释MoE系统之间的架构差异与发展脉络。
AI.method: 论文综合了主要论文、官方技术报告和先前调研，提出五维耦合维度（专家粒度、专家拓扑、路由自由度、负载均衡范围、执行结构）描述MoE系统；将八个架构里程碑组织为一个依赖图（六条主线发展加两条正交分支）；通过四个控制平面（专家拓扑、路由、均衡、专家并行）对个体系统进行分析，连接算法选择（Top-k路由、共享专家、细粒度专家、动态专家组合）与系统关注点（令牌派发、设备放置、全对全通信、通信计算重叠）。
AI.result: 论文构建了一个统一的MoE分析框架，揭示MoE架构演化的核心趋势是从"激活更多稀疏参数"转向"解耦语义路由、计算预算和物理执行"。论文以等预算预训练实验、质量与系统指标以及开放研究问题作为结论支撑。
AI.conclusion: MoE系统设计的核心趋势是语义路由、计算预算与物理执行三者逐步解耦。这种解耦使得MoE架构不再仅是稀疏参数激活的手段，而是成为一种更灵活的资源调配和语义路由机制，为后续研究指明了方向。

title: GRACE: LLM-Grounded Semantic Metric Spaces for Scalable Mixed-Data Clustering
summary: Clustering mixed tabular data requires a unified metric space to bridge the inherent heterogeneity between continuous numerical measurements and discrete categorical symbols. Traditionally, algorithms rely entirely on dataset-internal statistics to estimate categorical relationships, which confines the learned metric to empirical co-occurrences and ignores conceptually obvious yet statistically unobserved affinities. Although LLMs offer external world knowledge, applying their text-centric reasoning to highly abstract tabular concepts presents significant challenges. Bridging this modality gap to construct a semantically complete metric typically requires embedding LLMs into iterative metric learning loops to dynamically optimize cross-modality representations. This incurs intractable computational overhead, forcing a compromise between semantic enrichment and scalability. Therefore, we propose GRACE, an LLM-grounded framework for scalable mixed-data clustering. GRACE shifts semantic acquisition to the attribute-value level via a multi-perspective LLM querying strategy, mapping heterogeneous values into knowledge-informed descriptions. Crucially, this one-shot grounding extracts general-purpose semantic representations that embed heterogeneous attributes into a unified space, decoupling expensive LLM invocation from iterative optimization. Furthermore, GRACE cross-validates these external semantics against dataset-internal statistical evidence to ensure alignment with the dataset-specific cluster structure. Ultimately, GRACE matches the scalability of conventional statistics-driven baselines while achieving superior clustering accuracy and conceptual interpretability over 11 competing methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A

AI.tldr: GRACE是一个基于LLM的混合表格数据聚类框架，通过属性-值级别的多视角LLM查询将异构值映射为知识驱动的描述，一次性地提取通用语义表示并将异构属性嵌入统一空间，同时用数据内部统计证据交叉验证外部语义，在保持传统方法可扩展性的同时取得更优的聚类精度和概念可解释性。
AI.motivation: 混合表格数据聚类需要统一度量空间来弥合数值与类别属性之间的异质性。传统方法仅依赖数据集内部统计估计类别关系，忽略了概念上明显但统计上未观察到的语义亲和性；虽然LLM能提供外部世界知识，但将其文本中心的推理应用于抽象表格概念存在模态鸿沟，且嵌入迭代度量学习循环会带来难以承受的计算开销，迫使在语义富集与可扩展性之间取舍。
AI.method: GRACE通过多视角LLM查询策略在属性-值级别获取语义，将异构值映射为知识驱动的描述；通过一次性grounding提取通用语义表示，将异构属性嵌入统一空间，从而将昂贵的LLM调用与迭代优化解耦；并通过外部语义与数据集内部统计证据的交叉验证，确保语义与数据特定簇结构对齐。
AI.result: 在与11种竞争方法的对比中，GRACE取得了更优的聚类精度和概念可解释性，同时匹配传统统计驱动基线的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GRACE验证了在属性-值级别进行一次性LLM语义获取能够有效弥合混合数据的异构性鸿沟，在不牺牲可扩展性的前提下实现语义增强的聚类，为LLM在表格数据领域的应用提供了可行范式。

title: Ghost Features and Spooky Transfer Learning for Hypercomplex-Valued Neural Networks
comment: 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026)
summary: Hypercomplex numbers extend the concept of complex numbers by introducing additional imaginary components. Besides increasing dimensionality, operations on the imaginary parts provide algebraic and geometrical properties that can be beneficial for solving machine learning problems. In this paper, we show how to create hypercomplex-valued neural network layers where the real part corresponds to the output of a traditional real-valued layer. The additional imaginary parts of these hypercomplex-valued layers produce what we call ``ghost features,'' which contain enhanced information that is not present in the output of the real-valued layer. Moreover, ghost features can be effectively integrated into a trained neural network through a process we refer to as ``spooky transfer learning.'' This approach allows us to harness the richness of ghost features, leading to more efficient neural networks. The source code and Jupyter Notebook are available at https://github.com/mevalle/v-nets/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将超复数（hypercomplex）神经网络层中的虚部输出作为"鬼影特征"（ghost features），并引入"幽灵迁移学习"（spooky transfer learning）方法，在不增加额外推理成本的前提下利用这些增强特征提升神经网络效率。
AI.motivation: 超复数通过引入额外的虚部成分，不仅增加了维度，还为机器学习问题提供了有用的代数和几何性质。作者希望利用超复数层的虚部所编码的增强信息来提升传统实值神经网络的表现，而不显著增加计算负担。
AI.method: 作者构建了超复数神经网络层，其设计使得实部输出等价于传统实值层的输出，而额外的虚部则产生富含增强信息的"鬼影特征"。同时提出"幽灵迁移学习"流程，将预训练网络中的鬼影特征有效集成到网络中，以提升网络效率。
AI.result: 鬼影特征携带了实值层输出中不存在的增强信息，通过幽灵迁移学习可以将其融入已训练的网络，从而获得更高效的神经网络模型。代码与Jupyter Notebook已开源。
AI.conclusion: 超复数层的虚部产生的鬼影特征能有效增强神经网络的信息表达能力，幽灵迁移学习为利用这些特征提供了可行途径，最终实现更高效的神经网络。

title: LibraSpec: Dynamic Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding via Marginal-Gain-Driven Optimization
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens for parallel verification, with efficiency critically determined by the speculative length selected at each decoding round. Existing dynamic speculation methods select the speculation length by estimating how many tokens will be accepted, which is reasonable for autoregressive drafters that generates tokens sequentially. The recent wave of diffusion-based drafters, however, generates candidate blocks in parallel at substantially lower drafting cost, shifting the key question from how many tokens to generate to how many generated tokens are worth verifying. We therefore reformulate dynamic speculative-length selection as expected-speedup optimization and derive a marginal criterion that extends the speculative sequence only when its acceptance gain outweighs the additional verification cost. Building on this criterion, we develop \textit{LibraSpec}, a training-free and plug-and-play algorithm that iteratively determines the speculative length using drafter confidence scores. Theoretically, we prove that LibraSpec monotonically converges toward the optimal speculative length. Experiments across six target models, three diffusion-based speculative decoding methods, and math, coding, and chat benchmarks show consistent improvements under both greedy and sampling settings, achieving a further $0.5\sim1.5\times$ improvement over baselines and up to $8.49\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出LibraSpec，一种训练无关、即插即用的动态投机解码长度选择算法，通过将投机长度选择重构为期望加速比优化问题并推导边际判据，利用扩散模型草稿器的置信度分数迭代确定最优投机长度。在6个目标模型、3种扩散式投机解码方法上，相比基线获得0.5~1.5倍的额外加速，相较自回归解码最高获得8.49倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有动态投机解码方法通过估计将被接受的token数量来选择投机长度，这适用于顺序生成token的自回归草稿器。然而扩散式草稿器以显著更低的成本并行生成候选块，关键问题从"生成多少个token"转变为"生成多少个token值得验证"。因此需要重新设计针对扩散式草稿器的投机长度选择策略。
AI.method: 将动态投机长度选择重构为期望加速比优化问题，推导出边际判据：仅当接收增益超过额外验证成本时才扩展投机序列。基于此判据开发LibraSpec算法，利用草稿器的置信度分数迭代确定投机长度，无需训练且即插即用。理论上证明了LibraSpec单调收敛于最优投机长度。
AI.result: 在6个目标模型、3种扩散式投机解码方法以及数学、代码和聊天基准上，在贪婪采样和采样设置下均取得一致改进，较基线进一步获得0.5~1.5倍加速，较自回归解码最高获得8.49倍加速。
AI.conclusion: LibraSpec通过重构投机长度选择为期望加速比优化问题，有效适配了扩散式草稿器的并行生成特性，实现了理论上收敛保证和实际上的显著性能提升，是一种实用的训练无关加速方案。

title: Reason Wide, Not Deep: Amortizing the Reasoning Premium into Distilled Skills
summary: Reasoning modes of language models outperform their non-reasoning counterparts on multi-step agentic tasks, but pay a 3-6x premium in output tokens on every episode -- much of it spent re-deriving procedures that are shared across episodes of the same domain. We show this recurring cost can be amortized: a coding agent analyses a small corpus of existing trajectories from a training split and compiles a compact natural-language skill that is injected into the non-reasoning model's system prompt. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, tau$^2$-bench telecom and retail, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), skills recover 55%-100%+ of the reasoning gap for GPT-5.4-mini on held-out tasks -- exceeding the reasoning mode outright on two of four -- while emitting 2.7-6x fewer output tokens and zero reasoning tokens. Notably, reasoning traces are not a prerequisite: skills distilled from non-reasoning trajectories alone remain competitive with skills distilled from paired reasoning/non-reasoning corpora, with domain-dependent differences between the two sources. We interpret these results through a search lens: test-time reasoning is deep search inside a single episode, re-paid at every deployment, while corpus distillation is wide search across episodes, paid once. The two recover overlapping procedural knowledge, and width over cheap trajectories is often the better buy -- with the residual gap on some domains (telecom, SpreadsheetBench) delineating where genuinely per-instance deep search remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种技能蒸馏方法，通过让编码智能体从已有轨迹中提取紧凑的自然语言技能并注入非推理模型的系统提示中，从而在多个智能体基准上恢复55%-100%+的推理差距，同时将输出token减少2.7-6倍。
AI.motivation: 推理模式的语言模型在多步智能体任务上表现优于非推理模式，但每个回合需支付3-6倍的输出token开销，其中大量token浪费在跨回合重复推导相同程序上。作者希望摊销这一重复成本。
AI.method: 利用编码智能体分析训练子集上现有轨迹的小规模语料，编译出紧凑的自然语言技能，并将其注入非推理模型的系统提示中。该框架在多个基准上评估，还比较了从推理轨迹与非推理轨迹蒸馏技能的效果，并通过搜索视角解释结果。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、tau²-bench（电信和零售）和SpreadsheetBench-Verified四个基准上，技能恢复GPT-5.4-mini推理差距的55%-100%+，在四个基准中的两个上超过了推理模式，同时输出token减少2.7-6倍且零推理token。从纯非推理轨迹蒸馏的技能与从配对推理/非推理语料蒸馏的技能表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过搜索视角来看，测试时推理是单回合内的深度搜索，每次部署都要重新付费；而语料蒸馏是跨回合的广度搜索，只需一次付费。两者恢复的是重叠的程序性知识，在大多数情况下基于廉价轨迹做广度搜索更划算，但在部分领域（如电信、SpreadsheetBench）仍存在剩余差距，说明这些场景确实需要逐实例的深度搜索。

title: BRUCE: Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation for Scientific Vision-Language Reasoning
summary:
Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. In this paper, we aim at analyzing VLMs' robustness by applying perturbations and distortions to the input images, such as blur or low contrast. Toward this goal, we propose BRUCE (Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation, a multimodal reasoning fragility framework for scientific vision-language reasoning.
  State-of-the-art evaluation frameworks/studies primarily focus on clean-task accuracy and rarely analyze how reasoning stability degrades across robustness dimensions. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. We evaluate BRUCE across chemistry and mathematical reasoning tasks for multiple datasets, while analyzing corruption-induced prediction failures in terms of four high-level reasoning domains: OCR-dependent reasoning, spatial reasoning, symbolic reasoning, and semantic failures, with each containing fine-grained corruption specific failure subtypes, thereby enabling an interpretable failure analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出BRUCE基准框架，通过逐步施加视觉扰动（如模糊、低对比度）来评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多模态科学推理任务中的鲁棒性，并引入RCI和T-RCI两个新指标量化推理性能随扰动严重度增加的退化速度，同时在化学和数学推理任务上提供可解释的失败分析。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评估框架主要关注干净任务上的准确率，很少分析推理稳定性在不同鲁棒性维度上的退化情况，导致对VLM在真实世界中遇到低质量或变化质量输入图像时的鲁棒性问题缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 提出BRUCE（Benchmarking Robustness Under Corruption Escalation）多模态推理脆弱性框架：对输入图像施加广泛范围的扰动和畸变（如模糊、低对比度），采用渐进式扰动缩放；引入两个新指标——Robustness Corruption Index (RCI)和Traversal-RCI (T-RCI)来量化推理性能随扰动严重度增加的退化速率；在化学和数学推理任务的多个数据集上评估，并将扰动引发的预测失败分为四类高层推理域（OCR依赖推理、空间推理、符号推理、语义失败），每个域包含细粒度的失败子类型。
AI.result: 在化学和数学推理任务的多个数据集上完成BRUCE基准评估，实现了对VLM在渐进扰动下推理退化速率的量化，并通过四类推理域及其细粒度失败子类型提供了可解释的失败分析。
AI.conclusion: BRUCE填补了VLM鲁棒性评估中缺乏系统性推理稳定性分析的空白，通过RCI和T-RCI指标以及分层失败归因框架，为科学视觉-语言推理任务中的鲁棒性评估提供了更全面的方法论。

title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
comment: 13 Pages, 6 Figures, Submitted to ARR Cycle
summary: The carbon footprint of any deployed Large Language Model (LLM) accumulates during inference, where repeated use of the model substantially exceeds the one-time cost of fine-tuning. Yet most efficiency interventions target either pre-training scale or post-hoc compression. We ask whether folding a calibrated, differentiable energy surrogate into the fine-tuning objective can produce inference behavior that gains task accuracy at zero or near-zero carbon cost, a break-even configuration. We propose a joint loss mechanism with a per-model carbon-emission parameter, a linear surrogate over parameter norm, FLOP proxy, and a memory proxy, fit from on-hardware energy profiling. We fine-tune three architecturally distinct families: Gemma-2 2B, Llama-3.1 8B, and Qwen-2.5 14B, and evaluate inference F1 and CO$_2$ emissions on three MMLU subjects: abstract algebra, philosophy, and formal logic. We discover from several outcomes that the carbon term behaves as either harmful interference or beneficial regularization depending on the task structure. We position calibrated carbon-aware fine-tuning as a lightweight, drop-in regularizer with a non-empty but model and task-dependent break-even region. This is an ongoing work, and we will release our codebase soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种碳感知微调方法，将可微分的能耗代理（基于参数范数、FLOP代理和内存代理的线性组合）折叠进微调目标函数中，以在零或近零碳成本下提升推理任务准确率。在Gemma-2 2B、Llama-3.1 8B和Qwen-2.5 14B三种架构上、以及MMLU的三个子科目上评估后发现：碳项的行为取决于任务结构——要么是有害干扰，要么是有益正则化。该方法定位为轻量级、即插即用的正则化器，存在非空但依赖模型和任务的盈亏平衡区域。
AI.motivation: LLM的碳足迹在推理阶段持续累积，远超一次性微调成本。然而现有效率优化大多针对预训练规模或事后压缩，忽略了推理阶段的能耗。作者希望探索能否通过将校准的可微能耗代理嵌入微调目标，在零或近零碳成本下获得任务准确率的提升，实现"盈亏平衡"配置。
AI.method: 提出联合损失机制，包含逐模型碳排放参数、参数范数线性代理、FLOP代理和内存代理，代理系数通过硬件能耗画像拟合。微调三个架构族（Gemma-2 2B、Llama-3.1 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B），在MMLU的抽象代数、哲学和形式逻辑三个子科目上评估推理F1和CO₂排放。
AI.result: 发现碳项在不同任务结构下呈现两种截然不同的行为：作为有害干扰或作为有益正则化。碳感知微调存在非空的盈亏平衡区域，但该区域高度依赖具体模型和任务的组合。
AI.conclusion: 碳感知微调可作为一种轻量级、即插即用的正则化器使用，能够在不带来额外碳成本的前提下改善推理性能，但其有效性受模型和任务结构影响，并非普遍适用。目前为进行中工作，代码即将开源。

title: TelemetrySuffBench: Is Agent Telemetry Sufficient for Failure-Origin Diagnosis?
summary: Agent systems increasingly expose execution traces, yet telemetry that reveals a failure may still be inadequate for identifying where that failure originated. We introduce TelemetrySuffBench, a controlled benchmark that separates failure detection, fault-origin localization, and safe abstention under insufficient evidence. The benchmark constructs canonical multi-component traces with delayed-binding faults and renders them as paired coarse views, seven-factor telemetry masks, and exact-equal ambiguous origin pairs. We evaluate five frontier language models using unified protocols, explicit candidate sets, invalid-output accounting, subgroup analyses, and a frozen blind holdout. With full telemetry, origin-step Top-1 accuracy ranges from 33.8% to 97.2% across models. Metadata, OpenTelemetry-compatible, and OpenInference-compatible views retain 99.5% to 100% detection F1 while limiting origin-step accuracy to at most 0.5%, exposing a robust detection-localization gap. Factor ablations further show that removing decision content reduces origin-step accuracy to zero for every model, while provenance removal also causes large model-dependent losses. On rich ambiguous inputs that require abstention, evidence gating reduces unsupported unique-origin answers by 12.5 to 48.6 percentage points for three models, whereas two models still answer every case, revealing strong model dependence in safe abstention. Results on the frozen holdout reproduce the central pattern within the same generator family. These findings show that terminal status can support detection, whereas reliable causal attribution requires explicit decision-to-provenance links and abstention safeguards that remain effective across models. The dataset and benchmark implementation are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TelemetrySuffBench-E635/README.md.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TelemetrySuffBench基准，用于分离遥测故障检测、故障根源定位和证据不足时的安全弃权三个任务。通过构造多组件延迟绑定故障轨迹并渲染为七因子遥测掩码，测评五个前沿语言模型后发现：故障检测F1可接近100%，但根源定位精度最高仅0.5%（暴露检测-定位差距）；移除决策内容使定位精度归零；三个模型在证据门控下弃权效果提升12.5-48.6个百分点，而两个模型仍回答所有情况。结果表明终端状态足以支持检测，但可靠因果归因需显式决策-来源链接和安全弃权保障。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统暴露的执行轨迹日益增多，但遥测数据虽能揭示故障发生，却无法有效定位故障源头。现有系统缺乏一个受控基准来严格区分故障检测、故障来源定位和证据不足时的安全弃权这三个本质上不同的任务，导致模型能力被混为一谈。
AI.method: 构建TelemetrySuffBench可控基准：(1)构造带延迟绑定故障的规范多组件轨迹；(2)渲染为配对粗视图、七因子遥测掩码和精确等同的模糊来源对；(3)用统一协议、显式候选集、无效输出核算和子组分析评估五个前沿语言模型；(4)设置冻结盲留出集验证泛化性。
AI.result: 全遥测下来源步骤Top-1准确率在33.8%至97.2%之间；元数据、OpenTelemetry和OpenInference兼容视图保留99.5%-100%检测F1但来源定位精度至多0.5%，暴露稳健的检测-定位差距。因子消融显示移除决策内容使所有模型来源定位精度归零；移除溯源导致大幅模型依赖损失。证据门控使三个模型的不受支持唯一来源答案减少12.5-48.6个百分点，但两个模型仍回答每个案例。冻结留出集复现了同生成器家族内的核心模式。
AI.conclusion: 终端状态（如最终错误标记）足以支撑故障检测，但可靠因果归因必须依赖显式决策-溯源链接；安全弃权机制在模型间存在强烈差异，需设计跨模型有效的保障；检测、定位与弃权应作为独立的评估维度。

title: LoRSA: Toward Generalizable Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Biomedical Downstream Tasks
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. This restriction may prevent the model from simultaneously representing globally shared task structure and localized residual directions required for generalization to unseen imaging domains. We introduce LoRSA, a global--residual adaptation framework that jointly learns a dense low-rank component and a dynamically structured-sparse low-rank component. The dense component captures globally coordinated task adaptation, while the structured component provides complementary residual corrections whose support evolves during training. We characterize the representational capacity, approximation properties, rank structure, and singular-subspace complementarity of this decomposition. We evaluate LoRSA for four-class breast-density classification using DINOv3-Base, with VinDr-Mammo as the source domain and MammosighTR and RSNA as unseen external domains. LoRSA remains competitive on the internal validation set and achieves the best external macro-F1 on both target datasets, improving upon the strongest competing method by 2.15 percentage points on MammosighTR and 3.09 percentage points on RSNA. Weight-matrix analysis further shows that approximately $92\%$ of the energy of each adaptation component lies outside the bilateral singular subspace of the other, indicating that the two components learn largely complementary update directions. These results suggest that organizing adaptation capacity into distinct global and residual paths can improve the external-domain generalization of parameter-efficiently adapted biomedical vision models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoRSA框架，通过联合学习一个稠密低秩组件和一个动态结构化稀疏低秩组件，分别捕获全局协调的任务适配和局部残差修正，从而提升参数高效微调下视觉基础模型在生物医学任务中的跨域泛化能力。在乳腺密度分类任务上，LoRSA在内部验证集保持竞争力的同时，在两个外部未见域上分别超过最强基线2.15和3.09个百分点。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调（PEFT）虽能在有限计算资源下适配视觉基础模型到生物医学任务，但单一低秩更新将任务特定变化限制在狭窄的参数子空间中，无法同时表示全局共享的任务结构和局部残差方向，从而限制了模型对未见成像域的泛化能力。
AI.method: LoRSA采用全局-残差两分支适配框架：一个稠密低秩组件捕获全局协调的任务适配，一个动态结构化稀疏低秩组件提供互补的残差修正，其支持集在训练过程中自适应演化。文章还对该分解的表示容量、逼近性质、秩结构和奇异子空间互补性进行了理论刻画。
AI.result: 在四类乳腺密度分类任务（DINOv3-Base, VinDr-Mammo为源域，MammosighTR和RSNA为外部未见域）上，LoRSA在内部验证集上与基线相当，并在两个外部目标域上取得最佳macro-F1，分别领先最强竞争方法2.15和3.09个百分点。权重矩阵分析显示约92%的每个适配组件能量位于另一组件的双边奇异子空间之外，证实两个组件学习到高度互补的更新方向。
AI.conclusion: 将适配能力组织为全局路径和残差路径两个独立通道，可以显著提升参数高效适配的生物医学视觉模型在外部域的泛化性能，为PEFT在跨域生物医学场景中的应用提供了新的设计范式。

title: Multilingual Emotion Neurons in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Emotion is central to human communication, and its expression varies across languages. Large audio-language models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on multilingual speech tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they encode emotion through language-specific correlations or language-agnostic representations. We present the first neuron-level interpretability study of this question. We define Multilingual Emotion Neurons (MLENs) as functional units exhibiting stable emotional selectivity and aligned causal effects across languages, and introduce Consistency-Regularized Fusion (CR-Fusion) to identify them. Across four modern LALMs and 12 typologically diverse languages, emotion-sensitive neurons identified independently per language show minimal overlap, and additional monolingual identification data saturates quickly without isolating more transferable units, motivating identification from pooled cross-lingual evidence. Causal interventions demonstrate that MLENs identified by CR-Fusion provide more precise and transferable affective control than monolingual neuron sets in both zero-shot and low-resource settings. Leave-one-out ablations further reveal asymmetric transfer: individual identification languages, including low-resource ones, contribute non-redundant evidence, while several low-resource languages benefit most from the resulting cross-lingual transfer. Together, our findings provide the first causal, neuron-level account of how LALMs encode emotion across languages, and establish multilingual neuron identification as an effective mechanism for understanding cross-lingual affective behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在神经元层面研究了大型音频语言模型（LALMs）如何跨语言编码情感。作者提出了多语言情感神经元（MLENs）的概念，并引入一致性正则化融合（CR-Fusion）方法来识别这些跨语言稳定且具有对齐因果效应的功能单元。实验表明，CR-Fusion识别的MLENs在零样本和低资源场景下比单语言神经元集提供更精确、更具迁移性的情感控制，并揭示了低资源语言对跨语言迁移的非冗余贡献。
AI.motivation: 情感在人类交流中至关重要，但不同语言中情感的表达方式存在差异。尽管大型音频语言模型在多语言语音任务中表现优异，但它们在跨语言中编码情感的方式尚不明确——是通过语言特定的相关性还是语言无关的表征。理解这一问题对于构建更具可解释性和泛化能力的情感识别系统至关重要。
AI.method: 作者首先定义多语言情感神经元（MLENs）为具有跨语言稳定情感选择性和对齐因果效应的功能单元。然后提出一致性正则化融合（CR-Fusion）方法，从跨语言合并的证据中识别这些神经元。实验涉及四个现代LALMs和12种类型多样的语言，通过因果干预和留一法消融分析验证方法的有效性。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）各语言独立识别的情感敏感神经元重叠极小，且单语言识别数据增加很快饱和；2）CR-Fusion识别的MLENs在零样本和低资源场景中提供更精确、更可迁移的情感控制；3）留一法消融显示迁移是不对称的，各识别语言（包括低资源语言）贡献非冗余证据，而多个低资源语言从跨语言迁移中获益最大。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次提供了LALMs跨语言情感编码的因果性神经元级解释，并确立了多语言神经元识别作为理解跨语言情感行为的有效机制。

title: GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning
summary: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating planning hallucinations. Furthermore, within the GRPO framework, the task graph offers delicate reward design to train the LLM planner, enhancing long-horizon planning capabilities and improving generalization. Finally, an event-driven replanning module, powered by the scene graph, enables closed-loop environment awareness and error correction. GraphThink achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ALFRED benchmark. In particular, our high-level planner surpasses leading API-based LLMs on both the validation set and held-out long-horizon tasks, underscoring its robust zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. Additional evaluations further demonstrate strong out-of-distribution generalization to novel tasks and environments.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphThink框架，将任务图（task graph）和场景图（scene graph）引入LLM-based具身智能体，通过上下文提示、GRPO奖励设计和事件驱动重规划解决物理幻觉、长时程任务泛化差和环境感知缺失问题，在ALFRED基准上达到SOTA，超越API-based LLM。
AI.motivation: LLM-based具身智能体在使用规划器时面临三大核心问题：物理幻觉（physical hallucinations）、长时程任务泛化能力差、缺乏环境感知。这些缺陷严重制约了具身智能体在真实和复杂环境中的可靠性与实用性。
AI.method: GraphThink通过集成两类图结构来增强LLM规划能力：1）任务图（task graph）提供结构化知识，通过上下文提示（contextual prompting）和迭代精炼引导LLM推理，缓解规划幻觉；2）在GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）框架下，任务图提供细粒度的奖励设计来训练LLM规划器，提升长时程规划能力和泛化性；3）场景图（scene graph）驱动的event-driven重规划模块实现闭环环境感知和错误修正。
AI.result: 在ALFRED基准上取得SOTA性能。所提出的高层规划器在验证集和held-out长时程任务上均超越领先的API-based LLM，展现出强大的zero-shot和few-shot能力。额外评估进一步验证了在novel任务和环境上的强OOD泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphThink通过任务图+场景图的双图结构设计，系统性地解决了LLM具身规划中的幻觉、长时程泛化和环境感知问题，证明了结构化知识注入与强化学习训练相结合的有效性，并具有良好的分布外泛化能力。

title: Multi-Task Consistency-based Detection of Adversarial Attacks
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have found successful deployment in numerous vision perception systems. However, their susceptibility to adversarial attacks has prompted concerns regarding their practical applications, specifically in the context of autonomous driving. Existing defenses often suffer from cost inefficiency, rendering their deployment impractical for resource-constrained applications. In this work, we propose an efficient and effective adversarial attack detection scheme leveraging the multi-task perception within a complex vision system. Adversarial perturbations are detected by the inconsistencies between the inference outputs of multiple vision tasks, e.g., object detection and instance segmentation. To this end, we developed a consistency score metric to measure the inconsistency between vision tasks. Next, we designed an approach to select the best model pairs for detecting inconsistencies effectively. Finally, we evaluated our defense against PGD attacks across multiple vision models on the BDD100k validation dataset. The experimental results demonstrated that our defense achieved a ROC-AUC performance of 99.9% detection within the considered attacker model.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用多任务感知一致性来检测对抗攻击的方案，通过衡量目标检测与实例分割等视觉任务输出之间的不一致性来识别对抗扰动，在BDD100k上对PGD攻击实现了99.9%的ROC-AUC检测性能。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉感知系统中广泛应用，但易受对抗攻击影响，尤其在自动驾驶场景中威胁显著。现有防御方法成本高昂，难以部署在资源受限的应用中，亟需一种高效且有效的对抗攻击检测方案。
AI.method: 利用复杂视觉系统中的多任务感知特性进行对抗攻击检测。具体包括：(1) 开发一致性评分指标来量化多个视觉任务（如目标检测与实例分割）推理输出之间的不一致性；(2) 设计模型对选择方法，以选取最佳任务模型对来有效检测不一致性；(3) 在BDD100k验证集上对多种视觉模型进行PGD攻击下的评估。
AI.result: 在考虑的对抗攻击者模型下，所提出的防御方案在BDD100k验证数据集上实现了99.9%的ROC-AUC检测性能，证明了基于多任务一致性检测对抗攻击的高效性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于多任务感知一致性的对抗攻击检测方案能够以高效的成本实现对PGD攻击的可靠检测，为资源受限的自动驾驶等实际应用提供了一种可行的防御思路。

title: OmnilingualGAIA2: Evaluating the Multilingual Gap in Frontier AI Agents
summary: Agentic benchmarks aim to measure how well AI agents plan, search, execute, and recover within realistic multi-tool environments, but they are almost exclusively in English. As AI agents are globally deployed to a linguistically diverse user base, whether agentic competence measured in English transfers to other languages remains an open question. We introduce OmnilingualGAIA2, a machine-translated expansion (with partial human- expert validation) of the GAIA2 agentic benchmark, covering ten target languages spanning five writing systems, paired with a localised and human-calibrated multilingual verifier. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight agents, we find a universal cross-lingual gap of 8.8-18.4 pass@3 points that is agent-asymmetric in magnitude, concentrates on tool-orchestration rather than quantitative reasoning, and does not close with model scale. A stratified error attribution decomposes the gap as predominantly model-driven (55%), with a bounded translation-contamination floor of only 6.4% of scenario-language pairs. Human-expert linguistic analysis further identifies morphological cue loss and amplified ambiguity as the primary failure mechanisms in non-Latin-script languages. Our results argue that multilingual agentic evaluation must become a standard part of the reporting protocol for globally deployed agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OmnilingualGAIA2，将GAIA2智能体基准通过机器翻译扩展至10种覆盖5种书写系统的目标语言，并配备本地化且人工校准的多语言验证器。在7个前沿及开源智能体上的评估显示存在普遍的跨语言性能差距（8.8-18.4 pass@3分），该差距具有智能体不对称性、集中于工具编排而非量化推理、且不随模型规模缩小。误差归因显示差距主要由模型驱动（55%），翻译污染下限仅为6.4%。人工语言学分析识别出形态线索丢失和歧义放大是非拉丁文字语言的主要失败机制。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准（如GAIA2）几乎完全以英语构建，而AI智能体正被部署到全球多种语言用户群体中。英语环境下测得的智能体能力是否能够迁移到其他语言仍然是一个未解问题，这直接关系到多语言场景下智能体评估的有效性与公平性。
AI.method: 将GAIA2智能体基准通过机器翻译扩展至10种目标语言（覆盖5种书写系统），辅以部分人类专家验证；构建本地化且经人工校准的多语言验证器；在7个前沿和开源权重智能体上进行系统评估；采用分层误差归因（stratifed error attribution）将差距分解为模型驱动与翻译污染两部分；结合人类专家语言分析识别具体失败机制。
AI.result: 发现所有智能体均存在8.8-18.4 pass@3的跨语言差距，且该差距在不同智能体间不对称；差距主要集中于工具编排任务而非量化推理；模型规模增大并不能缩小该差距。误差归因表明约55%的差距源于模型本身，翻译污染下限仅为6.4%的场景-语言对。非拉丁文字语言的主要失败机制是形态线索丢失和歧义放大。
AI.conclusion: 多语言智能体评估必须成为全球部署智能体的标准报告协议的一部分。仅依赖英语基准会显著高估智能体在非英语用户场景中的真实能力，且该问题无法通过简单地增加模型规模来解决。

title: When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits
summary: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. Frozen calibration efficacy predicts held-out power curves, with R^2 = 0.83-0.98 across six exact-permutation channels, but the efficacy-only Gaussian budget is miscalibrated at the small sample sizes it prescribes, failing in 9/9 gate-passing channels even though efficacy itself transports. The failure is in the inversion, not the calibration. A predeclared two-stage planner that simulates the deployed test repairs the budgets, is uniformly conservative, and abstains when its probe does not transport. The certificate is valid but vacuous at audit scale, and a five-seed paired injection study recovers the mechanism ordering verbatim > paraphrase > surface, in which the apparent answer-only signal is explained by baseline drift. We report the audit contract and its failures together: a non-rejection is interpretable only alongside the efficacy, budget, and validity gates that produced it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对行为污染检测中"无证据"无法区分"基准干净"与"审计功效不足"的问题，提出基于二阶矩的形式化框架，证明可检测性由 alpha*rho*sqrt(m) 决定，并引入功效（efficacy）作为标量检测器的理论上限。实证发现校准功效可预测验证集功效曲线（R²=0.83-0.98），但功效-高斯预算在小样本下失准（9/9通道失败），修复方案为两阶段预声明规划器。证书有效但审计规模下空洞，注入研究恢复机制排序：逐字>释义>表面。
AI.motivation: 行为污染检测器返回"无证据"时，无法判断是因为基准确实干净还是审计统计功效不足。这种二义性使得负结果在科学上不可解释，论文旨在形式化区分这两种情形，并为审计报告提供可验证的功效与有效性门控。
AI.method: (1) 用稀疏混合 Q_alpha=(1-alpha)P_0+alpha P_1 建模含未知污染比例 alpha 的基准；(2) 通过精确二阶矩论证证明可检测性由 alpha*rho*sqrt(m) 决定，其中 rho^2=chi^2(P_1||P_0)；(3) 证明任意标量检测器功效受 ef<=rho 约束且可在审计前从对照组估计；(4) 提出样本分割证书对 alpha 进行分布自由的置信下界；(5) 提出两阶段预声明规划器，通过模拟部署测试修复预算失准问题；(6) 使用五种子配对注入研究验证机制排序。
AI.result: 校准功效预测留出集功效曲线（跨六个精确置换通道 R²=0.83-0.98）；功效本身可迁移，但功效-高斯预算在小样本下失准，在9/9通过门控的通道中失败（失败在反演环节而非校准）；预声明两阶段规划器均匀保守并在探测不迁移时弃权；证书有效但在审计规模下空洞；注入研究恢复机制排序：逐字>释义>表面，其中答案-仅信号由基线漂移解释。
AI.conclusion: "未拒绝污染"的结论必须与功效、预算和有效性门控一起解读才有意义。需要将审计报告从单一的二值判定转变为包含功效度量、预算校准验证和有效性检查的完整契约，否则负结果不具有科学可解释性。

title: Rethinking 3D Segmentation from Individual LiDAR Scans: Incidence-Aware Sampling on the SIP Benchmark
summary: 3D scene understanding is increasingly important in construction, yet most methods are developed on curated datasets that do not fully reflect real site sensing conditions. In many workflows, individual LiDAR scans provide rapid local updates rather than complete scene representations, producing limited surface coverage, acquisition-driven density variation, and severe imbalance between dominant planar surfaces and sparse construction elements. Because large point clouds must be downsampled, sampling resolution and point allocation directly affect the balance between geometric detail and spatial context. This study evaluates these effects under a fixed per-fragment point budget and introduces an incidence-aware sampling strategy for individual LiDAR scans. The method maps points to a geometry-normalized manifold space for voxel-based selection while preserving original Euclidean coordinates for downstream learning. It requires only point coordinates and normals and no backbone modification. Using the Site in Pieces (SIP) benchmark, experiments with Point Transformer and PointNeXt show improved resolution-averaged segmentation performance, especially for non-planar elements and ladders, while reducing sensitivity to sampling resolution. The results show that acquisition-aware sampling can provide a more stable geometric representation and should be treated as an active component of individual-scan 3D segmentation rather than generic preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向个体LiDAR扫描的入射感知采样策略，在固定点数预算下通过几何归一化流形空间进行体素选择，在不修改骨干网络的情况下提升3D分割性能，尤其在非平面元素和爬梯等稀疏结构上效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法大多在精心整理的基准数据集上开发，未充分反映真实施工现场的感知条件。单个LiDAR扫描只提供局部更新而非完整场景表示，导致表面覆盖有限、密度随采集方式变化，以及占主导地位的平面表面与稀疏施工元素之间严重不平衡。此外，大点云必须降采样，采样分辨率和点分配直接影响几何细节与空间上下文之间的平衡，而采样策略往往被当作通用预处理而非主动组件。
AI.method: 在固定每片段点预算下，引入一种入射感知采样策略。该方法将点映射到几何归一化的流形空间以进行体素选择，同时保留原始欧几里得坐标供下游学习使用。该方法仅需点坐标和法线，无需修改骨干网络。通过在Site in Pieces (SIP)基准上使用Point Transformer和PointNeXt进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在SIP基准上，使用Point Transformer和PointNeXt的实验表明，所提方法在分辨率平均分割性能上有所提升，尤其对非平面元素和爬梯等结构效果更佳，同时降低了对采样分辨率的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 采集感知采样能够提供更稳定的几何表示，应被视为个体扫描3D分割中的主动组件而非通用预处理步骤。

title: Unsure but Certain: Uncovering the Representation-Confidence Gap in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models use broad context to create text, suggesting they might handle input noise better than standard models. Testing reveals this is only partially true. Internally, diffusion models detect text errors highly accurately. Externally, their reported certainty ignores this signal. As accuracy drops due to noise, confidence stays near its maximum and the ability to correctly rank answers degrades toward random chance. We call this mismatch the representation confidence gap. The visible concentration of high certainty scores is a misleading surface symptom. Standard math adjustments remove this concentration but fail to fix the underlying loss of ranking order. This ranking deficit favors standard models under noisy conditions and resists common remedies. Matching training recovers accuracy but not ranking, while score recalibration and input level error signals cannot reorder the final answers. However, the information needed to properly evaluate an answer survives in the hidden states. A lightweight extraction tool uses this signal to improve ranking. This approach is highly efficient because it leaves the base model completely frozen and requires zero additional text generation steps. We present this tool to prove the signal exists, while clearly noting its limits. Ultimately, certainty reliability is a more pressing limit than overall accuracy under noisy conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文发现扩散语言模型在内部能高精度检测文本错误，但对外报告的置信度信号却与其内部检测能力脱节，导致噪声条件下模型置信度虚高、答案排序能力退化至随机水平，作者将此现象命名为"表示置信度差距"，并提出一种无需微调基础模型、不增加额外生成步骤的轻量级提取工具来利用隐藏状态中的信号改善排序。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型基于广泛上下文生成文本，理论上应比标准自回归模型更能处理输入噪声。然而实证发现其外部置信度报告与内部错误检测能力存在严重脱节，置信度可靠性成为比整体准确率更紧迫的限制因素，因此需要系统研究这一差距并寻找利用隐藏信息的途径。
AI.method: 首先通过对比实验揭示扩散模型内部错误检测的高准确率与外部置信度信号的高虚高性之间的"表示置信度差距"；接着分析标准数学校准（如绝对分数重校准）为何无法恢复排序顺序；然后分别验证训练匹配、分数重校准、输入级误差信号等常见方法的失效性；最后提出一种轻量级提取工具，从模型隐藏状态中提取信号以改善答案排序，该方法保持基础模型完全冻结且不增加任何额外文本生成步骤。
AI.result: 内部检测显示扩散模型能高精度识别文本错误，但外部置信度在准确率因噪声下降时仍接近最大值，答案排序能力退化至随机水平。标准数学调整只能消除高置信度分数的表观集中却无法修复排序损失，训练匹配可恢复准确率但无法恢复排序，分数重校准和输入级误差信号均无法重排最终答案。然而隐藏状态中保留了足以正确评估答案的信息，轻量级提取工具可利用该信号改善排序，但其能力有明确局限性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型在噪声条件下的核心瓶颈不是整体准确率，而是置信度可靠性——外部置信度与内部检测能力之间存在系统性的表示置信度差距。轻量级提取工具证明了隐藏状态中排序信号的存在，但作者明确指出其效力有限；未来应更加关注如何弥补置信度表示与内部知识之间的鸿沟。

title: TongGuOCR: A Layout-Aware and Token-Augmented OCR Framework for Chinese Historical Documents
summary: Chinese historical documents preserve valuable cultural heritage, but many collections remain accessible only as scanned page images, preventing full-text retrieval, collation, and computational analysis. Optical character recognition (OCR) can bridge this gap, but accurate transcription remains challenging because historical documents often contain complex layouts, rare characters, and nontrivial reading orders. We propose TongGuOCR, a layout-aware and token-augmented OCR framework for Chinese historical documents. First, a Layout-Aware Preprocessing module constructs and refines locally coherent recognition blocks to preserve local context while reducing interference across regions. Second, a Token-Augmented Recognition module augments the transcription target at two complementary levels: character-level vocabulary expansion gives each rare glyph a direct one-token representation and shortens its decoding path, while line-to-line transition modeling injects discrete spatial displacement tokens that guide the decoder along complex reading paths without requiring precise coordinates. Experiments on two Chinese historical document OCR benchmarks show that TongGuOCR outperforms representative traditional task-specific OCR models, general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and OCR-oriented MLLMs. On the more challenging M5HisDoc benchmark, TongGuOCR achieves 93.76 AR and reduces NED from 10.43 to 6.15 and RO-ED from 7.53 to 3.49 relative to the best competing score for each metric. An online demo is available at https://jzzh2004.github.io/TongGuOCR.

AI.tldr: TongGuOCR是一个面向中文历史文献的布局感知与标记增强OCR框架，通过布局感知预处理模块构建局部连贯的识别块，以及字符级词汇扩展和行间转换建模两级标记增强策略，在M5HisDoc等基准上显著优于传统OCR模型和通用/OCR专用多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 大量中文历史文献仅以扫描图像形式保存，无法进行全文检索、校对和计算分析。传统OCR在处理复杂版面、生僻字和非平凡阅读顺序时面临挑战，需要更准确的转录方案。
AI.method: TongGuOCR包含两个核心模块：(1) Layout-Aware Preprocessing：构建并优化局部连贯的识别块，保留局部上下文同时减少区域间干扰；(2) Token-Augmented Recognition：在字符级扩展词汇表，为生僻字提供直接的一标记表示以缩短解码路径；同时通过行间转换建模注入离散空间位移标记，引导解码器沿复杂阅读路径行进而无需精确坐标。
AI.result: 在两个中文历史文献OCR基准上超越传统任务特定OCR模型、通用多模态大语言模型和OCR专用MLLM。在更具挑战性的M5HisDoc基准上，TongGuOCR达到93.76 AR，NED从10.43降至6.15，RO-ED从7.53降至3.49。
AI.conclusion: TongGuOCR通过布局感知预处理和两级标记增强策略，有效解决了中文历史文献OCR中的复杂版面与生僻字问题，为历史文献的数字化与计算分析提供了可行方案。

title: Evidence-Calibrated Runtime Reconstruction for Agent Skills Across Heterogeneous Coding Agents
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Submitted to PROFES 2026. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/hellogxp/skill-runtime-intelligence
summary:
Agent Skills package reusable instructions and assets for tool-using language-model agents. Progressive loading creates failure boundaries poorly represented by session-, model-, or tool-centric traces: a Skill can be discovered but not activated, activated without instructions, or appear successful without an independently verified outcome. We present Skill Runtime Intelligence, a passive runtime-intelligence system that reconstructs supported Skill-lifecycle stages across heterogeneous harnesses while preserving unsupported stages as unknown. Its Run Panorama separates immutable events, deterministic relations, inferred diagnoses, and controlled outcomes with four evidence grades; optional trace import and OTLP/HTTP export support existing observability deployments.
  Across six frozen repository profiles, three coding agents, and seven clean or fault-injected conditions, all 126 executions preserve source worktrees and each correlates to exactly one source session. Yet adapters expose three distinct semantics: no Skill runs; complete runs but no failure-like events; or failure-like events in every operational-failure and clean session. In a seven-template diagnostic study, semantic aliases and Panorama localize the same six non-clean boundaries but differ in exact/status behavior; both Raw views emit a failure status on all 18 clean cases, while Panorama emits none. A known-rule graph conforms to 126/126 frozen contracts, whereas a second model completes only 228/378 calls. These observations motivate executable adapter qualification and show that event presence is not boundary fidelity, composite exact scores mask distinct errors, and model explanations must not overwrite deterministic facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Skill Runtime Intelligence，一种被动运行时智能系统，用于跨异构框架重建工具使用语言模型代理中Skill生命周期的各阶段，并区分支持与不支持阶段。通过Run Panorama分离不可变事件、确定性关系、推断诊断与受控结果，实现四档证据分级。实验表明适配器语义差异显著，事件存在性不等于边界保真度，复合精确分数掩盖不同错误，模型解释不能覆盖确定性事实。
AI.motivation: Agent Skills封装了可复用的指令和资产，但渐进式加载会在会话、模型或工具为中心的追踪上产生难以表征的失败边界：Skill可能被发现但未激活、激活但无指令，或看似成功但缺乏独立验证。现有追踪系统无法有效刻画这些生命周期阶段的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出被动运行时智能系统Skill Runtime Intelligence，重建跨异构执行框架的Skill生命周期阶段，同时将不支持阶段保留为未知。核心组件Run Panorama将不可变事件、确定性关系、推断诊断和受控结果分离为四档证据等级；支持可选的trace导入和OTLP/HTTP导出以兼容现有可观测性部署。
AI.result: 在六个冻结仓库配置、三个编码代理和七种干净/故障注入条件下，全部126次执行保持源worktree完好且每次执行精确关联一个源会话。适配器暴露三种不同语义：无Skill运行、有完整运行但无故障事件、或在所有操作故障和干净会话中均出现故障事件。七模板诊断研究中，语义别名和Panorama定位到相同的六个非干净边界，但精确/状态行为不同；Raw视图在全部18个干净案例中发出故障状态，而Panorama无一发出。已知规则图符合126/126冻结契约，而第二个模型仅完成228/378调用。
AI.conclusion: 这些观察表明需要可执行的适配器资格认证，并证明：事件存在性不等于边界保真度；复合精确分数会掩盖不同错误；模型解释不能覆盖确定性事实。

title: ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration
summary:
EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.
  We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution, where the complete system achieves 78.5% Pass@1 in the commercial Empyrean Aether environment, substantially outperforming a pure LLM baseline (23.6%). Ablation studies identify sandbox execution as the dominant performance driver (41.2 pp drop when removed), with the self-exploration mechanism contributing an additional 3.2 pp accuracy gain and a 22.1% reduction in per-task tool calls. On 20 interactive tasks involving unsaved layouts and schematics, ZhuLong achieves 60.0% Pass@1 for PyAether and 50.0% for SKILL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZhuLong，一个基于执行反馈的LLM编码智能体，通过统一MCP工具整合API检索、文档检查和沙箱执行，并配备离线API自探索机制来推断未文档化API行为，在EDA领域（PyAether和SKILL）显著优于纯LLM基线。
AI.motivation: EDA脚本编写依赖工具特定的、往往没有文档的API，形成长期存在的长尾瓶颈，而现有LLM无法解决这一挑战。
AI.method: ZhuLong结合了API检索、文档检查与沙箱执行（通过统一MCP工具），并引入离线API自探索机制，通过反事实实验推断未文档化API的行为。在商业Empyrean Aether环境中基于EDA-Eval-PyAether基准（158个真实任务、基于断言的执行）进行评估。
AI.result: 完整系统在商业Empyrean Aether环境中达到78.5% Pass@1，远超纯LLM基线的23.6%。消融实验表明沙箱执行是主导性能驱动因素（移除后下降41.2个百分点），自探索机制额外贡献3.2个百分点准确率提升和22.1%的单任务工具调用减少。在20个涉及未保存布局和原理图的交互任务中，PyAether达到60.0% Pass@1，SKILL达到50.0%。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈（沙箱执行）是EDA编码智能体的关键性能驱动因素，自探索机制能有效弥补文档缺失问题，ZhuLong展示了解决EDA领域中LLM长尾API瓶颈的可行路径。

title: DINO-3DRA: Leveraging 2D Foundation Model Semantics for 3D Cerebral Aneurysm Segmentation
summary: Accurate aneurysm segmentation in 3D rotational angiography (3DRA) is hindered by extreme class imbalance, morphological similarity to vessels, and absent large-scale 3D pretraining. 2D vision foundation models encode dense structural priors from 1.7 billion images, yet naïve slice-wise transfer fragments anatomical continuity and destabilises optimisation. We propose DINO-3DRA, a dual-path framework achieving effective cross-dimensional semantic transfer by injecting frozen DINOv3 features into a 3D U-Net backbone via Room-Lite spatial mixing and calibrated residual fusion. On multi-centre 3DRA data, DINO-3DRA achieves state-of-the-art aneurysm segmentation (Dice: 0.758; HD95: 2.75 mm; +13% over nnU-Net) with only 5.72M trainable parameters. Ablation studies confirm that gains arise from structured cross-dimensional transfer rather than loss design alone, with bridged foundation features improving anatomical continuity between aneurysms and parent vessels. Without fine-tuning on CADA and SHINY-ICARUS, DINO-3DRA eliminates all catastrophic failure cases observed in baseline architectures, demonstrating robust generalisation across heterogeneous imaging protocols.

AI.tldr: DINO-3DRA提出了一种双路径框架，通过将冻结的DINOv3二维视觉基础模型特征注入3D U-Net主干网络，实现跨维度语义迁移，解决了三维旋转血管造影中动脉瘤分割面临的类别极度不平衡、形态学相似性和缺乏大规模3D预训练等问题，在仅5.72M可训练参数下达到SOTA性能（Dice 0.758，较nnU-Net提升13%）。
AI.motivation: 3DRA中的动脉瘤分割面临三大挑战：极端类别不平衡、动脉瘤与血管形态相似难以区分、以及缺乏大规模3D预训练权重。尽管2D视觉基础模型从17亿图像中编码了丰富的密集结构先验，但朴素的逐切片迁移会破坏解剖连续性并导致优化不稳定。
AI.method: 提出DINO-3DRA双路径框架：(1) 使用冻结的DINOv3特征作为第二路径输入；(2) 通过Room-Lite空间混合模块实现跨维度特征对齐；(3) 采用校准残差融合策略将2D基础模型特征注入3D U-Net主干网络，在不微调基础模型的情况下实现有效的跨维度语义迁移。
AI.result: 在多中心3DRA数据上达到SOTA分割性能：Dice 0.758、HD95 2.75mm，较nnU-Net提升13%，且仅需5.72M可训练参数。消融实验证明性能提升源于结构化跨维度迁移而非单纯损失函数设计。无需在CADA和SHINY-ICARUS上微调即消除了基线架构中所有灾难性失败案例，验证了跨异构成像协议的鲁棒泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DINO-3DRA证明了2D视觉基础模型的特征可以通过精心设计的融合机制有效迁移到3D医学分割任务中，桥接的基础模型特征能够改善动脉瘤与母血管之间的解剖连续性，为缺乏大规模3D预训练的场景提供了一条可行路径，并展现了优异的跨中心泛化能力。

title: Instability of LLM Pre-Pretraining: It Doesn't Always Help. An Investigation on Multiple Languages
summary: Pretraining LLMs on artificial languages ("pre-pretraining") is a technique that could reportedly increase token efficiency by 33%, i.e., save up to 33% of training tokens needed to reach a certain performance. We validate this prior result for English on a larger set of natural languages across four language families, using two different tokenizers and varying model sizes. We also relate the observed gains (or losses) in token efficiency to quantified linguistic properties of the languages, such as sentence length, morphological richness, and features of dependency syntactic trees (tree depth, number of children, number of crossing dependencies). Our empirical results indicate that the reported gains depend heavily on the experiment setup and the choice of random seed, although we can confirm the trend of stable gains with 128-Dyck pretraining of small models with the Llama tokenizer for most of the examined languages. On a general note, we argue that multiple training runs should be carried out at least for a subset of experiments to avoid the community adopting unstable approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在大规模语言模型训练前使用人工语言进行"预预训练"（pre-pretraining）以提高训练数据效率的技术声称。作者在四种语言族的多种自然语言上验证了此前关于33%数据效率提升的报告，发现该收益高度依赖于实验设置和随机种子，仅在特定条件下（128-Dyck预训练、小模型、Llama分词器）能确认稳定收益。
AI.motivation: 先前研究声称在预训练之前使用人工语言（如Dyck语言）进行预训练可以将训练效率提高33%，但该结果仅基于英语验证。作者希望检验这一结论在更广泛的语言（跨越四个语言族）上是否成立，并探究其与语言结构特征的关系，同时提醒研究社区关注实验设置的稳健性。
AI.method: 作者在跨越四个语言族的多种自然语言上，使用两种不同的分词器（包括Llama分词器）和不同规模的模型进行实验，通过对比有无人工语言预预训练条件下的token效率差异来验证先前的报告结果。同时，他们将观察到的效率增益（或损失）量化为与语言属性（句长、形态丰富度、依存句法树特征如树深度、子节点数和交叉依存数）之间的关联。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，先前报道的训练效率增益在很大程度上取决于实验设置和随机种子的选择。然而，在大多数被检查的语言中，使用128-Dyck预训练、小模型配合Llama分词器时，可以确认稳定增益的趋势。其他条件下增益不稳定甚至可能出现损失。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议，在实验设计中至少对部分实验进行多次训练运行，以避免社区采纳不稳定的技术方案。预预训练的效率收益并非普适的结论，需要在更严格的实验验证后才能广泛推广。

title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are prone to hallucination, which undermines their reliability and poses challenges for safe deployment. Hallucinations in LRMs arise from two distinct failure sources: reasoning hallucination, where flawed inference steps propagate to an incorrect conclusion, and knowledge hallucination, where the model lacks the requisite factual knowledge to answer the query. To address reasoning hallucination, we propose REIN, an alignment framework that trains LRMs to produce a structured reasoning sequence, $\texttt{<think>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<reflection>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<answer>}$, enabling explicit self-reflection before committing to a final answer. To address knowledge hallucination, REIN introduces a reward mechanism that encourages explicit abstention (e.g., "I don't know") when none of the sampled reasoning chains yields a correct answer, allowing the model to refrain from unsupported predictions. Extensive evaluations on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that REIN consistently improves selective accuracy, reduces incorrect-but-self-endorsed responses, and maintains high coverage compared with competitive baselines. Notably, REIN achieves these gains within a single forward pass, without requiring process supervision, inference-time controllers, external search, or multi-round critiques. Experiments on multiple backbones show that REIN reduces the hallucination proxy by $58\sim72\%$ relative to the base models while maintaining $86\sim91\%$ average coverage, and improves selective accuracy on attempted questions by $6.6\sim14.2\%$.

AI.tldr: REIN是一个针对大型推理模型（LRMs）幻觉问题的对齐框架，通过两种机制分别解决推理幻觉和知识幻觉：训练模型生成「思考→反思→回答」的结构化推理序列以实现显式自我反思，并通过奖励机制鼓励模型在无法得到正确答案时明确表示"不知道"（即主动弃答）。实验表明，REIN在数学和常识推理基准上显著降低幻觉、提高选择性准确率，且只需单次前向传播，无需过程监督或外部工具。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）容易产生幻觉，这严重损害了其可靠性和安全部署能力。LRMs的幻觉来源可分为两类：推理幻觉（推理步骤中的错误传播导致错误结论）和知识幻觉（模型缺乏回答问题所需的事实知识）。现有方法难以同时有效处理这两种不同类型的幻觉。
AI.method: REIN框架包含两个核心设计：(1) 针对推理幻觉，训练LRMs生成结构化推理序列（<think>→<reflection>→<answer>），使模型在给出最终答案前进行显式自我反思；(2) 针对知识幻觉，引入奖励机制，当所有采样推理链都无法产生正确答案时，鼓励模型明确弃答（如说"I don't know"），避免对无依据的预测进行背书。整个过程仅需单次前向传播，无需过程监督、推理时控制器、外部搜索或多轮批评。
AI.result: 在数学和常识推理基准上的广泛评估表明，REIN持续提升了选择性准确率，减少了错误但自我背书的回答，并保持了高覆盖率。在多个骨干模型上，REIN将幻觉代理指标降低了58~72%（相对于基础模型），保持了86~91%的平均覆盖率，并将尝试回答问题的选择性准确率提升了6.6~14.2%。
AI.conclusion: REIN通过对齐训练同时解决LRMs的推理幻觉和知识幻觉两类问题，在不增加推理成本和外部依赖的前提下，显著提升模型可靠性和选择性回答能力，为大型推理模型的安全部署提供了有效方案。

title: SeqLoc: Beyond the Single Frame for Cross-View Geo-Localization in Feature-Sparse Scenes
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. To study this failure mode, in this work, we introduce CV-FSS, a benchmark that pairs sequential panoramas from five rural regions with aligned OSM maps, on which single-frame methods degrade drastically. We then propose SeqLoc, an online test-time sequence aggregation mechanism that recursively maintains a log-belief volume with three key components: (1) Entropy-Tempered Uncertainty (ETU) tempers each incoming pose likelihood volume by its normalized entropy; (2) Map-Guided Relocalization (MGR) mixes a map-shaped recovery distribution into the belief so that a suppressed true pose can recover; (3) Peak-Anchored Smoothing (PAS) derives the final pose at sub-grid precision. Extensive experiments on CV-FSS and CV-RHO demonstrate that SeqLoc outperforms single-frame localization by a large margin, improving both position and orientation recall by over 50%. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CV-FSS基准（五个乡村区域的序列全景图与OSM地图配对），用于研究跨视图地理定位在特征稀疏场景下的失效问题，并提出SeqLoc——一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，通过熵温不确定度、地图引导重定位和峰值锚定平滑三个组件，在CV-FSS和CV-RHO上相比单帧定位将位置和方向召回率提升超过50%。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视图地理定位（CVGL）方法在结构密集的城市环境中表现良好，但在乡村道路等特征稀疏场景下性能急剧下降，该失败模式此前缺乏系统的研究和针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SeqLoc，一种在线测试时序列聚合机制，递归维护对数置信体积。包含三个关键组件：(1) 熵温不确定度（ETU）根据归一化熵对每个传入的姿态似然体积进行调节；(2) 地图引导重定位（MGR）将地图形态的恢复分布混入置信度中，使被抑制的真实姿态能够恢复；(3) 峰值锚定平滑（PAS）在子网格精度上推导最终姿态。
AI.result: 在CV-FSS和CV-RHO基准上的大量实验表明，SeqLoc显著优于单帧定位，位置和方向召回率均提升超过50%。
AI.conclusion: SeqLoc通过时间序列聚合有效解决了CVGL在特征稀疏场景下的性能崩溃问题，且基准和源代码将公开发布以促进后续研究。

title: IDRAAK: From Multi-Agent NLP to Few-Shot Prompting for Semantic Drift Detection in Technical Requirements
summary: Translating technical requirements across languages can introduce semantic drift, altering numerical constraints, polarities, modalities, or other specification-critical meaning. IDRAAK is presented as an interpretable framework for detecting such drift using a language-independent Semantic Requirement Representation (SRR), with six detection workflows evaluated, ranging from deterministic comparison to multi-agent verification and few-shot prompting. On 890 synthetic perturbations across 300 requirements from 10 engineering domains, a single LLM call with six few-shot examples achieves MCC=0.888 and F1=0.983, outperforming the evaluated structured and multi-stage alternatives. Further evaluation on PAWS-X (805 pairs, 5 languages) and XNLI (700 pairs, 7 languages) exposes complementary strengths and limitations of structured and LLM-based approaches. Deterministic SRR comparison performs strongly on technical requirements (F1=0.898) but poorly on general-domain text (F1=0.012), while structured evidence improves performance on adversarial paraphrases. Post-hoc Platt scaling further improves confidence calibration. The results demonstrate that increased agentic complexity does not necessarily improve semantic-drift detection and that simple few-shot prompting can provide a strong and efficient alternative.
