A recent line of query-based methods reconstructs a compact set of 3D Gaussians by treating them as transformer queries that are refined with multi-view deformable attention; these methods, however, assume that camera poses are given. FlexSplat removes this assumption: a geometry transformer is trained jointly with the Gaussian decoder to predict per-image camera parameters and depth, which in turn ground a depth-guided Gaussian parameterization and a multi-view deformable cross-attention that aggregates evidence across all input views into a single, view-consistent set of primitives. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: FlexSplat是一个前馈式新颖视图合成框架，无需相机位姿和真实深度，通过联合训练的几何Transformer预测每张图像的相机参数和深度，并结合深度引导的高斯参数化与多视图可变形交叉注意力，实现紧凑、视图一致的3D高斯重建。在ShapeNet-SRN和GSO上，其性能接近或达到需要位姿的SOTA方法，PSNR差距在0.7 dB以内。
AI.motivation: 现有基于查询（query-based）的3D高斯重建方法（如采用多视图可变形注意力的方法）能够从多视图图像中重建紧凑的3D高斯集合，但普遍假设相机位姿是已知的。这限制了它们在真实场景中的适用性，因为实际应用中相机位姿往往不可得或难以精确估计。FlexSplat旨在移除这一强假设，实现无需标定的前馈式高斯重建。
AI.method: FlexSplat包含一个几何Transformer，与高斯解码器联合训练。几何Transformer负责预测每张输入图像的相机参数和深度，这些预测用于：(1) 构建深度引导的高斯参数化；(2) 支撑多视图可变形交叉注意力，该注意力将所有输入视图的证据聚合为一个视图一致的原语集合。训练时采用不确定性加权的深度一致性损失，使几何前端适应重建任务；解码阶段形成的跨视图共识用于吸收相机和深度估计的残余误差。高斯预算紧凑且与输入分辨率及视图数量解耦。
AI.result: 在ShapeNet-SRN和Google Scanned Objects (GSO)数据集上，FlexSplat无需相机位姿和真实深度，即可匹配或接近需要位姿的SOTA重建方法。在GSO上其感知质量（LPIPS）达到所有对比方法中最佳，且PSNR与有位姿的方法差距保持在0.7 dB以内。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练的几何前端足以使基于查询的高斯重建实现免标定操作。该结果表明，相机位姿和深度可以通过与重建任务联合优化的方式隐式估计，而解码阶段的跨视图一致性机制能够有效补偿几何估计中的误差，使得免标定方法在性能和感知质量上接近有标定的SOTA方法。

title: Don't Scroll Back: Missing-Evidence Memory for Streaming Dialogue Summarization
summary: Users of modern platforms repeatedly need summaries of recent dialogue, but the window rarely contains enough context to be interpreted on its own. We formalize this setting as streaming dialogue summarization, where a system must summarize a current window using selective memory from an unbounded history under a fixed budget. We show that the central challenge is not how much history is accessed, but whether memory recovers the evidence that the current window presupposes. We construct a benchmark and evaluation protocol that separately assesses whether memory contains gap-resolving evidence and whether the generated summary reflects it. We propose ReMEMBER, a missing-evidence memory framework that conditions retrieval on unresolved window dependencies and refines retrieved chunks into evidence-dense memory under a fixed budget. Experiments on dialogues with histories up to 160K tokens show that ReMEMBER improves memory recall and gap-resolution completeness over memory construction baselines under the same budget.

AI.tldr: 本文正式定义了流式对话摘要任务，提出ReMEMBER框架，通过基于未解析窗口依赖进行检索并将检索块精炼为证据密集记忆，在固定预算下提升历史对话摘要的缺口解析能力。
AI.motivation: 现代平台用户需要反复获取近期对话的摘要，但当前窗口往往缺乏足够上下文来独立解读。核心挑战不在于访问多少历史，而在于记忆能否恢复当前窗口所预设的证据。需要一个能评估记忆是否包含缺口解析证据以及生成摘要是否反映该证据的系统化方法。
AI.method: 提出ReMEMBER（缺失证据记忆框架），其核心思想是：1）条件化检索——基于当前窗口中未解析的依赖关系（如指代、省略等）来检索历史；2）在固定预算下将检索到的块精炼为证据密集的记忆表示。同时构建了基准测试和评估协议，分别评估记忆是否包含缺口解析证据以及生成的摘要是否反映了这些证据。
AI.result: 在长达160K token的对话历史实验上，ReMEMBER在相同预算下相较于记忆构建基线，在记忆召回率和缺口解析完整性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 流式对话摘要的关键在于恢复当前窗口所预设的历史证据，而不是简单地增加历史访问量；通过条件化检索和证据密集记忆精炼，可以在固定预算下有效解决该问题。

title: SkillSmith: Enhancing Locally Deployed Agents via Automatic Skill Construction and Evolution
summary: LLM-based agent frameworks now act as personal assistants for multi-step tasks. Existing agent frameworks such as OpenClaw commonly follow the Cloud Agent depolyment mode using closed-source cloud LLMs as backbone model, which may expose private user information and incur repeated LLM-calling costs. Local Agents address these deployment concerns by depolying frontier open-source SLMs on user-controlled devices, but their task effectiveness still lags far behind Cloud Agents. Through diagnostic analysis, we reveal that the limited effectiveness of Local Agents with frontier SLM backbones mainly comes from missing environment knowledge caused by limited backbone model scale including environment rules and operation procedures. To supply such knowledge non-parametrically, context-efficiently, and without expert authoring, we present SkillSmith, a Cloud--Local Agent collaboration framework that uses Skill as a context-efficient knowledge carrier, automatic constructs Skill from Cloud Agent task exploration and evolves Skill using Local Agent execution feedback to enhance a frozen Local Agent. Experiments on daily agent task datasets AppWorld and WorkBench show that the automatically generated Skill enables the Local Agent with Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) to achieve task effectiveness comparable to Cloud Agents with frontier LLMs, outperform the strongest non-parametric baselines, reduce average actions per task from 36.1 to 9.9 on AppWorld-Normal, and generalize to other SLM backbone models without rerunning Skill construction.

AI.tldr: SkillSmith是一个云-本地智能体协作框架，通过自动构建"技能"（Skill）作为上下文高效的知识载体，将云Agent探索中获取的环境知识非参数化地注入本地SLM智能体，并通过本地执行反馈不断进化技能，使冻结的本地SLM在任务有效性上达到甚至超越云端Agent水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的云Agent部署模式（如OpenClaw）依赖闭源云端LLM，存在隐私泄露风险和反复调用成本；本地Agent虽然通过部署开源SLM解决了这些问题，但其任务效果远落后于云Agent。诊断分析表明，本地Agent效果受限的根本原因是骨干模型规模有限导致的环境知识缺失（包括环境规则和操作流程）。
AI.method: 提出了SkillSmith框架：1）以Skill作为上下文高效的知识载体；2）从云Agent的任务探索中自动构建Skill，无需专家人工编写；3）利用本地Agent的执行反馈对Skill进行进化迭代；4）以冻结（frozen）的本地SLM为骨干，非参数化地注入环境知识以增强其任务执行能力。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和WorkBench日常任务数据集上，SkillSmith使基于Qwen3.6-27B（SLM）的本地Agent达到与前沿LLM驱动的云Agent相当的任务效果，优于最强的非参数化基线；在AppWorld-Normal上将平均每任务动作数从36.1降至9.9；技能可泛化到其他SLM骨干模型，无需重新运行技能构建流程。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith证明了通过云-本地协作和自动技能构建与进化，可以弥合云端Agent与本地SLM Agent之间的效果差距，在保障隐私和降低成本的同时实现接近云端的前沿任务表现。

title: LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出LAD-COD框架，通过对齐顶层语义目标引导与自下而上的分层视觉特征，解决伪装物体检测中前景与背景高度相似、边界证据弱的问题，在两个基准数据集及12项指标上取得最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 伪装物体检测中物体与周围环境视觉高度相似，前景-背景判别力低且外观、纹理、结构上的边界证据薄弱。虽然基于大语言模型（LMM）的分割系统可通过指令条件化目标嵌入指导掩码解码，但这种语言-掩码范式中嵌入主要只条件化掩码解码器，密集视觉特征在保留低对比度边界和精细局部结构时缺乏显式语义引导。
AI.method: 提出Language-Aligned Dense perception框架（LAD-COD），包含：1）一个可训练的分层视觉分支，用于捕获伪装敏感的纹理、边界和上下文信息，而非完全适配大型通用图像编码器；2）Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion（LADVF）模块，将目标嵌入从稀疏提示扩展到查询补丁级语言对齐特征，并通过门控机制将其残差集成到分层特征中，使语义信息引导定位同时保留分割所需的精细结构细节。
AI.result: 在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个数据集上进行实验，LAD-COD在所有12项数据集-指标组合对比（4项指标×3个数据集）中均取得最佳报告值。
AI.conclusion: LAD-COD通过语言对齐的密集感知设计，有效弥合了顶层语义知识与底层视觉特征之间的鸿沟，证明在大型多模态模型驱动的分割框架中，仅条件化掩码解码器是不够的，还需对密集视觉特征提供显式语义引导。

title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE), a structured experience-management framework that aligns experience organization with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents. Specifically, ToE organizes the experience into a shared tree of analytical perspectives and reasoning paths, whose reliability is calibrated through environmental outcomes to support systematic updating, transfer, and efficient retrieval. The experimental results on \textsc{Game of 24} and \textsc{FinEvolveBench} show that ToE substantially improves both problem-solving performance and efficiency. On \textsc{Game of 24}, ToE achieves a 31.4\% relative improvement in accuracy over the experience-free ToT baseline. On \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, ToE improves tsIC by an average of 41.24\% over the experience-free pipeline across 12 evaluation settings, whereas conventional experience-management methods often underperform experience-free baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tree-of-Experience (ToE)，一种将经验组织与LLM智能体层次化推理过程对齐的结构化经验管理框架，通过共享的观点树和推理路径树来组织经验，并利用环境结果校准可靠性，在Game of 24和FinEvolveBench上显著提升问题求解性能与效率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需要通过持续自我进化将环境交互转化为可靠且可复用的经验。现有方法要么细化单个轨迹，要么从相关轨迹中抽象共享知识，但它们的经验表示往往与底层推理过程脱节，导致反馈归因、跨任务迁移以及更新和检索效率受限，尤其是在具有结果级反馈的复杂推理任务中。
AI.method: ToE将经验组织为共享的分析视角树和推理路径树，使其与LLM智能体的层次化推理结构对齐；通过环境结果校准各经验节点的可靠性，以支持系统化更新、跨任务迁移和高效检索。
AI.result: 在Game of 24上，ToE相比无经验ToT基线实现了31.4%的相对准确率提升；在FinEvolveBench上，ToE在12种评估设置下平均提升tsIC指标41.24%，而传统经验管理方法往往不如无经验基线。
AI.conclusion: ToE证明了将经验组织与推理过程对齐的结构化框架能有效解决现有经验管理方法在反馈归因、跨任务迁移和检索效率方面的不足，显著提升复杂推理任务的性能与效率。

title: Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities
summary: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lingjing，一个面向开放城市环境的多智能体具身智能仿真平台，统一了异构智能体（无人机、地面机器人、自动驾驶车辆）的协调、任务设计与评估，支持自然语言任务、可配置通信与资源约束，并提供归因可回放的功能。基于12个视觉语言模型在9项城市任务上的评估揭示了接地与长时程执行的瓶颈，以及通信与规模扩展中的性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 城市具身智能需要异构智能体（无人机、地面机器人、自动驾驶车辆）在动态城市中的协调配合，但现有仿真平台将不同具身形态相互隔离，且将任务设计与评估解耦，缺乏一个统一的测试环境来系统地开发和评估多智能体协调能力。
AI.method: Lingjing平台从地理数据重建并渲染演化中的城市，同步多个物理引擎，向智能体暴露共享的物理和结构化城市状态。提供Gym风格的接口，支持用户自定义ReAct智能体和单/多智能体自然语言任务，配备星型或广播通信配置及资源约束。每个回合生成可归因回放，将智能体轨迹和通信与关系图变化、资源消耗及基于引擎的评估关联起来。在共享引擎在环协议下对12个视觉语言模型在9项城市任务上进行评估，并开展通信、可扩展性、鲁棒性和失败溯源的受控研究。
AI.result: 实验揭示了智能体在接地（grounding）和长时程执行方面的持续性瓶颈；任务相关的协调权衡、增加模型容量带来的边际收益递减，以及更重的工作负载进一步降低任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: Lingjing提供了一个统一的测试平台，支持可复现的端到端评估和系统性失败诊断，为城市多智能体具身智能研究奠定了基础。

title: SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model
summary: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

AI.tldr: SynVAR是首个针对VAR（Next-Scale Prediction）范式的免训练增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播，包含全局引导、感受野约束和高频补偿三个组件，在复杂场景建模中显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: VAR因其next-scale预测范式广受欢迎，但在处理包含多个物体和属性的复杂场景时存在显著的性能瓶颈。现有基于扩散的增强方法无法有效解决VAR特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题，亟需针对性的解决方案。
AI.method: SynVAR是一个免训练的增强框架，采用空间-语义协同控制策略，由三个关键组件构成：(1) 全局引导，确保早期阶段的空间结构合理性；(2) 感受野约束，缓解早期语义混乱；(3) 高频补偿，恢复细粒度细节。
AI.result: 大量定量和定性实验表明，SynVAR能够显著提升VAR在复杂场景建模方面的能力，有效抑制误差传播并改善生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SynVAR通过针对VAR范式特性设计的免训练增强方案，有效解决了复杂场景下的跨尺度误差传播问题，为VAR的后续优化提供了可行的方向。

title: Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production
summary: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Uni-SLTP，一个统一手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP）的框架，通过共享手语分词器和统一自回归生成模型，实现手语与文本之间双向映射，在手语生成运动准确性上表现优越，同时保持竞争力的翻译性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手语研究已尝试统一多个手语理解（SLU）子任务（如ISLR、CSLR、SLT），但手语理解与手语生成（SLP）方向相反，尚未被统一。统一这两个任务存在两大挑战：一是连续手语动作与离散文本token之间的模态鸿沟；二是需要学习一个既能以手语为输入也能以文本为输入的单向条件自回归模型。
AI.method: Uni-SLTP包含两个关键组件：（1）共享手语分词器，将手语序列转换为离散token和潜在表示，同时捕获语义信息和重建信息；（2）统一自回归生成模型，将SLT和SLP两个任务统一建模为条件序列生成问题，模型可以接受手语或文本作为输入，生成另一模态的目标序列。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的公开数据集上的实验表明，Uni-SLTP在手语生成（SLP）任务上取得了优越的运动准确性，同时在手语翻译（SLT）任务上保持了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: Uni-SLTP证明了手语理解（翻译）和手语生成可以在单一框架内统一实现，通过共享分词器弥合模态鸿沟，并通过统一自回归模型实现双向映射，为手语研究的全面统一奠定了重要基础。

title: JustLLMGRPO: Radiographic Control for Chest X-Ray Generation
summary: Text-conditioned chest X-ray generation aims to synthesize realistic radiographs that faithfully depict specified findings. Existing work has primarily improved quality by updating image generators, implicitly treating prompts as fixed after CXR-domain adaptation. We show that this generator-centric view leaves a substantial optimization dimension underexplored. With a CXR-adapted Sana generator frozen, one-pass reformulation by an unmodified LLM reduces RadDINO-FID from 54.225 to 27.572. Prompt analysis shows that the LLM suppresses temporal comparisons, uncertainty, and other non-renderable report content while emphasizing visible radiographic findings. However, unconstrained reformulation reduces BioViL-T alignment with source prompts from 0.695 to 0.609. We therefore introduce JustLLMGRPO, which applies standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only to the LLM prompt policy while keeping Sana frozen. Group-relative radiology-aware image feedback retains visual focus while preserving source-prompt alignment. On CheXGenBench, JustLLMGRPO reduces RadDINO-FID to 26.780, a 50.6% improvement over direct prompting, while maintaining alignment (0.696 versus 0.695). It also achieves state-of-the-art distribution coverage and downstream classification utility. These results show that substantial performance can remain latent in how radiographic information is expressed to an adapted generator. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/JustLLMGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JustLLMGRPO框架，通过仅优化LLM提示策略（而非生成器）来改进基于文本的胸部X光图像生成。在冻结的Sana生成器上，单次LLM提示重写可将RadDINO-FID从54.225降至27.572；进一步使用GRPO强化学习优化提示策略，RadDINO-FID降至26.780（相对直接提示提升50.6%），同时保持源提示对齐（0.696 vs 0.695），实现SOTA的分布覆盖和下游分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有胸部X光生成工作主要优化图像生成器，将提示视为固定输入，忽略了提示表达这一优化维度。作者发现仅通过LLM重写提示即可大幅提升生成质量，因此动机是探索并充分利用提示侧的优化潜力。
AI.method: 采用冻结的CXR适配Sana生成器，仅优化LLM提示策略。具体包含两步：(1) 单次无约束LLM提示重写（揭示提示侧的巨大潜力）；(2) 提出JustLLMGRPO，仅对LLM提示策略应用标准GRPO，利用组相对的放射学感知图像反馈在保持视觉聚焦的同时保留源提示对齐。
AI.result: 在CheXGenBench上，JustLLMGRPO将RadDINO-FID降至26.780，相对直接提示改进50.6%；BioViL-T对齐维持0.696（基线0.695）；同时取得SOTA的分布覆盖和下游分类效用。
AI.conclusion: 大量性能潜力仍潜在于向适配生成器表达放射学信息的方式中。提示侧优化是与生成器优化正交且高效的新维度，为可解释、无需重训生成器的医学图像生成提供了新范式。

title: LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing
summary: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIBAD，这是第一个面向锂离子电池电极制造的多模态异常检测基准，包含对齐的双面可见光成像、高分辨率X射线和低分辨率X射线数据。同时提出DA-Core方法，该记忆库方法在coreset选择中联合考虑特征空间覆盖率和正常特征的局部密度，在0.05的coreset比例下将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，并相比最优标准coreset结果减少43.9%的推理时间。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态工业异常检测主要聚焦于离散产品，依赖RGB与3D强相关观测，而连续流程制造（如电极生产）和弱相关传感模态（如X射线与可见光）尚未被充分探索。实际产线中不同模态间的异常证据可能不一致，导致跨模态异常不一致性显著，现有方法迁移性差且误报率高。
AI.method: 1) 构建LIBAD基准：从真实卷对卷产线采集对齐的双面可见光图像、高分辨率X射线和低分辨率X射线数据；2) 提出DA-Core方法：一种基于记忆库的异常检测方法，在coreset选择时联合考虑特征空间覆盖范围（farthest point sampling）和正常特征的局部密度（density-aware），使紧凑的记忆库能更好地保留细粒度的正常变化。
AI.result: 在coreset比例为0.05时，DA-Core将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%（相比标准最远点采样）；在该比例下还优于最佳标准coreset结果（比例为0.20），同时推理时间减少43.9%。代表性方法在可见光+低分辨率X射线的内联兼容设置下表现出有限的迁移性和持续高误报率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在流程制造场景中设计异常检测方法时，需要显式考虑正常特征的数据分布以及模态间的关系。LIBAD和DA-Core为该领域提供了基准和方法参考。

title: Measuring the Tokenization Premium: A Cost Audit for Underserved Language Communities
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as general-purpose educational and technical assistance systems, but their underlying infrastructure does not treat languages equally. One underexamined source of disparity is tokenization: semantically equivalent content can require substantially different token counts across languages, affecting API cost, latency, and usable context length before a model is invoked. We introduce the Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA), a reproducible benchmark for measuring tokenization premiums in technical tutoring content. TEA evaluates three widely used tokenizers, GPT-4o's o200k base, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, on a 120-item Python debugging corpus translated from English into Bengali, Hindi, Arabic, Tamil, and Yoruba. Bengali and Hindi serve as the primary validated cases, while the remaining languages provide exploratory cross-script and cross-family comparisons. Across this corpus, Bengali requires (1.56\times) as many GPT-4o tokens as English, reducing a nominal 128k-token context window to an effective 82k-token English-equivalent capacity for the same semantic content. With the Qwen2.5 and Mistral tokenizers, Bengali requires up to (4.5\times) the English token count. Yoruba, despite using the Latin script, exhibits the highest GPT-4o tokenization premium at (2.37\times), indicating that tokenization inequity cannot be explained by script family alone. These results demonstrate that tokenization can create measurable economic and functional barriers, highlighting the need to treat tokenization as an equity-relevant infrastructure layer for underserved language communities, particularly where educational systems depend on low-cost or offline-capable AI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tokenization Equity Audit (TEA)，一个可复现的基准，用于衡量不同语言在tokenization层面的不平等。通过在Python调试语料上评估三种主流tokenizer，发现孟加拉语、约鲁巴语等语言相比英语需要1.56×到4.5×的token数，造成显著的API成本、延迟和上下文窗口损耗，揭示tokenization是影响AI教育工具公平性的关键基础设施层。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型被广泛部署为通用教育和技术支持系统，但其底层基础设施（尤其是tokenization）对不同语言处理不平等。语义相同的内容在不同语言中需要显著不同的token数量，影响API成本、延迟和有效上下文长度。这种不平等在低收入语言社区的教育场景中尤为关键，但此前缺乏系统性的衡量基准。
AI.method: 构建TEA基准：使用120个Python调试教学条目，从英语翻译为孟加拉语、印地语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和约鲁巴语。评估三种广泛使用的tokenizer：GPT-4o的o200k base、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B。孟加拉语和印地语作为主要验证用例，其余语言提供跨文字系统和跨语系探索性比较。
AI.result: 孟加拉语在GPT-4o中需要1.56倍于英语的token数，将128k token上下文窗口缩减为等效82k；使用Qwen2.5和Mistral tokenizer时孟加拉语需要高达4.5倍token数。约鲁巴语虽使用拉丁文字，但在GPT-4o下展现出最高的tokenization溢价(2.37×)，表明tokenization不平等不能仅由文字系统解释。
AI.conclusion: Tokenization可以产生可衡量的经济和功能壁垒，应当作为与公平性相关的基础设施层来处理，尤其是对教育资源依赖低成本或离线AI工具的欠服务语言社区而言。研究凸显了需要重新审视tokenization设计以促进AI技术的语言公平性。

title: SodaMem: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Graph Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that assist users over weeks of conversation must remember what is currently true, not merely what was once said. Flat RAG diaries and Markdown logs optimize needle retrieval but under-serve currency, provenance, and ordered temporal reasoning (Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2024; Packer et al. 2023; Chhikara et al. 2025). We present SodaMem, an evidence-grounded temporal graph memory that (i) extracts typed FactEvents with mandatory provenance spans, (ii) persists mention time, occurrence time, and validity with SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES edges under hybrid lexical-dense indexing, and (iii) answers via a planner-reader loop that gathers citable evidence before composing a final response. On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem

AI.tldr: 本文提出SodaMem，一个基于证据支撑的时间图记忆系统，用于LLM长会话代理。它通过提取带来源标注的FactEvents、维护时间与有效性语义（含SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES边）以及混合词法-稠密索引，在LongMemEval-S上以92.8%准确率和约0.00161美元/问的成本达到精度前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的长期记忆方案（如扁平RAG日记、Markdown日志）擅长检索特定条文，但在信息时效性（currency）、来源追溯（provenance）和有序时间推理（ordered temporal reasoning）方面不足，无法回答"当前什么为真"而非"曾经说过什么"的问题。
AI.method: SodaMem由三部分构成：(i) 提取带强制来源跨度标注的类型化事实事件FactEvents；(ii) 持久化提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并通过SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES边在混合词法-稠密索引下组织；(iii) 采用规划器-阅读器（planner-reader）循环，先收集可引用证据再合成最终回答。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-S上，store-of-record配置达到92.8%准确率（464/500，N=3最优），平均每次提问约0.00161美元（约18.3k tokens，中位数约0.00111美元/14.6k tokens），使用deepseek-v4-flash。对比可估算API成本的公开系统，SodaMem在Flash级成本下接近准确率前沿，并严格支配多个高成本低准确率的方案。
AI.conclusion: SodaMem表明基于证据的时间图记忆能够在低成本下实现高准确率的长会话记忆，同时作者也坦诚了局限：准确率采用Flash模型自评（自我评分），成本排除摄入/裁判开销，跨系统对比为汇编估算而非单一基准下的统一评测。

title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
summary: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhyS，一个三阶段框架，用于将物理先验知识蒸馏到流式世界模型中。通过构建120K真实物理交互视频数据集PhyS-120K，先对14B双向DiT教师模型进行物理感知监督微调，再蒸馏为1.3B因果DiT，最后通过在线强化学习和时态信用路由（TCR）激励模型生成物理合理的轨迹。在PhysicsIQ基准上显著超越了多种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型虽然能在长时程内维持物理一致性的视觉状态预测，但其推演过程经常违反基本物理约束。现有方法通常将预训练的双向DiT蒸馏为少步因果生成器，但存在两个根本局限：一是通用的双向教师模型从视觉导向的预训练中获得的物理先验有限；二是这些有限的先验在双向到因果的蒸馏过程中进一步丢失。因此需要专门的方法来获取并保留物理先验。
AI.method: PhyS采用三阶段框架：(1) 构建PhyS-120K数据集，包含120K真实世界物理交互视频，覆盖刚体动力学、软体变形、流体现象和相变，每个视频带有物体属性和因果状态转换的结构化标注；(2) 通过物理感知监督微调将物理先验注入14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏为轻量1.3B因果DiT用于少步自回归流式生成；(3) 使用在线强化学习激励模型生成物理合理的推演，并提出时态信用路由（TCR）算法，在重叠时态窗口上评估物理一致性并将组相对优势路由到时间对齐的去噪动作上，以解决时态信用分配问题。
AI.result: 在PhysicsIQ基准上，PhyS使Wan2.1-14B教师模型提升18.2%，使Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。同时在物理感知视频基准VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench上也取得了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PhyS通过数据构建、物理感知微调与在线强化学习相结合的方式，有效解决了流式世界模型中物理先验获取和蒸馏丢失的问题，证明了系统化注入物理先验能够显著提升流式世界模型在物理一致性方面的表现。

title: Security and Privacy Taxonomy Generation from Mobile App Reviews
summary: Mobile app reviews are a rich, continuously renewing source of how users experience privacy and security, yet existing taxonomies of these concerns are hand-crafted and cannot keep pace with the evolving nature of the data. Automating taxonomy construction is the natural response, but scalability is the core challenge: current LLM- and clustering-based methods are developed for scientific corpora of a few thousand documents and do not extend to app review collections numbering in the hundreds of thousands. We address this gap in two ways. First, we filter app reviews for privacy- and security-related content, yielding a comprehensive corpus of over 600K reviews. Second, we introduce TaxoScale, a pipeline that handles taxonomy construction at this scale by extending an expert-defined taxonomy via Recursive Hierarchical Clustering and LLM-based node naming. TaxoScale outperforms strong automatic-taxonomy baselines on path, level, coverage, and novelty metrics, and discovers novel branches absent from prior taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TaxoScale，一个可扩展到数十万规模移动应用评论的分类体系自动构建流水线，通过筛选出超过60万条隐私与安全相关评论，并使用递归层次聚类与LLM节点命名扩展专家定义分类体系，在路径、层级、覆盖度和新颖性等指标上优于现有自动化基线，并发现了先前分类体系缺失的新分支。
AI.motivation: 移动应用评论是了解用户隐私与安全体验的丰富且持续更新的数据来源，但现有分类体系均为手工构建，无法跟上数据演进的步伐。虽然自动化分类体系构建是自然应对方案，但现有基于LLM和聚类的方法是为几千篇文档的科学语料设计的，无法扩展到数十万条应用评论的规模，这是当前的核心挑战。
AI.method: 该方法包含两部分：(1) 对应用评论进行隐私与安全相关内容过滤，构建超过60万条评论的综合性语料库；(2) 引入TaxoScale流水线，通过递归层次聚类（Recursive Hierarchical Clustering）扩展专家定义分类体系，并使用基于LLM的节点命名对聚类结果进行标注，从而实现大规模分类体系构建。
AI.result: TaxoScale在路径、层级、覆盖度和新颖性四个指标上均优于强自动化分类基线，并成功发现了先前分类体系中不存在的新分支。
AI.conclusion: TaxoScale证明了在数十万规模的应用评论数据上进行自动化分类体系构建的可行性，不仅能紧跟数据演进，还能发现专家定义分类体系未涵盖的新兴隐私与安全关注点，为规模化、持续化的应用评论分析提供了有效方案。

title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义数据湖架构，利用知识图谱实现医疗异构数据（多模态、多种表格模式、非结构化文本）的语义协调，并通过大语言模型（LLMs）对无标签元数据集合进行生成式标注，以支持对数据适用的机器学习技术推荐。
AI.motivation: 医疗数据具有高度异质性（多模态、不同表格架构、非结构化文本），数据湖虽灵活但易退化为"数据沼泽"。同时，在异构数据上应用合适的ML技术十分困难，需要领域专家人工判断，且大量现有数据集缺乏元数据标注信息。
AI.method: 提出一种语义数据湖架构：(1) 利用知识图谱描述数据间动态关系，避免schema-on-write的刚性约束，实现数据协调；(2) 引入生成式标注过程，使用LLMs对无标签元数据集合进行自动标注；(3) 在此之上构建更高级的知识层面，基于数据特性评估其与适用ML操作的匹配度。
AI.result: 论文提出该架构可同时解决数据协调（通过知识图谱）和ML互操作性（通过LLM生成元数据标注）两大挑战，从而帮助用户根据数据特性确定适合的机器学习技术。
AI.conclusion: 该语义数据湖架构通过知识图谱与LLM生成式标注的结合，在不牺牲数据完整性和灵活性的前提下，实现了医疗异构数据的语义协调与ML应用的智能化推荐。

title: AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: AdaDINO是一种对冻结的DINO视觉基础模型进行对感知（pair-aware）的骨干网络内适应框架，用于遥感变化检测。其核心模块CGLA在冻结块后通过共享时序残差以相反符号耦合双流分支，BSCS机制通过批共享通道块选择减少FFN计算量，CPGR解码器复用编码器侧变化响应进行粗到细预测。在四个基准数据集上达到或超过现有基于VFM的方法，SYSU-CD上F1达85.29%，FFN隐藏宽度减少62.5%的同时获得1.41倍吞吐加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型（如DINO）是为单图像表示预训练的，而遥感变化检测需要从Bi-temporal图像对中进行推理。现有基于VFM的方法通常独立编码两幅图像后再进行比较，导致VFM骨干网络无法感知跨时间关系，存在预训练范式与任务需求之间的错配。
AI.method: AdaDINO包含三个关键组件：(1) Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA)——在选定冻结块后耦合双流，注入符号相反的共享时序残差，增强真实变化响应同时保持配对中点；(2) Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS)——通过保留批共享的通道块子集并作为紧凑密集FFN执行，降低FFN计算量；(3) CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) 解码器——复用编码器侧变化响应进行粗到细的预测。
AI.result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO达到或优于现有基于VFM的基线方法，在类别无关的SYSU-CD数据集上获得最大增益。去除62.5%的FFN隐藏宽度后，在SYSU-CD上F1达到85.29%，同时实现1.41倍的吞吐量加速。
AI.conclusion: AdaDINO通过在冻结的DINO骨干网络内部引入双时相交互机制，有效弥合了单图像预训练VFM与变化检测任务之间的语义鸿沟，证明了在不微调骨干网络的情况下，通过在骨干内进行轻量级对感知适应即可实现高效且高性能的变化检测，代码将开源。

title: When Confidence Fails: Overconfidence in LLMs under Uncertainty and Missing Clinical Information
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in medical question answering and clinical reasoning tasks. However, their reliability under uncertainty remains poorly understood which raises critical concerns for deployment in high-stakes clinical settings. In such environments, incorrect predictions are inherently risky, but confident incorrect predictions can be particularly harmful as they may mislead clinical decision-making. In this paper, we conduct a systematic behavioral analysis of LLMs under clinical information uncertainty. We propose an evaluation framework based on the MedMCQA dataset consisting of two complementary uncertainty settings. First, we introduce linguistic uncertainty cues through prompt modifications to simulate ambiguous clinical contexts. Second, we construct an answer removal setting, wherein the correct option is deliberately excluded mandating the model to recognize insufficient information and abstain. We analyze both model accuracy and confidence behavior using multiple calibration metrics including calibration gap, Expected Calibration Error (ECE), and Unsafe Confident Error Rate (UCER) across 500 medical questions. Our results reveal a consistent failure mode, i.e., although accuracy degrades under increasing uncertainty, model confidence remains misaligned with accuracy. This leads to a substantial increase in unsafe confident errors, indicating that model confidence remains largely insensitive to clinically meaningful information loss. Furthermore, we observe significant variation across models in their ability to abstain when the correct answer is unavailable, with some models persistently producing high confidence hallucinated answers. These findings expose critical limitations in the epistemic reliability of current LLMs and highlight the need for uncertainty aware evaluation methods prior to their deployment in clinical workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地研究了大语言模型（LLMs）在临床信息不确定性下的行为表现，提出基于MedMCQA数据集的双重不确定性评估框架（语言不确定性提示和答案移除设置），发现模型在不确定性增加时准确率下降但置信度仍然错位，导致不安全自信错误率显著上升，揭示当前LLMs在临床部署中的认知可靠性存在关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLMs在医学问答和临床推理任务中表现优异，但在不确定条件下的可靠性尚未被充分理解。在临床高风险场景中，错误预测本身危险，但自信的错误预测（confident incorrect predictions）尤为有害，可能误导临床决策。因此需要对LLMs在临床信息不确定性下的行为进行系统性评估。
AI.method: 基于MedMCQA数据集提出双重不确定性评估框架：(1) 语言不确定性提示设置——通过修改提示引入语言层面的模糊临床语境；(2) 答案移除设置——刻意排除正确选项，迫使模型识别信息不足并选择弃权。使用多种校准指标（校准差距、期望校准误差ECE、不安全自信错误率UCER）在500个医学问题上分析模型准确率与置信度行为。
AI.result: 揭示了一致的失败模式：随着不确定性增加，准确率下降但模型置信度与准确率仍然错位，导致不安全自信错误率显著上升，表明模型置信度对临床意义上的信息丢失基本不敏感。此外，不同模型在正确答案不可用时弃权能力存在显著差异，部分模型持续产生高置信度的幻觉答案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究暴露了当前LLMs在认知可靠性方面的关键局限，强调在将模型部署到临床工作流程之前，需要引入不确定性感知的评估方法。

title: CORDA: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Harm-Centric Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Fourth International Workshop on Value Engineering in AI (VALE 2026), affiliated with IJCAI-ECAI 2026
summary: The key question in moral judgement is not simply whether someone chooses the "right" answer, but how they decide what matters most when moral principles conflict. Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited: most test whether models give morally acceptable answers, match human preferences, or avoid obvious violations, rather than whether they can prioritise between competing principles when no option is morally cost-free. We introduce CORDA (Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence), a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical, harm-centred moral reasoning in LLMs. Building on the morality chains formalism, CORDA tests 90 moral dilemmas involving trolley-style cases, medical trade-offs, resource allocation, and human-animal-robot conflicts across four ordered ethical frameworks: Utility, Utility + Agent Harm, Dual-Process, and Dual-Process + Agent Harm. Together, these frameworks test whether models can adapt their decisions when moral priorities change. Across ten instruction-tuned models from seven providers, we find a strong deontological default, with 9 of 10 prioritising avoidance of direct personal harm over reducing overall harm. Models also perform more reliably on categorical harm-avoidance rules, such as avoiding killing, than on outcome-based comparisons, such as minimising total harm, suggesting that they recognise moral red lines more easily than they reason through competing harms. Although all models respond to explicit chain conditioning, several fail to consistently follow specified priority orderings, such as humans over animals and animals over robots. CORDA addresses a central gap in LLM moral evaluation by testing whether models can move beyond default harm-avoidant responses and apply context-specified moral priorities. Moral reliability requires more than default restraint; it requires controllability under conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORDA基准，用于评估大语言模型在道德原则冲突时的层级化、以伤害为中心的道德推理能力。通过对90个道德困境、四种有序伦理框架的测试，发现模型普遍存在道义论默认倾向（9/10模型优先避免直接个人伤害），在分类性伤害规避规则上表现可靠，但在基于结果的伤害比较和指定优先级排序（如人类>动物>机器人）的执行上存在不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估存在局限：多数测试只考察模型是否给出可接受的道德答案、匹配人类偏好或避免明显违规，而非检验其在无道德自由选项冲突情境下能否对相互竞争的原则进行优先级排序。这遗漏了道德判断的核心问题——当道德原则冲突时，模型如何决定什么最重要。
AI.method: 基于morality chains形式化框架构建CORDA基准，包含90个道德困境（电车难题、医疗权衡、资源分配、人类-动物-机器人冲突），覆盖四种有序伦理框架：效用主义、效用+代理伤害、双过程理论、双过程+代理伤害。对来自七个提供者的十个指令微调模型进行评估，测试其在道德优先级变化时能否适应决策。
AI.result: 发现如下结果：(1) 9/10的模型表现出强烈的道义论默认倾向，优先避免直接个人伤害而非减少整体伤害；(2) 模型在分类性伤害规避规则（如避免杀人）上比基于结果的比较（如最小化总体伤害）表现更可靠；(3) 尽管所有模型都能响应显式链式条件设定，但部分模型无法一致地遵循指定的优先级排序。
AI.conclusion: 道德可靠性不仅需要默认的自我约束，更需要冲突情境下的可控性。CORDA填补了LLM道德评估的关键空白，证明模型需要在超越默认伤害规避反应的基础上，能够应用情境特定的道德优先级。道德判断的评估应关注模型的优先级推理能力而非仅检查其道德可接受性。

title: AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining
comment: Accepted at the Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture (CVPPA) Workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. Building on this, we present AgriMAE, a parameter-efficient continual pretraining baseline that adapts a masked autoencoder pretrained on natural images by training only lightweight adapters. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. Project page: https://dtu-pas.github.io/agrifield40k/

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgriField-40K，一个涵盖17个公共数据源的农业田间视觉数据集，并基于其提出了AgriMAE参数高效持续预训练基线，通过仅训练轻量适配器来适应在自然图像上预训练的掩码自编码器，能够以9倍更少的可训练参数匹配甚至超越全量微调的性能。
AI.motivation: 农业田间计算机视觉对精准农业至关重要，但依赖昂贵的标注和预训练大模型的高成本领域适配，亟需一种低成本、参数高效的持续预训练方案。
AI.method: 构建了AgriField-40K字段中心数据集（整合17个公共资源，覆盖多样作物、杂草和田间条件）；提出AgriMAE基线，仅训练轻量适配器适配自然图像预训练的掩码自编码器；探索语义特征重建作为替代预训练目标，并评估多任务迁移性能。
AI.result: AgriMAE持续提升下游任务性能，能以最多9倍更少的可训练参数匹配甚至超越全量微调的效果，验证了AgriField-40K作为农业视觉持续预训练实用资源的价值。
AI.conclusion: AgriField-40K和AgriMAE证明了参数高效持续预训练在农业视觉领域的可行性和实用性，为农业视觉提供了一种低成本、高性能的模型适配范式。

title: The Announcement Carries the Cue: Markup, Boundaries, and the Notation of Pre-Training Corpora
comment: 44 pages, 10 tables, 7 figures. Pre-registered protocols and their amendment history ship with the repository. Code, data, and instruments: https://github.com/emfreeburg/announcement-carries-cue
summary: How a document's arrangement is written down, its notation, is a training variable that no dataset card records. The field has established that text-extraction choices change model behaviour, and has never once measured the notation of what those choices put into the corpus. We define clean-window survival, a deterministic count of how much of a stream still demands the boundary inference, and measure notation on three fronts. What corpora carry: a census of thirteen public corpora, where survival falls to 0.153 in a vision-converted PDF slice against 0.889 in C4; the scarce resource is not unmarked text but long unmarked text; a pre-registered supply test finds what remains institutional, not consumer. Our own pre-registered prediction failed: converters do not fabricate structure on prose, and that null forced the reliability mechanism that survives it. What readers use: across five base models spanning 0.6B to 8.2B and two pipelines, deleting a structural announcement makes the following prose measurably harder to predict, while swapping its notation moves nothing. That zero does not make notation unimportant; it relocates the variable: the operative cue is the announcement, not the sigil. What writers impose: a bounded null. Base models do not impose the marked register above the authored baseline, and handed prose with every announcement deleted they do not put one back, at a rate indistinguishable from zero against an authored reference of zero. We ship the format those measurements imply: the pure frame, paragraphs in authored order, every announcement deleted into a reversible sidecar, mixed against the marked copy over announcement presence rather than notation. Choose format operators by the capability they train, not by the fidelity they preserve, and record extractor identity and survival on data cards.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将文档"排印记号（notation）"作为训练变量进行系统性测量。作者定义"clean-window survival"指标，从语料库、读者、写者三个层面测量记号的影响，发现结构性宣告（如标题标记）而非符号本身是影响模型预测的关键线索。最终提出"pure frame"格式，并建议在数据卡上记录提取器身份与survival指标。
AI.motivation: 现有文献已证明文本提取选择会改变模型行为，但从未有人测量过这些选择放入语料库中的排印记号（notation）。数据集卡不记录文档排印方式这一训练变量，作者旨在填补这一空白，量化记号对模型训练和推理的实际影响。
AI.method: 作者定义clean-window survival（确定性度量流中仍需要边界推断的文本量），从三个层面测量：(1) 语料库普查：对13个公开语料库进行记号普查；(2) 读者测试：跨5个基础模型（0.6B到8.2B）和两条pipeline，分别测试删除结构性宣告与交换记号符号的效应；(3) 写者测试：检验基础模型是否会在无宣告文本上强加有标记的语域。采用预注册的预测与方法。
AI.result: 语料库层面：survival在视觉转换PDF切片中降至0.153，而在C4中为0.889，稀缺资源不是无标记文本而是长无标记文本；预注册的供应测试发现剩余标记文本来自机构而非消费者。读者层面：删除结构性宣告使后续散文更难预测，但交换记号符号无影响——该零点将变量重新定位为"宣告本身而非符号"。写者层面：受限零结果，基础模型不会在作者基线之上强加标记语域，也不会在被删除全部宣告的文本中恢复宣告。预注册预测失败：转换器不会在散文中捏造结构。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出"pure frame"格式：按作者顺序排列段落，将所有宣告删除到可逆的侧车（sidecar）中，与带标记副本按宣告存在性而非记号符号混合。主张按格式训练的能力而非保真的保真度来选择格式算子，并在数据卡上记录提取器身份和survival指标。

title: Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?
summary: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMRD框架，将ToS框架扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的管线，系统评估好奇心驱动的视觉语言模型在部分可观测条件下的空间理解能力。研究发现VLMs在做决策时倾向于依赖预训练的文本先验而非空间证据，低光照条件下空间推理退化，且VLM记忆与人类认知存在根本性分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术越来越多地应用于安全关键场景，需要理解VLMs是否具备稳健的空间记忆并做出可靠决策，特别是其决策是否基于物理证据还是被视觉-语言偏差所污染，以及其记忆过程是否与人类认知模式一致。
AI.method: 将ToS框架扩展为Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD)管线，量化环境覆盖率和时间效率来评估探索能力，评估空间保真度，用一系列心理学指标评估记忆持久性，并用焦点指标度量认知决策能力。
AI.result: VLMs在选择疏散点时频繁基于预训练的文本先验而缺乏空间依据来证明选择合理性；空间推理在低光照条件下退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响；VLM记忆与人类认知根本性分歧。
AI.conclusion: VLM空间记忆与人类认知存在根本性差异，导致不可预测的错位风险，表明当前好奇心驱动的VLMs在安全关键空间决策任务中的可靠性仍存在严重隐患。

title: Advantage-Guided Gate: Reshaping Open-Ended Reasoning for Vision-Based Spatial Intelligence
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于优势引导的门控框架（Advantage-Guided Gating Framework），用于在多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的开放推理过程中动态干预和纠正偏差，通过蒙特卡洛值评估提供中间监督信号，并设计了Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate分别动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量完整推理轨迹，显著提升视觉空间理解与推理任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在复杂空间场景理解和推理任务中虽展现出巨大潜力，但其开放式推理过程容易产生决策错误和错误累积，导致答案质量不稳定。现有方法缺乏对推理过程中的中间监督和动态干预机制，无法及时纠正推理偏差。
AI.method: 1) 将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，并在推理树上引入蒙特卡洛值评估以提供中间监督信号；2) 设计Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate，分别用于动态选择高价值推理步骤和高质量完整推理轨迹；3) 通过多分支采样生成推理树，对门控进行监督学习训练；4) 采用共享参数初始化与任务特定头的组合，实现跨任务鲁棒性和多样性；5) 推理时贪心选择高价值前缀推理步骤，并根据问题类型选择最优推理头；6) 构建Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集并执行两阶段学习。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该优势引导门控框架能有效增强基准MLLMs在视觉空间理解和推理任务中的性能，显著提高最终答案的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 优势引导的门控机制为MLLMs的开放式推理提供了有效的中间监督和动态纠偏手段，通过选择高价值推理步骤和高质量推理轨迹，改善了推理过程的稳定性和答案质量。代码已开源供研究使用。

title: Evo-Bench: Can Language Models Improve Agent Harness?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have driven rapid progress in autonomous agents, yet standard evaluations remain confined to static task solving. An emerging frontier is harness evolution---the agent's capacity to autonomously optimize its own operating harness. However, systematically benchmarking this capability remains challenging, as existing evaluations fail to isolate harness improvements from base model strength, prevent task-specific overfitting, or capture long-horizon iterative research. To address these challenges, we introduce Evo-Bench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate models' intrinsic harness-evolving capabilities across Search, Office, and General agent domains. To rigorously isolate this capability, Evo-Bench employs a novel harness-guided construction framework: it leverages auxiliary-task evolution to identify tasks genuinely sensitive to framework improvements, followed by sensitivity-aware stratified splitting to ensure robust cross-suite generalization. Extensive evaluations across nine frontier and open-weight models reveal that top models achieve massive absolute gains reaching 16.6 points, closely approaching state-of-the-art human-engineered baselines. Crucially, while autonomous evolution outpeforms artificial harness in General tasks and excels in Search tasks, it struggles in Office tasks that demand highly specific processing workflows. Furthermore, our analysis exposes critical temporal anomalies like early saturation, while demonstrating that the synthesized harnesses act as highly transferable reasoning structures, consistently boosting diverse policy models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Evo-Bench，这是首个用于评估大语言模型内在"束具演化"（harness evolution）能力的基准测试，覆盖搜索、办公和通用Agent三大领域。通过辅助任务演化识别对框架改进敏感的样本，并进行敏感性感知分层划分，Evo-Bench能有效隔离基座模型能力与框架演化能力，防止任务特定过拟合。在九个前沿模型上的评估显示，顶尖模型最大绝对提升达16.6分，接近人工设计的SOTA基线；自主演化在通用任务上优于人工束具、在搜索任务上表现优异，但在需要特定处理流程的办公任务上表现不佳。分析还揭示了早期饱和等异常现象，且合成的束具作为可迁移的推理结构，能持续提升不同策略模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主Agent持续发展，但现有评估局限在静态任务求解，缺乏对"束具演化"（Agent自主优化自身运行框架）能力的系统性基准测试。现有评估方法要么无法将束具改进与基座模型能力隔离，要么无法防止任务特定过拟合，要么无法捕捉长时程的迭代研究过程。
AI.method: 提出了Evo-Bench基准，采用创新的束具引导构建框架：首先通过辅助任务演化来识别真正对框架改进敏感的任务，然后进行敏感性感知的分层划分以确保跨套件的鲁棒泛化。评估覆盖搜索、办公和通用Agent三大领域，使用九个前沿和开源权重模型进行测试。
AI.result: 顶尖模型在束具演化中取得最高16.6分的绝对提升，接近人工设计的SOTA基线。自主演化在通用任务上优于人工束具，在搜索任务上表现出色，但在办公任务（需要高度特定处理流程）上表现不佳。分析还发现了早期饱和等关键时间异常，并且合成的束具被证明是高度可迁移的推理结构，能持续提升多种策略模型。
AI.conclusion: Evo-Bench为评估LLM Agent的束具演化能力提供了首个系统化基准，揭示了模型在不同领域演化能力的差异性（通用和搜索任务强、办公任务弱），同时证明了自主演化束具具有强大的跨模型可迁移性。工作为未来Agent自主优化和自我改进的研究提供了重要评估基础设施。

title: PATH: Next-Interval Prediction via Autoregressive Tree Hierarchy on Tabular Data
summary: Interval prediction aims to achieve a target coverage level while producing intervals that are as short as possible. Many conformal regression pipelines first predict an uncertainty surrogate and then convert it into an interval through calibration or selection. This separation supports coverage calibration, but post hoc rules largely determine the final interval and do not fully use the learned output distribution. We observe that the resulting intervals have inherently hierarchical geometry: an interval can be recursively refined into nested subintervals, and binary trees naturally represent this structure. We formulate this hierarchy as next-interval prediction and propose PATH, which learns how probability mass flows from each interval to its next nested subintervals. PATH predicts a base leaf distribution and uses an autoregressive decoder to refine branch probabilities. Matching the distribution to the interval hierarchy aligns learning with extraction: PATH accumulates probability over adjacent output intervals and returns the shortest contiguous range reaching a selected mass. We compare PATH with 24 baselines for interval prediction on PATHBench, comprising 56 OpenML regression datasets. PATH substantially shortens the resulting intervals, achieving the lowest mean normalized length, 0.1473, while maintaining mean coverage of 0.9144. These results establish hierarchical output modeling as an effective approach for compact interval prediction on tabular data. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/PATH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PATH方法，将区间预测建模为层次化的"下一区间预测"问题，通过二叉树递归细化区间结构，学习概率质量在嵌套子区间间的流动，从而在保持覆盖率的同时显著缩短预测区间长度。
AI.motivation: 现有服从回归流程先预测不确定代理量，再通过校准或选择将其转化为区间。这种分离虽然支持覆盖率校准，但事后规则决定了最终区间，未充分利用学习到的输出分布，导致区间不够紧凑。
AI.method: PATH将区间预测公式化为一个层次化的下一区间预测问题。核心思想是：一个区间可以递归细化为嵌套子区间，用二叉树表示这一结构。PATH通过自回归解码器预测每个区间到其嵌套子区间的分支概率，学习概率质量在区间间的流动。它预测一个基础的叶子分布，并利用自回归解码器细化分支概率，使分布与区间层次结构对齐。最终通过累积相邻输出区间的概率，返回达到选定质量的最短连续范围。
AI.result: 在PATHBench基准（含56个OpenML回归数据集）上与24个基线方法对比，PATH取得了最低的平均归一化长度0.1473，同时保持平均覆盖率0.9144，显著缩短了预测区间。
AI.conclusion: 层次化输出建模是一种有效的表格数据紧凑区间预测方法，将学习与提取对齐能够提升区间预测的紧凑性。

title: MRBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Human Motion-Text Retrieval
summary: Human motion-text retrieval provides a rigorous means of assessing cross-modal alignment. Prevailing benchmarks are dominated by homogeneous indoor motions, imbalanced motion distributions, and oversimplified, repetitive texts, which hinder the reliable measurement of cross-domain and cross-granularity alignment. We thus introduce MRBench, a comprehensive motion-text retrieval benchmark featuring heterogeneous motions, broad and balanced category coverage, and reliable, discriminative, multi-granular descriptions. MRBench is constructed through a meticulously designed multi-stage data curation pipeline, which filters and balances candidates, verifies unambiguous semantic alignment, and generates motion-grounded descriptions at multiple granularities. The resulting benchmark contains 3,390 motions drawn from motion capture, in-the-wild videos, synthetic videos, and motion generative models, covering 118 fine-grained categories. Each motion is paired with concise, standard, and fine-grained descriptions, yielding 10,170 captions. Extensive evaluations of representative retrieval baselines on MRBench reveal a substantial cross-dataset generalization gap and pronounced sensitivity to query granularity. We propose a lightweight granularity-aware model anchored at a frozen standard-caption-aligned retrieval model. LLM-based concise and fine-grained captions provide pseudo-supervision for extra-branch granularity-specific motion extractors and text adapters. For inference, granularity-aware score fusion integrates global and adapted similarities while strictly maintaining score comparability across all description levels. The resulting model improves mixed-granularity retrieval without compromising standard-caption performance. We believe that our MRBench provides a comprehensive testbed for advancing motion-language alignment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MRBench，一个面向人体运动-文本检索的综合基准，包含3,390个来自多种来源（动捕、野外视频、合成视频、生成模型）的运动样本、118个细粒度类别和10,170条多粒度描述。同时提出一个轻量级粒度感知模型，利用冻结的标准描述对齐检索模型加额外分支，实现混合粒度检索提升且不损害标准描述性能。
AI.motivation: 现有运动-文本检索基准存在三类问题：以同质室内运动为主、运动分布不平衡、文本描述过于简化和重复，导致无法可靠评估跨域和跨粒度对齐能力。需要一个新的全面基准和相应方法来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: MRBench的构建采用多阶段数据流水线：候选过滤与平衡、语义对齐验证、多粒度运动接地描述生成。模型方面，提出粒度感知模型：以冻结的标准描述对齐检索模型为锚，利用LLM生成的简洁和细粒度描述作为伪监督，训练额外的粒度特定运动提取器和文本适配器；推理时通过粒度感知分数融合，在保持分数可比性的前提下整合全局和适配后的相似度。
AI.result: 在MRBench上对代表性检索基线的广泛评估显示存在显著的跨数据集泛化差距和对查询粒度的明显敏感性。提出的粒度感知模型在混合粒度检索上取得提升，同时不损失标准描述性能。
AI.conclusion: MRBench为运动-语言对齐评估提供了全面的测试平台，揭示了现有模型在跨域和跨粒度对齐上的不足，并验证了粒度感知建模的有效性。

title: LexKairos: Benchmarking Legal Temporal Capabilities in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of legal tasks. In legal practice, time is a critical concept that governs the validity of statutes, the progression of legal cases, and the enforcement of procedural deadlines. However, legal temporal capabilities remain underexplored in existing legal AI benchmarks. To address this gap, we propose LexKairos, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the temporal capabilities of LLMs in the Chinese legal context across three dimensions: statutory temporal knowledge, case temporal modeling, and statute-case temporal reasoning. LexKairos comprises nine sub-tasks drawn from real-world Chinese judicial cases and statutes. We conduct systematic evaluations of eight LLMs under multiple inference settings, including vanilla, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and thinking modes. Our results show that Gemini-3-Flash achieves the strongest overall performance, yet even the best-performing model exhibits notable limitations on tasks demanding precise time-sensitive statutory metadata recall or complex reasoning in time limits, indicating that legal temporal knowledge and reasoning remain open challenges for current LLMs. Data and code are available at https://github.com/thunlp/LexKairos.

AI.tldr: LexKairos是一个面向中文法律场景的大语言模型时间能力综合基准，涵盖法律时间知识、案件时间建模和法律时间推理三个维度共九个子任务。评估了八种LLM在多种推理设置下的表现，发现即使最佳模型Gemini-3-Flash在精确时间元数据回忆和复杂时限推理方面仍存在明显局限。
AI.motivation: 法律实践中"时间"是核心概念，决定了法规效力、案件进程和程序期限，但现有法律AI基准对法律时间能力的评估十分缺乏，亟需一个系统化的基准来全面衡量LLM在此领域的能力。
AI.method: 构建LexKairos基准，从三个维度（法规时间知识、案件时间建模、法规与案件时间推理）设计九个子任务，数据来源于真实中文司法案件与法规。在vanilla、Chain-of-Thought（CoT）和thinking模式等多种推理设置下对八种LLM进行系统评估。
AI.result: Gemini-3-Flash在整体表现上最强，但即使在最佳模型中，对精确时间敏感法规元数据的回忆以及时限复杂推理任务仍存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在法律时间知识与推理方面仍面临开放性挑战，LexKairos为此提供了系统化的评估工具，有助于推动该方向的研究与改进。

title: Generative Models: Principles, Architectures, and Applications
summary: Generative AI has emerged as one of the most transformative forces in modern artificial intelligence, reshaping how we create, imagine, and interact with digital content. From photorealistic images to coherent text, from immersive videos to novel molecular structures, generative models now power applications that were once confined to science fiction. This book is designed to guide readers through the foundational principles, mathematical underpinnings, and practical architectures that underpin this revolution.

AI.tldr: 本书系统介绍生成式AI的基础原理、数学基础和实用架构，涵盖从图像、文本到视频和分子结构等多种内容生成应用。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已成为现代人工智能中最具变革性的力量之一，重塑了数字内容的创作、想象和交互方式，但目前缺乏一本系统讲解其基础原理、数学基础和实用架构的综合性指南。
AI.method: 本书采用循序渐进的教学方式，从基础原理出发，深入数学推导，最后落实到具体实用架构，全面覆盖生成模型在图像、文本、视频和分子结构等领域的应用。
AI.result: 本书为读者提供了一套完整的知识框架，使读者能够理解并掌握驱动生成式AI革命的核心概念和技术。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI已经从科幻概念转变为现实应用，本书旨在为读者提供系统化的学习路径，帮助其掌握这一领域的关键理论和技术。

title: PE-Mamba: Bidirectional Selective Layer Aggregation for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image (AIGI) detection has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid advancement of generative models and the diminishing gap between synthetic and authentic content. Existing vision transformer-based detectors commonly rely on weighted-sum strategies to aggregate intermediate representations across transformer layers, often overlooking the inherently ordered semantic progression of hierarchical features from shallow texture cues to deep semantic representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{PE-Mamba}, a novel framework built upon a pre-trained PE-Core vision transformer with lightweight LoRA adaptation that introduces three complementary components for cross-layer feature aggregation and fusion. First, a bidirectional selective aggregator (BSA) processes layer-wise classification tokens through forward and backward selective scans, where the forward scan progressively accumulates shallow-to-deep forensic evidence, and the backward scan performs deep-to-shallow contextual refinement to reinterpret low-level cues in light of high-level semantic context. Second, a softmax-weighted aggregator (SWA) computes a learned global summary of all layer tokens as a complementary aggregation path. Third, a sigmoid-gated blend (SGA) adaptively fuses the BSA and SWA outputs via a learnable scalar gate, allowing the model to dynamically balance directional sequential evidence and global layer-wise aggregation. Extensive experiments on UniversalFakeDetect (96.6\% mACC, 99.5\% mAP) and AIGCDetect (95.3\% mACC, 98.1\% mAP) demonstrate that \methodname{} outperforms 18 detectors with superior generalization across diverse generative models, while training only 1.3\% of total parameters (0.13\% for LoRA alone).

AI.tldr: PE-Mamba是一个基于预训练PE-Core视觉Transformer的AI生成图像检测框架，通过双向选择性聚合器(BSA)、Softmax加权聚合器(SWA)和Sigmoid门控融合(SGA)三个组件实现跨层特征聚合，在UniversalFakeDetect和AIGCDetect上分别达到96.6%/99.5%和95.3%/98.1%的准确率，超越18个检测器，且仅训练1.3%的参数。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉Transformer的AIGI检测器通常采用加权求和策略聚合各Transformer层的中间表示，忽视了从浅层纹理到深层语义这一分层特征的内在有序语义递进关系，导致跨层特征聚合不充分、检测性能受限。
AI.method: 提出PE-Mamba框架，基于预训练PE-Core视觉Transformer并引入轻量LoRA适配。核心包含三个互补组件：(1)双向选择性聚合器BSA，通过前向扫描累积浅到深的取证证据，反向扫描进行深到浅的上下文精炼；(2)Softmax加权聚合器SWA，对所有层token计算学习到的全局摘要作为互补聚合路径；(3)Sigmoid门控融合SGA，通过可学习标量门动态平衡BSA和SWA的输出。
AI.result: 在UniversalFakeDetect上达到96.6% mACC和99.5% mAP，在AIGCDetect上达到95.3% mACC和98.1% mAP，优于18个现有检测器，在多种生成模型上展现出优越的泛化能力，且仅需训练1.3%的总参数（其中LoRA仅占0.13%）。
AI.conclusion: PE-Mamba通过显式建模分层特征的语义递进顺序并融合双向序列证据与全局加权聚合，有效提升了AIGI检测的准确性和泛化能力，同时保持了极高的参数效率。

title: Subjective Multi-Bias Detection with Large Language Models
summary:
In this project, we delved into the pervasive challenge of bias detection within the text content. More specifically, our focus lies on the identification of subjective bias, a type of bias that introduces improper attitudes or portrays a statement at odds with the actual truth. The subjective bias can jeopardize the authenticity and reliability of texts, leading to misconceptions and potential social tensions, especially when expressed through offensive language.
  Following prior work [1], we tackled with three different types of subjective biases in text: (1) framing bias with the use of one-sided words or phrases containing a particular point of view; (2) epistemological bias which includes subtle linguistic features that can affect the believability of the texts; (3) demographic bias with word/phrase usage under presuppositions of a particular demographic factor (i.e., gender or religion).
  In terms of the data we utilize, the input consists of texts that may harbor subjective biases. The output is a classification or annotation that reveals the presence or absence of such biases within the provided content. More specifically, we detected three different types of multi-span biases in corpus WIKIBIAS [2] with more than 4,000 sentence pairs from Wikipedia edits. The data is labelled by bias type for span pairs with the following categories: (1) framing bias, (2) epistemological bias, (3) demographic bias, and (4) no bias. The project codes are released at https://github.com/HoningJade/LLM-Bias-Type-Classification.

AI.tldr: 该项目聚焦于文本中的主观偏见检测，针对WIKIBIAS语料库中4,000多个来自维基百科编辑的句子对，识别三种类型的多跨度偏见（框架偏见、认识论偏见和人口统计偏见），并发布了相关代码。
AI.motivation: 主观偏见会危及文本的真实性和可靠性，导致误解和潜在的社会紧张，尤其是在通过冒犯性语言表达时。因此，识别文本中的主观偏见具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用分类或标注方法，输入为可能含有主观偏见的文本，输出为揭示是否存在偏见及其类型的标注。针对WIKIBIAS语料库中超过4,000个维基百科编辑句子对，按偏见类型（框架偏见、认识论偏见、人口统计偏见、无偏见）对跨度对进行标注。
AI.result: 成功在WIKIBIAS语料库上实现了三种类型主观偏见（框架偏见、认识论偏见、人口统计偏见）的多跨度检测与分类，项目代码已公开在GitHub上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为文本中的主观偏见检测提供了系统化的分类框架和可复现的工具，有助于提升文本的公正性和可靠性，减少因偏见导致的误解和社会矛盾。

title: Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it creates substantial computational overhead by forcing models to externalize intermediate reasoning steps as discrete tokens. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to internalize this process within continuous hidden states. One of the latest advancements in the field of latent reasoning, Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) excel at symbolic reasoning but struggle to preserve semantic coherence in natural language settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReLIT (Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer), a hybrid framework that grounds deep recursive reasoning within the rich semantic representations of a foundational model. ReLIT augments a frozen LLM backbone (TinyLlama-1.1B) with a lightweight, trainable recursive block that iteratively refines its latent thinking (z) before committing to a final output, structurally solving linguistic intuition from algorithmic processing and enabling "deep thinking" via gradient-isolated recurrent loops without the latency of explicit token generation. Empirically, ReLIT achieves high parameter efficiency on the GLoRE logical reasoning benchmark, matching or outperforming significantly larger models on challenging tasks such as ProofWriter and RuleTaker despite minimal supervision. These results demonstrate that reasoning capability can be scaled efficiently through recurrent depth rather than parameter width, offering a principled framework for semantically grounded implicit reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了ReLIT（递归潜在隐式Transformer），一种混合框架，将深度递归推理嵌入基础模型的丰富语义表示中，通过轻量级可训练递归块在冻结的LLM骨干（TinyLlama-1.1B）上迭代精炼潜在思维，无需显式token生成即可实现"深度思考"。在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上以高参数效率匹配或超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: CoT提示迫使模型将中间推理步骤外化为离散token，产生大量计算开销。现有的潜在推理方法（如TRMs）在符号推理上表现出色，但在自然语言场景中难以保持语义连贯性。需要一种既能内部化推理过程、又能保持语义一致性的混合框架。
AI.method: ReLIT在冻结的LLM骨干（TinyLlama-1.1B）上增加一个轻量级可训练递归块，持续迭代精炼潜在思维表示z再进行最终输出。通过梯度隔离的递归循环实现"深度思考"，无需显式token生成，结构上将语言直觉与算法处理分离。
AI.result: 在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上实现高参数效率，在ProofWriter和RuleTaker等挑战性任务上以极少监督匹配或超越显著更大的模型，展现通过递归深度而非参数宽度扩展推理能力的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 推理能力可以通过递归深度而非参数宽度高效扩展，ReLIT为语义基础化的隐式推理提供了有原则的框架。

title: Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation
summary: Fake news increasingly relies on cross-modal image-text forgeries, making transparent and verifiable reasoning chains an urgent need for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4). Existing methods produce black-box detection results without any decision rationale, limiting their reliability in forensic practice. Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a natural path toward explainability, but applying them to DGM4 raises two difficulties. First, models tend to generate explanations disconnected from predicted evidence locations, producing unverified attribution. Second, enforcing evidence-conclusion consistency requires active optimization, yet uniform training signals fail to distinguish localization tokens from classification tokens, making multi-head joint training unreliable. We propose a multi-modal manipulation detector based on an Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning (EFR) framework. EFR introduces an Anchor-and-Verify reasoning chain that enforces modality-isolated perception before cross-modal comparison, with conclusion coordinates as explicit anchors to which downstream evidence must spatially correspond. A verifiable reward system then enforces evidence-conclusion consistency during training, while a Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) routing mechanism mitigats credit misassignment across prediction tasks. Experiments show that EFR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing structured forensic reasoning records that explicitly bind explanations to evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于证据锚定的取证推理框架（EFR），用于检测和定位多模态媒体操纵（DGM4），通过锚定-验证推理链和可验证奖励系统确保证据与结论的一致性，同时采用模态解耦优势路由机制优化多任务联合训练，在实验中达到最先进性能并生成结构化的取证推理记录。
AI.motivation: 现有的假新闻检测方法产生黑盒检测结果，缺乏决策依据，阻碍其在取证实践中的可靠性。多模态大语言模型虽为可解释性提供自然路径，但应用于DGM4时面临两大挑战：（1）模型生成的解释与预测的证据位置脱节，产生无法验证的归因；（2）强制证据-结论一致性需要主动优化，而统一的训练信号无法区分定位token与分类token，导致多头联合训练不可靠。
AI.method: EFR框架包含三个核心组件：（1）Anchor-and-Verify推理链：先进行模态隔离感知，再进行跨模态比较，以结论坐标作为显式锚点，要求下游证据与之空间对应；（2）可验证奖励系统：在训练期间强制证据-结论一致性；（3）模态解耦优势（MDA）路由机制：缓解多任务预测间的信用分配错误问题。
AI.result: 实验表明EFR在DGM4任务上达到最先进（SOTA）性能，同时能生成结构化的取证推理记录，将解释明确绑定到证据位置。
AI.conclusion: EFR通过锚定-验证推理范式有效解决了多模态大语言模型在虚假新闻检测中的可解释性问题，在保证性能的同时提供了可验证、证据绑定的结构化推理过程，提升了检测结果的可靠性。

title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent social settings where they must cooperate, negotiate, and adapt to other agents. Measuring and improving these social skills is hard because, unlike math or logic, social interaction offers no objective ground truth: evaluations fall back on LLM judges, which are costly, subjective, and noisy, and models get no reliable signal to learn from. To address both, we first introduce Social Gym, an environment of 21 multi-agent social games (e.g., Werewolves, Resistance, Spyfall) whose rule-decided outcomes make agent performance verifiable and objective, with an Elo tournament that produces a cross-game leaderboard. Benchmarking experiments show that while GPT-5-mini tops the leaderboard, no model excels at all games uniformly or in all game roles, pointing to limitations of social reasoning. Motivated by this, we additionally propose SPaRTan (Self-Play and Reflect-Transfer), a training-free self-improvement loop: a model plays a game, reflects on its trajectories and their outcomes to produce a transferable playbook, and applies that playbook in subsequent games. Our results show that SPaRTan playbooks help GPT-5-mini agents level their performance on weaker roles, but largely do not improve Qwen3-32B's performance. Together, Social Gym and SPaRTan offer a reproducible, verifiable foundation for measuring and improving LLM social reasoning without weight updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Social Gym（含21个多智能体社交游戏的验证性评测环境，采用Elo联赛生成跨游戏排行榜）和SPaRTan（一种免训练的自改进循环，通过自对弈、反思和策略迁移提升LLM智能体社交能力）。实验表明GPT-5-mini位居榜首但无模型在所有游戏和角色中全面胜出；SPaRTan策略手册能提升GPT-5-mini在弱势角色上的表现，但对Qwen3-32B帮助有限。
AI.motivation: 多智能体社交场景中LLM的社交技能（合作、协商、适应）难以测量和改进。与数学或逻辑不同，社交交互缺乏客观基准真值，现有评估依赖LLM裁判，存在成本高、主观性强、噪声大的问题，且模型无法获得可靠的学习信号。
AI.method: 1) Social Gym：构建包含21个多智能体社交游戏（如狼人杀、抵抗组织、Spyfall）的评测环境，通过规则决定的结果使智能体性能可验证且客观，配合Elo锦标赛生成跨游戏排行榜。2) SPaRTan（Self-Play and Reflect-Transfer）：一种免训练的自改进流程——模型先进行游戏，对轨迹和结果进行反思以生成可迁移的策略手册（playbook），并在后续游戏中应用该手册。
AI.result: 基准测试显示GPT-5-mini位居排行榜榜首，但没有模型在所有游戏中表现一致优秀，也没有模型在所有游戏角色中均衡出色，暴露了社交推理的局限性。SPaRTan策略手册能帮助GPT-5-mini智能体提升在弱势角色上的表现，但大体上未能改善Qwen3-32B的性能。
AI.conclusion: Social Gym和SPaRTan共同提供了一个可复现、可验证的基础设施，用于在无需权重更新的情况下测量和改进LLM的社交推理能力。

title: Neurosymbolic Discovery of Algebraic Graph Constructions
summary:
There are several methods for searching for graphs with prescribed properties, such as SAT solvers and specialized generators. These methods return the result as raw data: an adjacency matrix or a string encoding. The raw data certifies that the graph exists, but it does not reveal any structural properties of the graph. We ask whether one can automatically discover a short algebraic description if only this raw data is provided. We look for a description such as a Cayley graph $\mathrm{Cay}(Γ, S)$ or a lexicographic product $C_5[K_3]$.
  We address this question with a neurosymbolic approach. We propose an agent that runs on a general-purpose large language model with no fine-tuning or per-target training. The model interleaves reasoning with calls to the computer algebra system SageMath: it analyzes the target graph, proposes and tests candidate constructions, and revises them until the output matches the target. The agent communicates with SageMath through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, which we release as a general-purpose bridge. Whether a construction matches the target is checked by a single exact isomorphism test, and therefore rests on the symbolic side and not on the model. We test the approach on a benchmark of 100 highly symmetric graphs, namely two-orbit graphs on up to 25 vertices; the benchmark was fixed in advance. Our agent could find verified algebraic constructions for all of them, without falling back to raw encodings. A strong template-enumeration baseline reaches only about $20\%$, and a catalog lookup could not identify any of these graphs. However, construction quality declines when symmetry is removed.
  As a concrete application, we identify the smallest known counterexample to the Bernhart-Kainen dispersability conjecture, a $16$-vertex graph that enumeration found as raw data. For this graph, our agent found an explicit algebraic construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号方法，利用通用大语言模型作为智能体，通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器与计算机代数系统SageMath交互，自动发现给定图的短代数描述（如Cayley图、字典序积等）。在100个高度对称的二轨道图基准测试中，智能体成功为所有图找到验证的代数构造，而强模板枚举基线仅达约20%。此外，该方法识别出了Bernhart-Kainen可散布猜想的最小已知反例（16顶点图）的显式代数构造。
AI.motivation: 现有图搜索方法（如SAT求解器、专用生成器）只能返回原始数据（邻接矩阵或字符串编码），虽然证明图存在，但无法揭示图的结构性质。作者希望仅从原始数据出发，自动发现图的短代数描述（如Cayley图或字典序积），从而获得对图结构本质的深入理解。
AI.method: 提出一个基于通用大语言模型的智能体方法：模型无需微调或针对性训练，通过推理与调用SageMath交互循环工作——分析目标图、提出候选构造、测试并修订，直至输出与目标匹配。智能体通过MCP服务器与SageMath通信（该服务器作为通用桥梁发布）。构造是否匹配由单个精确同构测试决定，结果完全依赖符号侧而非模型。在100个高度对称图（最多25个顶点的二轨道图）上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 智能体为所有100个基准图找到了经过验证的代数构造，无需回退到原始编码。强模板枚举基线仅达到约20%，目录查找无法识别任何图。但去除对称性后构造质量下降。作为具体应用，为16顶点的Bernhart-Kainen可散布猜想最小反例找到了显式代数构造。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号方法能有效从原始数据中自动发现图的代数描述，尤其适用于高度对称的图。该方法在对称图上表现优异但对称性缺失时性能下降，表明代数构造的发现与图的对称结构密切相关。发布了通用MCP-SageMath桥接服务器作为可复用的工具。

title: EgoTrack3D: A Modular Framework for Egocentric 3D Object Tracking
summary: Understanding 3D scenes from egocentric video is fundamental for robotics and autonomous navigation, yet rapid viewpoint changes and partial occlusions make building structured representations challenging. Existing 3D tracking and scene graph construction methods primarily address explicit interactions or assume static scenes, limiting their ability to capture complex dynamics. We introduce EgoTrack3D, a modular framework that reconstructs and maintains a dynamic 3D scene representation directly from egocentric RGB video. The framework lifts 2D segmentation masks into a global 3D coordinate frame, using a point-based motion scoring mechanism alongside a voxel-based merging heuristic to associate object tracks. EgoTrack3D maintains accurate representations over time, achieving an 11% improvement in percentage of correct locations (PCL) relative to the strongest baseline on the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) dataset, while addressing the more general setting of persistent 3D tracking for both static and dynamic objects. Furthermore, to demonstrate the system's robustness under degraded conditions that simulate real-world deployment constraints, we replace dense depth maps with sparse 3D bounding box estimation and integrate interaction-guided dynamic association, enabling EgoTrack3D to maintain accurate spatial representations despite noisy observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoTrack3D，一个从第一视角RGB视频中重建和维持动态3D场景表示的模块化框架，通过点基运动评分布散和体素合并启发式实现静态与动态物体的持续3D跟踪，在ADT数据集上相比最强基线PCL提升11%，并在稀疏深度和交互引导关联等退化条件下仍保持稳健。
AI.motivation: 从第一视角视频理解3D场景对机器人技术和自主导航至关重要，但快速视角变化和部分遮挡使得构建结构化表示具有挑战性。现有3D跟踪和场景图构建方法主要针对显式交互或假设静态场景，无法捕捉复杂动态，因此需要一种能同时处理静态和动态物体的通用持久3D跟踪方法。
AI.method: EgoTrack3D采用模块化框架：首先将2D分割掩膜提升到全局3D坐标系，然后使用点基运动评分机制与体素合并启发式来关联物体轨迹。此外，在退化条件下，用稀疏3D边界框估计替代密集深度图，并引入交互引导的动态关联机制，以增强系统对噪声观测的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Aria Digital Twin (ADT)数据集上，EgoTrack3D相比最强基线实现了11%的PCL（正确位置百分比）提升；在稀疏3D边界框和交互引导关联等退化条件下，系统仍能维持准确的空间表示，证明了其鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: EgoTrack3D首次以模块化方式解决了第一视角视频中静态和动态物体的持久3D跟踪这一更普遍的任务，并在标准与退化条件下均展现优越性能，为真实世界部署中的动态场景理解提供了可行方案。

title: An Agentic Generative Large Language Model for Treatment Planning of Colorectal Cancer
summary: Treatment planning in precision oncology requires synthesizing heterogeneous patient information with rapidly evolving clinical guidelines to ensure guideline-concordant care. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in many diagnostic tasks, their adoption for high-stakes treatment planning is hindered by complex reasoning, adherence to timely clinical guidelines, and safety concerns. In this study, we present GatorOnco, an agentic LLM for colorectal cancer (CRC) treatment planning.
