Together, Business Arena takes a first step toward a realistic and trustworthy testbed for evaluating end-to-end business agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Business Arena，一个基于真实阿里巴巴采购数据的受控环境，用于评估 LLM 代理在跨境电商业务中的端到端运营能力。实验发现15个前沿模型的最终净资产均值相差9倍，最佳模型仍落后于人工设计策略，表明业务运营对 LLM 代理仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准很少评估与商业相关的能力，而经营企业需要从不完整信号中推断机会、在不确定性下配置资本、适应延迟结果并满足监管义务，这些复杂工作流对前沿 LLM 代理而言日益可行但缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建一个受控环境，让 AI 代理在长期时间跨度内运营跨境店铺（向供应商采购、向买家销售）。该环境基于真实 Alibaba.com 采购数据及权威来源校准的市场条件。通过四层分析体系进行评估：与人工设计策略对比估计机会上限、技能级指标揭示强弱项、动作级归因追踪损益来源、机制消融排除模拟器捷径。
AI.result: 评估了15个前沿模型，最终净资产均值相差9倍；最佳模型仍落后于人工设计策略。技能级分析揭示了不同运营风格（利润导向的高端卖家、高周转批发商、客户服务专家），动作级归因识别出采购、定价和恢复决策中创造或破坏价值的环节。
AI.conclusion: Business Arena 为评估端到端商业智能体提供了一个真实可信的测试平台，首次系统性地检验了 LLM 代理在长期、延迟反馈、多约束商业环境中的综合运营能力。

title: VLZip: Unified Visual and Textual Compression for Interleaved Long-Context Modeling
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) face significant challenges with ultra-long, interleaved image-text sequences due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Current solutions either resort to aggressive token pruning, risking irreversible information loss, or adopt efficient but less precise architectures, while largely ignoring the equally vital textual component. We introduce VLZip, a framework that unifies visual and textual compression for high-fidelity reasoning within a pure Transformer. At its core, VLZip hierarchically distills visual and textual segments into compact, layer-specific "soft prefixes" and injects them into each decoder layer's hidden states, drastically shortening the attention sequence while preserving fine-grained global context. To address deficient evaluations in the field, we also introduce LongVLBench, a new benchmark derived from video narratives that demands holistic, narrative-level reasoning. Extensive experiments show VLZip achieves leading performance on long-context multimodal reasoning, enabling training up to 120K tokens, a 6x increase over the baseline, and inference beyond 280K tokens with significantly reduced memory, while demonstrating the memory scalability to handle up to 2M tokens. By excelling at extreme context lengths where existing methods collapse, VLZip establishes an efficient and powerful new standard for long-context multimodal AI. Code is available at https://github.com/ShareLab-SII/VLZip.

AI.tldr: VLZip是一个统一压缩视觉与文本的框架，通过将视觉和文本段分层蒸馏为紧凑的"软前缀"注入各解码器层，大幅缩短注意力序列，实现最长120K训练、280K推理及扩展到2M token的长上下文多模态推理能力，并配套提出LongVLBench基准。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在处理超长图文交错序列时面临自注意力二次复杂度的问题。现有方案要么采用激进的token剪枝导致不可逆的信息损失，要么采用高效但不精确的架构，且大多忽略了文本组件的压缩需求。此外，该领域缺乏能真正要求整体叙事级推理的评估基准。
AI.method: VLZip在纯Transformer框架内统一视觉与文本压缩：(1) 将视觉和文本分段进行分层蒸馏，生成紧凑、层特定的"软前缀"；(2) 将这些软前缀注入每个解码器层的隐藏状态中；(3) 大幅缩短注意力序列长度，同时保留细粒度的全局上下文。
AI.result: 在长上下文多模态推理任务上达到领先性能；支持120K token训练（比基线提升6倍）；推理时可处理超过280K token且显存显著降低；具备扩展到2M token的记忆可扩展性；在现有方法失效的极端上下文长度下仍表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VLZip通过软前缀注入机制在保持高保真推理能力的同时实现了高效的长上下文扩展，为长上下文多模态AI建立了高效且强大的新标准。同时引入LongVLBench基准以弥补现有评估的不足。

title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning
summary: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCalc-R1知识引导混合奖励框架，通过在RLVR中引入知识验证奖励机制和软硬结合奖励方案，解决数学推理任务中基于容差的浮点奖励存在的阈值校准困难、训练不稳定和精度受限等问题，在安全关键领域显著提升推理准确性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR框架中，浮点结果通常采用基于容差的奖励评估，但在临床等安全关键场景中面临三大挑战：阈值校准困难、训练动态不稳定、精度有限。
AI.method: 提出MedCalc-R1框架：(1) 引入知识验证奖励机制，强制生成可解释的计算公式，并通过外部验证器进行验证以增强推理可靠性；(2) 设计软硬混合奖励方案，包括基于临床安全阈值的硬约束和精度敏感型软奖励，在可接受范围内逐步引导学习。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在推理准确性和泛化能力上均显著优于现有基线，验证了其在安全关键领域的有效性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: MedCalc-R1通过知识引导的混合奖励设计，有效解决了RLVR中浮点奖励评估的固有缺陷，为安全关键领域的数学推理提供了更加可靠、可解释的奖励机制。

title: Agentic Visual Reasoning in Whole-Slide Pathology Images via Active Perception
summary: Whole-slide visual reasoning requires identifying sparse diagnostic evidence in gigapixel pathology slides and integrating observations across spatial scales. Existing WSI methods either compress densely sampled patches into global representations or use pretrained vision-language models with heuristic region selection, weakening links between predictions and morphology or lacking pathology-trained observation policies. We present AdaptivePath, an active-perception framework that formulates WSI evidence acquisition as sequential decision making. The Navigator learns question-agnostic abnormality-driven navigation from pathologist-reviewed labels to select observation locations and spatial extents, avoiding costly question-specific trajectory annotations. We train this policy through alternating representation learning and proximal policy optimization, followed by fine-tuning with geometric and appearance consistency objectives to stabilize focus trajectories. During inference, the Navigator hierarchically acquires sparse observations from low to high magnification under a limited ROI budget. A Morphology Interpreter converts observations into question-conditioned evidence, while the Deliberator evaluates evidence and revises intermediate answers across magnifications. The Arbiter integrates deliberation history to produce final answers. AdaptivePath achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on WSI and region pathology VQA benchmarks and reaches 80.14% accuracy for cancer subtype classification across six TCGA cohorts. In a blinded diagnostic-utility study, pathologists using AdaptivePath-selected observation sequences achieve 82.9% accuracy. These results demonstrate that learned active perception enables effective and traceable visual reasoning over gigapixel pathology slides.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaptivePath，一种将全玻片病理图像（WSI）证据获取建模为序列决策的主动感知框架，通过学习病理学驱动的导航策略来分层采集稀疏观测，并在多个病理VQA基准上达到SOTA零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI方法要么将密集采样块压缩为全局表征，要么依赖启发式区域选择的预训练视觉-语言模型，前者削弱了预测与形态学的联系，后者缺乏病理学训练的观测策略，难以在千兆像素级别上进行稀疏诊断证据的跨尺度整合。
AI.method: AdaptivePath包含三个核心组件：1) Navigator——通过病理学家审阅标签学习与问题无关的异常驱动导航策略，采用交替表征学习和PPO训练，并结合几何与外观一致性目标微调以稳定聚焦轨迹；2) Morphology Interpreter——将观测转换为问题条件化证据；3) Deliberator——跨放大倍数评估证据并修订中间答案；4) Arbiter——整合审议历史生成最终答案。推理时以有限ROI预算从低到高放大率分层采集稀疏观测。
AI.result: 在WSI和区域病理VQA基准上实现SOTA零样本性能；在六个TCGA队列的癌症亚型分类中达到80.14%准确率；在盲法诊断效用研究中，使用AdaptivePath选择观测序列的病理学家达到82.9%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 学习得到的主动感知机制能够实现对千兆像素病理切片的有效且可追踪的视觉推理，验证了将WSI证据获取建模为序列决策的可行性。

title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. Across Amazon Beauty, KuaiRec, and TenRec with 2, 4, and 6 MoE blocks, the final four-expert checkpoints obtain source-relative five-run mean NDCG@10 ratios of 99.92%--102.30% and measured A100 speedups of 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$. An aggressive two-expert, top-1 operating point obtains ratios of 98.36%--104.24% and speedups of 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$. These endpoint results evaluate the complete conversion-and-adaptation workflow and show that a trained recommendation MoE can be exported at multiple serving budgets.

AI.tldr: UniMoMo是一个针对稀疏混合专家（MoE）推荐模型的后训练压缩框架，将问题建模为带约束的图粗化问题，基于功能相似性而非参数距离对专家进行合并，并引入层自适应保护机制限制高流量专家的合并。在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec数据集上，将MoE压缩至4个专家时NDCG@10保持99.92%-102.30%，A100加速1.28x-1.63x；压缩至2个专家时NDCG@10为98.36%-104.24%，加速1.47x-2.21x。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏MoE推荐模型在推理时必须保留并使用完整专家库，增加了部署成本。作者希望在不引入额外压缩专用在线模块的前提下，将已训练的MoE检查点压缩为更小规模的标准MoE，以满足显式的专家预算约束，从而降低推理开销。
AI.method: UniMoMo将后训练压缩形式化为一个带约束的图粗化问题：基于未标注校准集上专家对共享推荐状态的响应来衡量功能相似性（而非参数距离），以此对专家进行聚类合并；同时引入层自适应保护机制，根据专家的路由暴露程度限制高流量专家的合并，防止性能退化。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec三个数据集上（分别包含2、4、6个MoE块），最终4专家检查点相对源模型的5次运行平均NDCG@10比值为99.92%-102.30%，A100实测加速比为1.28x-1.63x；激进的2专家top-1配置下比值为98.36%-104.24%，加速比为1.47x-2.21x。完整的转换与适配工作流表明训练好的推荐MoE可在多种服务预算下导出。
AI.conclusion: 通过功能相似性驱动的图粗化与受保护的路由合并策略，UniMoMo证明了训练好的推荐MoE检查点可以在后训练阶段被压缩为更小规模的MoE，在不同推理预算下保持甚至略超原始推荐性能，同时获得显著的推理加速。

title: JSGS: JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assumes that every input image faithfully samples scene radiance. However, mixed-quality JPEG images violate this assumption because compression-induced blocking and ringing artifacts can corrupt updates to Gaussians shared across views. To address this problem, we propose JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views (JSGS). JSGS uses luminance and chrominance quantization tables stored in each JPEG file to construct a view-specific JPEG observation operator. This operator encodes and decodes each rendered view for domain-matched comparison with the corresponding decoded input image. The luminance quantization table supplies continuous weights within a fixed middle frequency band. A loss in the low frequency band anchors coarse structure, while the weighted middle frequency loss redistributes supervision among the selected DCT coordinates. The resulting block disagreement also guides the Gaussian Controller to regularize small primitives with high opacity in disagreement regions. Across seven scenes and three mixed-quality schedules, JSGS achieves the lowest mean LPIPS and the highest mean SSIM under every schedule while rendering at approximately 150 FPS. Code: https://github.com/Jayden-Cui/JSGS.

AI.tldr: JSGS针对混合JPEG质量视图下的3D高斯泼溅训练问题，利用JPEG文件中的量化表构建视图专属的JPEG观测算子，实现域匹配的监督，并引入块不一致引导的正则化，在保持约150 FPS渲染速度的同时，在所有测试方案下取得了最低LPIPS和最高SSIM。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS假设输入图像忠实采样场景辐射，但混合质量的JPEG图像因压缩引入的块效应和振铃伪影会破坏跨视图共享高斯的更新，导致重建质量下降。
AI.method: 提出JPEG状态引导监督（JSGS）：1) 利用JPEG文件中的亮度和色度量化表构建视图专属的JPEG观测算子，对渲染视图进行编码-解码以与对应解码输入图进行域匹配比较；2) 利用亮度量化表在固定中频带内提供连续权重的中频损失，并在低频带使用锚定粗结构；3) 块不一致性引导高斯控制器对不一致区域的细小高不透明度图元进行正则化。
AI.result: 在7个场景和3种混合质量调度方案下，JSGS在所有方案中取得最低的平均LPIPS和最高的平均SSIM，同时渲染速度约为150 FPS。
AI.conclusion: JSGS通过显式建模JPEG压缩过程并利用量化表提供域匹配的有监督信号，有效缓解了混合质量JPEG图像对3DGS训练的干扰，在保持实时渲染性能的同时提升重建质量。

title: Can Open-Weight Models Compete on Financial Text Comprehension?
comment: To be presented at the workshop International Symposium on Large Language Models for Financial Services (FinLLM@IJCAI2026)
summary: Open-weight language models from Chinese AI labs caught up on benchmarks relative to proprietary frontier models in recent months. Yet their reliability on real-world financial tasks remains largely untested. We updated the Financial Touchstone benchmark, which now has 2,967 question context-answer triplets across 495 international annual reports. We also apply a new set of models on the benchmark, expanding coverage from eleven to twenty models across ten providers, including recent open-weight models such as GLM 4.7, GLM 5, Kimi K2.6, and DeepSeek V3.2, as well as Alibaba's proprietary flagship Qwen3-Max. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest accuracy (88.4%), while Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro maintains the lowest hallucination rate (0.08%). Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 ranks third in accuracy, and the non-reasoning models GLM 5 and Mistral 3 rank fourth and fifth, challenging the assumption that reasoning architectures or proprietary weights are a prerequisite for strong financial comprehension. Information retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, accounting for 48.9% of all failures. We also document a new finding: geopolitical content filters in Chinese models refuse legitimate financial questions (0.08% of attempts), sometimes without clear reason, and the refusal behavior depends on the access route as much as on the model. The complete dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文更新了Financial Touchstone基准（2,967个问答三元组，覆盖495份国际年报），将评估模型从11个扩展至20个（涵盖10家供应商，包括GLM 4.7/5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2等开源权重模型及Qwen3-Max）。Claude Opus 4.6准确率最高（88.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%）。开源权重模型Kimi K2.6准确率第三，非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3分列第四、五，挑战了"推理架构或专有权重是金融理解前提"的假设。信息检索是主要瓶颈（占48.9%失败）；另发现中国模型中的地理内容过滤器会拒绝合法金融问题（0.08%），且拒绝行为取决于访问路径。
AI.motivation: 中国AI实验室的开源权重模型在基准测试上已追赶专有前沿模型，但其在真实金融任务上的可靠性尚未得到充分检验。作者旨在通过对真实世界金融任务的大规模、多模型基准评测，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 更新Financial Touchstone基准：构建2,967个问答三元组（覆盖495份国际年报）；将评估模型从11个扩大到20个（10家供应商），纳入最新开源权重模型（GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2）及专有模型（Qwen3-Max、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Pro等）；进行准确率、幻觉率和失败模式分析，并记录模型拒绝行为。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6准确率最高（88.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%）。开源权重模型Kimi K2.6排名第三，非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3排名第四、五，表明推理架构或专有权重并非金融理解的必要条件。信息检索失败占所有失败的48.9%，为主要瓶颈。另发现0.08%的合法金融问题被中国模型的地理内容过滤器拒绝，且拒绝行为受访问路径影响。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重模型在真实金融任务上已能匹敌甚至超越部分专有模型，挑战了推理架构和专有权重的必要性假设。信息检索是金融文档理解的核心瓶颈，未来应重点改进。模型拒绝行为受访问路径影响这一发现凸显了评估部署路径而非仅评估模型的重要性。数据集和评估框架已公开。

title: A QUBO-Inspired Computational Framework for Airport Landside Bottleneck Diagnosis and Dynamic Dispatch Optimization
summary: Airport landside traffic centers connect terminal arrivals with taxis, ride-hailing vehicles, private cars, buses, metro services, parking facilities, and terminal-area roadways. Peak arrivals can create coupled congestion across passenger queues, vehicle queues, pickup berths, storage areas, and access roads. This study proposes a QUBO-inspired computational framework for bottleneck diagnosis and dynamic dispatch in this setting. Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport serve as case airports. A five-minute state model links passenger arrivals, vehicle supply, pickup berth service, vehicle storage, and road capacity. Bottleneck diagnosis uses service intensity, road demand saturation, bottleneck frequency, queue severity, shadow-price leverage, and a composite congestion severity index. Two dispatch schemes are tested under consistent demand inputs: finite-action model predictive control and quadratic-unconstrained-binary-optimization-inspired simulated annealing. In the strong-peak baseline scenario, the QUBO-inspired method reduces the final passenger queue from 3445 to 2477 passengers at Shanghai Pudong and from 2053 to 1482 passengers at Hangzhou Xiaoshan. Case results indicate different dominant bottlenecks. Shanghai Pudong is more affected by road saturation, whereas Hangzhou Xiaoshan is more affected by pickup berth service. Robustness tests under demand, supply, service, road-capacity, modal-share, and random-noise perturbations show retained queue-reduction benefits under the tested uncertainty levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个QUBO启发的计算框架，用于机场陆侧交通中心的瓶颈诊断与动态调度，以浦东和萧山机场为案例，通过五分钟状态模型和两种调度方案对比，验证了QUBO启发方法在高峰到达情景下能显著缩短旅客排队，并揭示了两个机场不同的主导瓶颈类型。
AI.motivation: 机场陆侧交通中心在高峰到达时段会出现旅客排队、车辆排队、上客泊位、车辆停放和道路通行之间的耦合拥堵问题，需要有效的瓶颈诊断与动态调度方法来进行缓解。
AI.method: 构建五分钟粒度状态模型，关联旅客到达、车辆供给、上客泊位服务、车辆停放与道路容量。瓶颈诊断基于服务强度、道路需求饱和度、瓶颈频率、队列严重度、影子价格杠杆与复合拥堵严重度指数。测试两种调度方案：有限动作模型预测控制（MPC）与QUBO启发的模拟退火方法，采用一致的供需输入进行对比。
AI.result: 在强高峰基线情景下，QUBO启发方法使浦东机场最终旅客队列从3445人降至2477人，萧山机场从2053人降至1482人。浦东主要受道路饱和度影响，萧山主要受上客泊位服务影响。在需求、供给、服务、道路容量、出行方式分担率及随机噪声扰动下的鲁棒性测试中，队列缩减效益在测试的不确定性水平下得以保持。
AI.conclusion: QUBO启发的模拟退火调度在机场陆侧交通瓶颈缓解方面优于传统MPC方案，且不同机场具有不同的主导瓶颈因素，需要针对性的瓶颈识别与调度策略。

title: Degradation-Guided Underwater Image Restoration with Task-Oriented Latent Control
summary: Degradation information in underwater images plays a dual role: its spatial and spectral cues can guide adaptive restoration, while degradation-entangled features may be propagated without explicit regulation during decoding. Existing methods largely overlook this dual role, either underexploiting degradation cues or directly forwarding encoder features through skip connections. To address this issue, we propose PROTEUS, which couples degradation-guided feature adaptation with task?oriented latent control. PROTEUS tackles this problem from two complementary perspectives. At the feature level, the Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block exploits spatially varying degradation cues to adapt feature processing across network stages. At the representation level, the task-oriented latent controller learns a structured control code under discriminative regularisation and uses it for channel-wise modulation of skip features, without requiring the code to form a metrically cleaner embedding. Extensive experiments on five paired and four non-reference underwater benchmarks demonstrate that PROTEUS achieves highly competitive restoration performance, with a favourable balance between restoration quality and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PROTEUS，一种耦合退化引导特征适应与任务导向潜变量控制的水下图像复原方法，通过双模块在特征级和表示级分别利用退化信息，在多个基准上取得竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 水下图像的退化信息具有双重作用：空间和光谱线索可引导自适应复原，但退化纠缠特征可能在解码过程中未经调控直接传播。现有方法要么未充分利用退化线索，要么通过跳跃连接直接转发编码器特征，忽略了这一双重作用。
AI.method: PROTEUS从两个互补角度解决问题：(1) 特征级：Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block利用空间变化的退化线索跨网络阶段自适应调整特征处理；(2) 表示级：任务导向潜变量控制器在判别正则化下学习结构化控制码，并用其对跳跃特征进行通道级调制，不要求控制码形成度量上更干净的嵌入。
AI.result: 在五个成对和四个非参考水下基准上进行了大量实验，PROTEUS实现了高度竞争力的复原性能，并在复原质量与计算成本之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: PROTEUS通过显式调控退化特征在解码过程中的传播，同时利用退化线索引导复原过程，在水下图像复原任务中达到性能与效率的优良折中。

title: AnchorFold: A Focus-Then-Fold Framework via Recursive Attention Propagation for Efficient Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Multi-vector vision-language retrievers enable fine-grained Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) through late interaction, but storing and scoring hundreds of visual patch embeddings per page incurs substantial overhead. Existing training-free methods rely on pruning or merging: pruning degrades sharply under aggressive compression, whereas merging does not explicitly prioritize important regions when forming representatives. We introduce AnchorFold, a training-free focus-then-fold framework for document-side index compression. AnchorFold applies Recursive Attention Propagation over visual self-attention graphs, performing multi-step propagation within each attention head and integrating scores across heads and layers. The focus stage selects the highest-centrality tokens as anchors. The fold stage assigns remaining tokens to their most similar anchors in the normalized retrieval space and summarizes each anchor-centered group through centrality-weighted aggregation. This preserves non-anchor contributions while concentrating capacity on structurally important tokens. Across ViDoRe v1/v2 and REAL-MM-RAG with three diverse retrieval backbones, AnchorFold consistently outperforms all evaluated training-free baselines at $γ\leq 0.20$. On ViDoRe v1/v2, it retains 98.3% of full-index NDCG@5 on average at $5\times$ compression, achieving near-lossless compression, and 92.4% at $20\times$ compression.

AI.tldr: AnchorFold是一个无需训练的"先聚焦后折叠"（focus-then-fold）框架，用于视觉文档检索中的索引压缩。它通过递归注意力传播识别高重要性的锚点标记，再将其余标记折叠到最相似的锚点组进行中心性加权聚合，在ViDoRe v1/v2和REAL-MM-RAG基准上以5倍压缩率保持98.3%的NDCG@5，实现近似无损压缩。
AI.motivation: 多向量视觉-语言检索器通过晚期交互实现细粒度视觉文档检索，但每页存储和打分数百个视觉块嵌入带来巨大开销。现有无需训练的方法存在缺陷：剪枝方法在激进压缩下性能急剧下降；合并方法在形成代表向量时未明确优先考虑重要区域。
AI.method: AnchorFold包含两个阶段：（1）聚焦阶段（focus）：通过递归注意力传播在视觉自注意力图上进行多层多步传播，跨注意力头和层集成分数，选择最高中心性的token作为锚点；（2）折叠阶段（fold）：将剩余token分配给归一化检索空间中与其最相似的锚点，并通过中心性加权聚合对每个锚点中心组进行汇总，在保留非锚点贡献的同时将容量集中在结构上重要的token上。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe v1/v2和REAL-MM-RAG基准上，使用三个不同的检索骨干网络，AnchorFold在压缩率γ≤0.20时始终优于所有评估的免训练基线。在ViDoRe v1/v2上，5倍压缩时平均保持全索引NDCG@5的98.3%（近似无损），20倍压缩时保持92.4%。
AI.conclusion: AnchorFold通过双阶段"聚焦-折叠"策略，有效解决了多向量视觉文档检索中索引压缩的难题，在无需训练的情况下实现了接近无损的高压缩性能，为大规模视觉文档检索提供了高效的索引压缩方案。

title: FiRe: Fixed-Noise Refinement for Visual Counterfactual Explanations
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to change classifier decisions through realistic and localized edits while preserving decision-irrelevant content. Existing DDPM-based methods typically perform classifier-guided editing along a long reverse denoising trajectory. The changing noise levels make semantic editability and spatial control difficult to balance, and the editable state is noisy, whereas the target classifier is trained on clean images. As a result, these methods require either costly recursive denoising or low-quality one-step estimates to obtain classifier-facing clean images. We propose FiRe, a Fixed-noise Refinement framework for visual counterfactual explanations. Rather than following a reverse denoising trajectory, FiRe maps the input to a fixed noise level and iteratively refines the noisy state at that level. To provide clean images for classifier guidance, FiRe first adapts Pixel Mean Flow to visual counterfactual explanation, enabling direct clean-image prediction from noisy states. To make fixed-noise refinement produce minimal and localized counterfactual edits, FiRe introduces three FiRe-specific controls: a dynamic dual-mask strategy, adaptive guidance, and early stopping, which determine where edits accumulate, which changes become visible, and when refinement stops. Experiments on five tasks across three datasets show that, compared with the strongest recent baseline, FiRe achieves about 3$\times$ faster online inference and 8$\times$ fewer FLOPs while obtaining comparable or state-of-the-art counterfactual quality.

AI.tldr: FiRe提出了一种固定噪声精炼框架用于视觉反事实解释，通过将输入映射到固定噪声水平并迭代精炼，配合分类器引导，实现了比现有DDPM方法约3倍更快的在线推理和8倍更少的FLOPs，同时保持相当或更优的反事实编辑质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于DDPM的视觉反事实解释方法沿长反向去噪轨迹进行分类器引导编辑，存在两个核心问题：(1) 变化的噪声水平使得语义可编辑性和空间控制难以平衡；(2) 可编辑状态带有噪声，而目标分类器在干净图像上训练，导致需要昂贵的递归去噪或低质量的一步估计来获得分类器可见的干净图像。
AI.method: FiRe包含三个关键组件：(1) 将输入映射到固定噪声水平并在此水平上迭代精炼，而非沿反向去噪轨迹；(2) 将Pixel Mean Flow适配到视觉反事实解释任务，实现从噪声状态直接预测干净图像，为分类器引导提供干净输入；(3) 引入三种FiRe特有的控制机制——动态双掩码策略决定编辑累积的位置、自适应引导控制哪些变化可见、提前停止决定精炼何时终止，以实现最小化和局部化的反事实编辑。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的五个任务中，与最强的近期基线相比，FiRe实现了约3倍更快的在线推理速度和8倍更少的FLOPs，同时获得相当或达到最先进水平的反事实编辑质量。
AI.conclusion: FiRe通过固定噪声迭代精炼框架有效地解决了DDPM方法在语义可编辑性与空间控制之间的权衡难题，在显著提升推理效率的同时保持了高质量的反事实编辑效果，为视觉反事实解释提供了更实用和高效的解决方案。

title: Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models
summary: Cognitive decision-making research depends on diverse scenarios with carefully controlled complexity, yet manual production is slow, inconsistent, and biased. We developed an automated pipeline that uses LLms to generate structured decision scenarios and validates their complexity through a composite framework rooted in established task-complexity theory. We evaluated 4,238 scenarios across multiple domains and complexity tiers. Measurement validation met rigorous psychometric standards. Agreement among five independent model families was nearly perfect, with an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.997 and a kappa of 0.971. Known-groups validity demonstrated large separation between tiers, with an eta-squared of 0.587 and all pairwise comparisons significant at p less than .001. Factor analysis revealed a dominant complexity construct, with loadings between 0.87 and 0.96 across three frameworks, while interactivity formed a weaker secondary dimension at 0.34. Discriminant validity was limited by a strong relationship between complexity and text length that persisted after controlling for tier, yielding a partial correlation of 0.86. This constrains construct purity but does not undermine the instrument's tier-grading function. Model analyses showed a negative association between throughput and schema pass rate (r = -0.967, p = .007, n = 5), suggesting a speed-quality trade-off, though largely driven by one high-throughput model. Llama 4 Maverick generated scenarios fastest at 134 per minute versus 25 for DeepSeek Chat V3.2, but underproduced complex-tier scenarios, whereas DeepSeek Chat V3.2 balanced domain coverage with high schema compliance. The system demonstrated strong psychometric properties, enabling reliable classification into Simple, Moderate, and Complex tiers and providing the measurement infrastructure needed for downstream cognitive assessment of AI systems

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用LLM自动生成结构化解决策场景的流水线，并通过基于任务复杂性理论的复合框架验证场景复杂度。在4,238个场景中验证了心理测量学特性，模型间一致性极高（ICC=0.997），因子分析揭示了单一主导复杂度构念，但判别效度受限于复杂度与文本长度之间的强相关。
AI.motivation: 认知决策研究需要多样化的场景且复杂度需精确控制，但手工生成场景速度慢、不一致且存在偏差，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 使用LLM自动化生成结构化决策场景，通过基于既有任务复杂性理论的复合框架验证场景复杂度，并采用ICC、kappa、已知组效度、因子分析和判别效度等心理测量学方法进行严格验证。
AI.result: 4,238个场景经多域和多复杂度层级评估。测量验证达到严格心理测量学标准：五个独立模型族间ICC=0.997、kappa=0.971；已知组效度eta-squared=0.587；因子分析显示主要复杂度构念载荷0.87-0.96，交互性为次要维度（0.34）；复杂度与文本长度部分相关0.86；吞吐量与schema通过率呈负相关（r=-0.967）。Llama 4 Maverick速度最快（134/分钟）但在复杂层级欠产，DeepSeek Chat V3.2在域覆盖和schema合规间更平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该系统展示了强大的心理测量学属性，能可靠地将场景分类为Simple、Moderate和Complex三个层级，为AI系统下游认知评估提供了必要的测量基础设施，但判别效度受限制约了构念纯度。

title: Smart Compaction: Predicting Compaction Utility from Lakehouse Table Metadata
summary: Open lakehouse table formats accumulate small data files over time, which degrades query performance. Deciding when compaction is worthwhile remains threshold-driven, but which metadata features actually determine compaction utility is not well understood. We present an open simulation framework that generates 2,376 Apache Iceberg tables spanning three orders of magnitude in file size, extracts 17 metadata features from manifest files without reading data, and trains XGBoost to predict the continuous file-reduction ratio (R2 = 0.998, RMSE= 0.013). The binary compaction decision turns out to be trivially separable by a single partition-level threshold max_files_per_partition> 4, requiring no learned model. Cross-schema validation on 96 TPC-H tables confirms generalisation without retraining (R2 = 0.976). A query benchmark reveals that compaction benefits metadata-heavy queries but can slow full-scan aggregations by reducing task parallelism. All code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个开源仿真框架，生成2,376个Apache Iceberg表并提取17个manifest元数据特征，用XGBoost预测文件缩减比率（R²=0.998）。发现压缩决策实际上可由单一分区级阈值max_files_per_partition>4简单分离，无需学习模型；跨schema验证和查询基准测试进一步确认了泛化能力及压缩对不同查询类型的影响差异。
AI.motivation: 开放湖仓表格式（如Iceberg）在小文件持续累积后会退化查询性能，但何时值得执行压缩（compaction）仍主要依赖阈值驱动，且缺乏对哪些元数据特征真正决定压缩效用的系统理解。
AI.method: 构建开源仿真框架生成2,376个Iceberg表（文件大小跨越三个数量级），从manifest文件中提取17个元数据特征（不读取实际数据），训练XGBoost模型预测连续的文件缩减比率。
AI.result: XGBoost预测R²=0.998，RMSE=0.013；二元压缩决策可由单一阈值max_files_per_partition>4简单分离。在96个TPC-H表上跨schema验证无需重训练的R²=0.976。查询基准显示压缩对元数据密集型查询有利，但可能因减少任务并行度而拖慢全表扫描聚合。
AI.conclusion: 压缩效用的预测可高精度实现，但实际决策可能不需要复杂模型；同时压缩并非总是有益，需根据查询类型权衡收益（元数据开销缓解vs任务并行度损失）。代码与数据公开可用。

title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
summary: Semantic vision encoders have become a central visual interface for multimodal understanding and semantic conditioning in image generation. However, their final tokens discard fine-grained visual details, leading to poor pixel reconstruction and limiting their use in reconstruction-sensitive tasks such as image generation and editing. In this work, we ask whether understanding, generation, and editing can be modeled in a single visual representation space built from a pretrained semantic ViT. We show that the frozen Transformer blocks of a semantic ViT are not intrinsically unable to preserve visual details. Instead, the original patch parameterization drives the representation toward semantic abstraction, making fine-grained information difficult to recover from the final tokens. Based on this observation, we introduce \emph{Patch Reparameterization}, which preserves the original semantic pathway while adding a reconstruction-aware patch embedding that provides fine-grained visual information to the same frozen ViT blocks. The resulting unified representation preserves multimodal understanding while enabling high-fidelity image reconstruction and a favorable reconstruction--generation trade-off. We further scale this representation into \emph{UniSpace}, an 8B Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts model that performs understanding, generation, and editing in the same visual space without a separate VAE pathway. System-level evaluations demonstrate practical text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing, showing that a reparameterized pretrained ViT can serve as a unified visual interface for scalable multimodal modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Patch Reparameterization方法，在预训练语义ViT中引入重建感知的patch嵌入，使同一个视觉表示空间同时支持理解、生成和编辑任务，并扩展为8B参数的UniSpace模型，无需单独VAE路径即可实现高保真图像重建和文本到图像生成。
AI.motivation: 语义视觉编码器在多模态理解和生成中已成为核心视觉接口，但其最终token丢弃了细粒度视觉细节，导致像素重建质量差，限制了在图像生成和编辑等重建敏感任务中的应用。现有方法通常需要分离的VAE路径，增加了系统复杂性。
AI.method: 作者首先发现冻结的语义ViT Transformer块本身并不丧失保留视觉细节的能力，问题出在原始patch参数化将表示推向语义抽象。基于此提出Patch Reparameterization：保持原有语义路径不变，同时添加一个重建感知的patch嵌入，为同一冻结ViT块提供细粒度视觉信息，从而获得统一的表示空间。
AI.result: 统一表示保留多模态理解能力，同时实现高保真图像重建和良好的重建-生成权衡。进一步扩展为UniSpace——一个8B参数的Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts模型，在无独立VAE路径的情况下完成理解、生成和编辑任务。系统级评估展示了实用的文本到图像生成和基于指令的图像编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: 重新参数化的预训练ViT可以作为可扩展多模态建模的统一视觉接口，证明理解、生成和编辑可以在同一视觉表示空间中被联合建模。

title: Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration
summary: The current work developed seven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models based on leading deception theories and compared how deception judgments were made relative to baseline models. Across 700 statements drawn from five published deception datasets, four large language models (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash), and two run-types (RAG vs. baseline), a total of 39,200 deception judgments were rendered. Detection accuracies were consistent with typical human accuracies and not statistically different across RAG (54.5%) and baseline models (54.6%). RAG-based models (57.0%) were less truth-biased than baseline models (59.7%), but the effect size was quite small. Theoretical perspective mattered little for accuracy yet mattered substantially for response bias, which ranged from highly lie-biased (the verifiability approach, 32.2%) to highly truth-biased (truth-default theory, 88.1%). Content effects and model effects further moderated the results. Theory-guided AI judgments are unreliable with current parameters, yet they might show promise with additional datasets, model testing, and theory-to-data matching.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了七种基于主流欺骗理论的检索增强生成（RAG）模型，在700条来自五个公开数据集的话语上，使用四种大语言模型（gpt-4o、claude-sonnet-4-6、ollama/llama3、deepseek-v4-flash）进行RAG与基线的对比实验，共生成39,200次欺骗判断。结果显示RAG与基线模型在检测准确率上无显著差异（54.5% vs. 54.6%），人类水平一致；RAG模型（57.0%）比基线模型（59.7%）略低的真实偏见，效应量很小；理论视角对准确率影响甚微但对反应偏差影响显著（从32.2%的高谎言偏见到88.1%的高真实偏见不等）；内容效应和模型效应进一步调节了结果。
AI.motivation: 探索理论引导的RAG模型是否能提升AI欺骗检测的准确性和改善反应偏差，检验欺骗理论在指导大语言模型判断中的实际价值。
AI.method: 基于七种领先欺骗理论构建RAG模型，与基线模型在700条语句上进行对比。使用四种LLM（gpt-4o、claude-sonnet-4-6、ollama/llama3、deepseek-v4-flash），两种运行类型（RAG与基线），通过2×4×7的实验设计收集39,200次欺骗判断，并分析准确率与反应偏差。
AI.result: RAG与基线模型的检测准确率无统计显著差异（54.5% vs. 54.6%），接近人类水平；RAG模型真实偏见略低（57.0% vs. 59.7%），效应量很小；理论选择对准确率几乎无影响但对反应偏差影响巨大（32.2%至88.1%）；内容效应与模型效应均起调节作用。
AI.conclusion: 在当前参数条件下，理论引导的AI欺骗判断仍不可靠。但若增加数据集、进行更多模型测试并实现理论-数据精确匹配，此类方法可能展现出潜力。

title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowl- edge. However, retrieving the appropriate skill from a large- scale library remains challenging because realistic user re- quests are often concise and underspecified, stating only the task goal while leaving the required capabilities and execu- tion steps implicit. Existing benchmarks provide limited cov- erage of such requests. To address this gap, we introduce SkillReason-Bench, a large-scale cross-domain benchmark containing 3,729 queries and a retrieval corpus of 61,228 skills spanning nine domains. We further propose SkillRea- son, a two-stage framework that uses chain-of-thought rea- soning as training-time supervision for skill retrieval. In Stage I, capability reasoning traces generated by a stronger teacher provide explicit supervision through contrastive learning, re- trieval distribution alignment, and language modeling, en- couraging the retriever to internalize capability reasoning in its query representation. In Stage II, a retrieval-guided GRPO objective encourages the model to explore reasoning trajecto- ries better suited to its own capabilities and more effective for retrieval. At inference, SkillReason directly encodes the orig- inal query without autoregressive CoT generation, preserv- ing efficient query-only retrieval. Extensive experiments on SkillReason-Bench, SkillRet, and SRA-Bench show that Skill- Reason achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating that reasoning-enhanced training better bridges the semantic gap between high-level task goals and skill capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 SkillReason-Bench，一个包含3,729个查询和61,228条技能的大规模跨领域技能检索基准，以及 SkillReason，一个两阶段训练框架，通过思维链推理作为训练时监督信号来提升大语言模型代理的技能检索性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型代理日益依赖可复用技能库来扩展能力边界，但现实中的用户请求往往简洁且不充分说明，仅陈述任务目标而隐含所需能力和执行步骤，导致从大规模技能库中检索合适技能非常困难。现有基准对此类请求的覆盖有限，缺乏针对这一语义鸿沟的评测与解决方案。
AI.method: SkillReason 采用两阶段框架：阶段I利用更强的教师模型生成能力推理轨迹，通过对比学习、检索分布对齐和语言建模提供显式监督，使检索器将能力推理内化到查询表示中；阶段II引入检索引导的GRPO目标，鼓励模型探索更适合自身能力且更有利于检索的推理轨迹。推理时直接编码原始查询，无需自回归思维链生成，保持查询仅检索的高效性。
AI.result: 在 SkillReason-Bench、SkillRet 和 SRA-Bench 三个基准上的大量实验表明，SkillReason 在所有三个基准上均达到最先进的性能，验证了推理增强训练能有效弥合高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义差距。
AI.conclusion: 推理增强的训练方法显著优于纯参数化方法，通过将思维链推理作为训练时监督信号而非推理时生成步骤，既能提升技能检索的准确性，又能保持推理时的高效性，为弥合任务目标与技能能力之间的语义鸿沟提供了有效路径。

title: Semi-Dense Matching Uncertainty Is Not Just Local Confidence
summary: Reliable semi-dense matching is essential for modern geometric vision systems. Designed under a coarse-to-fine paradigm, it achieves an optimal balance between performance and computational cost. However, existing methods often struggle to provide well-quantified uncertainties, where catastrophic coarse-assignment failures are ignored, leading to truncated error distributions and severely misjudged geometric estimations. In this paper, we propose a lightweight, post-hoc overall uncertainty estimation framework that introduces a two-component calibrated Laplace mixture model with only 9 learnable parameters. The objective is to explicitly capture both the sharp local refinement noise and the broader tail of coarse-assignment failures. We introduce the Coarse-success posterior Refit (CoRe) method, a geometric refitting module that utilizes the posterior probability of coarse-assignment success as soft correspondence weights. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently improves downstream geometric accuracy across various pretrained-only matchers and robust estimators with minimal computational overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/khoavpt/Probabilistic-matching.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅含9个可学习参数的轻量级事后（post-hoc）总体不确定性估计框架，用于半稠密特征匹配，通过双分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型捕获局部细化噪声与粗分配失败的尾部误差，并引入CoRe几何重拟合模块提升下游几何估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有半稠密匹配方法在粗到细范式下通常无法提供良好量化的不确定性，粗分配阶段的灾难性失败被忽略，导致误差分布截断、几何估计严重失真。
AI.method: 1) 提出轻量级事后总体不确定性估计框架，使用双分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型（仅9个可学习参数）分别建模尖锐的局部细化噪声与更宽的粗分配失败尾部；2) 提出CoRe（Coarse-success posterior Refit）方法，利用粗分配成功的后验概率作为软对应权重进行几何重拟合。
AI.result: 在多种预训练匹配器和鲁棒估计器上，该方法以最小的计算开销持续提升下游几何估计精度，且代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的不确定性量化框架能够有效捕获粗分配失败带来的尾部误差，并通过CoRe软加权重拟合显著改善各种匹配器与估计器的几何估计精度，具备轻量、通用且即插即用的优点。

title: PolicyKG: An Agentic LLM Pipeline for Translating Institutional Policies into SHACL Knowledge Graphs
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Under review at IJCKG 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
summary:
Institutional policies stay in natural language while the systems that check compliance demand machine-readable constraints. Bridging that gap is still done by hand.
  PolicyKG closes the loop. It is an LLM pipeline that reads a policy PDF, classifies each sentence as an obligation, permission, or prohibition, lifts the label into first-order deontic logic, and emits SHACL constraints. Four stages run on a LangGraph state machine with per-stage validators. The piece that matters most is the Corpus Adapter: a YAML vocabulary registry that grounds LLM predicates in a target ontology. Retargeting to a new domain means swapping the registry, not retraining a model.
  On the Asian Institute of Technology Policies and Procedures corpus (1,663 sentences, 443 rules), PolicyKG reaches 86.9% deontic classification accuracy (Cohen's kappa = .709). Three annotators independently re-label a 50-item sample and agree at Fleiss' kappa = .844. SHACL shape correctness on a 69-shape subset is F1 = .866. The FOL path handles 79.2% of rules; the rest go through a direct NL-to-SHACL fallback.
  We audited every one of the 443 rules for second- or higher-order constructs. An automated regex checklist flagged none, and a first-author pass on the 92 FOL-fallback cases confirmed the same. The exact upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the true HOL rate is 0.67%. This is an audit finding for one corpus, not a proof of FOL sufficiency for institutional policy.
  Swapping the AIT registry for a GDPR registry raises exact property alignment from 1/15 to 11/15 (Fisher's exact p < .001; Cohen's h = 1.53). On the LexDeMod lease-contract benchmark (N = 200), Macro F1 drops to .370 because lease English uses "shall be entitled" for permission -- exactly the vocabulary mismatch registry swap is meant to fix. Repeated runs produce hash-identical SHACL outputs.

AI.tldr: PolicyKG是一个基于LLM的管道系统，用于将机构政策PDF自动转换为机器可读的SHACL约束。它通过四阶段LangGraph状态机运行，核心创新是Corpus Adapter——一个YAML词汇表注册表，将LLM谓词映射到目标本体。在AIT政策语料上达到86.9%的模态分类准确率、SHACL形状F1=0.866，并验证了交换注册表即可跨领域迁移的能力。
AI.motivation: 机构政策以自然语言书写，而合规检查系统需要机器可读约束。当前这一鸿沟仍由人工手工桥接，缺乏自动化管道。此外，现有方法在新领域重定向时需要重新训练模型，效率低下。
AI.method: PolicyKG采用四阶段LLM管道，运行在LangGraph状态机上，每阶段配备验证器：(1) 将政策PDF逐句分类为义务、许可或禁止；(2) 将标签提升为first-order deontic logic (FOL)；(3) 转换为SHACL约束。核心是Corpus Adapter——一个YAML词汇表注册表，将LLM的谓词锚定到目标本体上，跨领域迁移只需替换注册表而无需重新训练。FOL路径处理不成功的规则使用直接的NL-to-SHACL回退。可复现性通过哈希一致输出保证。
AI.result: 在AIT政策语料（1,663句，443条规则）上，deontic分类准确率86.9%（Cohen's kappa=0.709），三位标注者独立复标50项样本的Fleiss' kappa=0.844。69个SHACL形状子集上F1=0.866。FOL路径处理79.2%的规则，其余走NL-to-SHACL回退。针对高阶逻辑的审计（regex检查+人工复查）确认HOL率上界95%置信区间为0.67%（Clopper-Pearson）。将AIT注册表换为GDPR注册表后，属性对齐从1/15提升至11/15（Fisher精确检验p<.001, Cohen's h=1.53）。在LexDeMod合同基准（N=200）上Macro F1降至0.370，归因于"shall be entitled"等词汇表不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: PolicyKG证明了LLM管道自动将政策文本转为SHACL约束的可行性，Corpus Adapter设计实现了跨领域的高效迁移。同时作者强调HOL审计结果仅针对单一语料库，不能推广为一阶逻辑对机构政策充分性的普适证明。词汇表不匹配（如租赁合同中的"shall be entitled"）是跨领域迁移的关键瓶颈。

title: The Scaffolding Matters More Than the Interface: A Controlled Comparison of MCP and CLI Tool Use Across Seven Agent Scaffoldings, Five Language Models, and One Software Task
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Companion methodology paper: arXiv:2606.11869. Dataset and measurement harness (open source, GPL-3.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21851992
summary:
How much an AI coding agent costs to run can depend more on the agent scaffolding that drives it than on the interface through which it
  reaches its tools. We set out to measure the cost of tool use over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) against tool use over an ordinary
  command-line interface (CLI), a difference on which published estimates disagree by more than an order of magnitude while resting on
  practitioner reports that cannot be reproduced. We ran one fixed software task -- six operations against a private online git repository --
  across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, and we verified completion by inspecting the repository state rather than trusting
  the agent's self-report. The dominant effect was the scaffolding. Two of the seven ship no MCP support at all; they completed every run using
  only the CLI, which shows that MCP is unnecessary for this class of work, and they were 5.0x to 28x cheaper than the five scaffoldings that
  do support MCP, comparing CLI runs alone with no MCP server attached anywhere. The effect was largest for a small 27-billion-parameter model
  running locally, whose cost varied 139x across scaffoldings while it completed the task under all of them. The comparison we set out to make
  proved unstable: thirteen strictly paired MCP-to-CLI ratios span 0.43x to 29x, with outliers on both sides. The two interfaces separate on
  the cost of failure, where 12.9 per cent of the money spent on MCP runs bought no completed work against 2.2 per cent on CLI runs, but not on
  its frequency: failures were equally common in both, in the original runs and in their repetitions alike. Agents frequently ignored the
  interface they were assigned, so comparisons that do not verify actual behaviour measure an unknown mixture. The harness, the task, the
  verification and the complete dataset are released as open source.

AI.tldr: 本文通过七个agent脚手架和五个语言模型运行同一固定软件任务，对比MCP协议与CLI工具使用的成本。发现脚手架是成本的主导因素：仅支持CLI的两个脚手架比支持MCP的五个脚手架便宜5.0x至28x；MCP与CLI的成对成本比在0.43x到29x之间不稳定；MCP在失败成本上更高（12.9% vs 2.2%的资金购买到未完成的工作），但失败频率无差异。
AI.motivation: 关于AI编码代理通过MCP协议与CLI接口使用工具的成本差异，已有估算分歧超过一个数量级，且基于不可复现的从业者报告。作者希望用可复现的受控实验来测量真实的成本差异。
AI.method: 固定一个软件任务（对私有在线git仓库执行六项操作），在七个agent脚手架和五个语言模型上运行，通过检查仓库实际状态（而非信任agent自报）验证任务完成情况，严格配对比较MCP与CLI两种接口下的成本。
AI.result: 脚手架主导成本差异：两个仅支持CLI的脚手架比五个支持MCP的脚手架便宜5.0x至28x；本地运行的27B小模型成本跨脚手架变化达139x。MCP与CLI成对比值跨0.43x至29x不稳定。MCP失败成本占比12.9% vs CLI的2.2%，但失败频率相当。
AI.conclusion: MCP对于此类任务并非必要（两个无MCP支持的脚手架全额完成），"MCP vs CLI"的简单对比测量的是不稳定的混合信号，因为agent经常忽略被分配的接口；研究强调必须验证实际行为而非自报，并开源了harness、任务、验证和完整数据集。

title: CUPA-T2*: Covariance-Aware Uncertainty Propagation and Alignment for T2* Mapping in Accelerated MRI
comment: Accepted at the 2nd workshop on: Reconstruction and Imaging Motion Estimation (RIME) MICCAI. This is the submitted manuscript with added link to GitHub repo, funding acknowledgements, disclosure of interests, and authors' names and affiliations. No further post submission improvements or corrections were integrated
summary: Quantitative T2* maps have strong potential for biomarker discovery but are limited by long scan times, rendering them impractical in clinical settings. Significant acceleration can be achieved through undersampling in k-space combined with learning-based reconstruction. However, reconstruction artifacts and noise can propagate into downstream T2* fitting, degrading its accuracy. We introduce CUPA-T2*, a framework that explicitly propagates voxel-wise inter-echo uncertainty from stochastic Monte Carlo dropout reconstructions to downstream T2* fitting via covariance-aware sampling. T2* fitting is performed with a heteroscedastic MLP and a correlation-based regularizer that encourages alignment between predicted variance and reconstruction uncertainty. Experiments on accelerated brain MRI data show tissue-dependent behavior: CUPA-T2* achieves competitive overall T2* fitting performance and improves white-matter performance at higher accelerations. Compared with a heteroscedastic baseline, the proposed framework substantially increases alignment between reconstruction uncertainty and predicted T2* variance, while also revealing a trade-off with calibration (ECE) and selective prediction performance (AURC). CUPA-T2* enables reconstruction uncertainty-aware T2* fitting and delivers voxel-wise uncertainty maps to support the interpretation of quantitative T2* estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUPA-T2*框架，通过将随机蒙特卡洛dropout重建的不确定性以协方差感知采样方式显式传播至下游T2*拟合过程，实现重建不确定性感知的定量T2*映射。
AI.motivation: 定量T2*图在生物标志物发现中具有重要潜力，但扫描时间长、临床实用性受限。现有加速方案（k空间欠采样+学习重建）虽可大幅加速，但重建伪影和噪声会传播到下游T2*拟合中，降低定量准确性。作者提出应显式建模并传播重建不确定性到下游拟合过程。
AI.method: CUPA-T2*框架：(1) 采用随机蒙特卡洛dropout重建生成逐体素回波间不确定性；(2) 通过协方差感知采样将不确定性显式传播至T2*拟合；(3) 使用异方差MLP进行T2*拟合；(4) 引入基于相关性的正则化项，促使预测方差与重建不确定性对齐。
AI.result: 在加速脑MRI数据上，CUPA-T2*在高加速倍数下具有竞争性的整体T2*拟合性能，并显著提升白质区域性能。与异方差基线相比，重建不确定性与预测T2*方差的对齐度大幅提升，同时存在与校准（ECE）和选择性预测性能（AURC）的权衡。
AI.conclusion: CUPA-T2*实现了重建不确定性感知的T2*拟合，可提供逐体素不确定性图以支持定量T2*估计的临床解释，但校准和选择性预测方面存在权衡需要进一步权衡与优化。

title: Business Truth, not SQL Accuracy: A Rule-Gated 7B Analytics Agent Outperforms a Direct-Prompted 32B Baseline
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Benchmark, code, run records, pre-registration and one-command reproduction: https://github.com/k-w-lee/query_proof
summary: LLM analytics agents are evaluated on SQL syntax accuracy, but production failures look different: questions with two valid business definitions, questions the warehouse cannot answer, deprecated columns after a schema change, and queries that execute successfully while returning the wrong business number. No execution-match metric can score them. This paper introduces WarehouseReliabilityBench, 400 frozen tasks over two synthetic warehouses in which roughly half the correct responses are a clarification, an abstention or a refusal, with pinned denominators and a pre-registered paired bootstrap fixing each claim verb before the numbers existed. QueryProof, a 7B agent, uses rules derived from a semantic layer and physical catalog to determine its behaviour, and gates every answer on deterministic post-execution checks. On an 80-task synthetic test split evaluated once, QueryProof outperforms a direct-prompted 32B baseline by +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] Business Truth Rate at 71.0% lower cost per correct answer; against a cost-matched few-shot baseline the accuracy gain holds but the cost difference does not resolve. This compares systems rather than model sizes: the 32B baseline receives none of the scaffolding. False success falls from 0.754 to 0.351 of returned answers, and no wrong number was returned on an answerable task (0 of 24), though 13 answers went to questions requiring clarification or abstention. Removing the routing layer changes little (0.562 against 0.537), so the result does not depend on escalation. Routing tuned on validation over-abstains on test, and the fitted confidence model loses to the heuristic it replaced. Resampling template families rather than tasks widens both accuracy intervals to include zero, so the effect's direction is better supported than its magnitude. The gain tracks the deterministic layer, though no component ablation was run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WarehouseReliabilityBench，一个包含 400 个冻结任务、在两个合成仓库上评估 LLM 分析代理在生产环境中可靠性（而非 SQL 语法准确性）的基准。约一半正确响应为澄清、弃权或拒绝。作者提出的 QueryProof（7B 代理）利用语义层和物理目录规则，并通过确定性的执行后检查门控每个答案，在 80 任务测试集上以 71% 更低的成本超越直接提示的 32B 基线（Business Truth Rate 提升 +0.237），将错误成功从 0.754 降至 0.351，且在可回答任务上未返回任何错误数字。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 分析代理评估过度关注 SQL 语法准确率，但生产环境中的失败模式截然不同：存在两种有效业务定义的问题、仓库无法回答的问题、schema 变更后的废弃列，以及执行成功但返回错误业务数字的查询。执行匹配指标无法对这些场景进行评分，因此需要面向生产可靠性的新基准。
AI.method: 构建 WarehouseReliabilityBench 基准（400 个冻结任务，两个合成仓库），约一半正确响应为澄清、弃权或拒绝，采用固定分母和预注册配对 bootstrap。提出 QueryProof（7B 代理），从语义层和物理目录推导规则以决定行为，并通过确定性后执行检查门控所有答案。在 80 任务测试集上与直接提示的 32B 基线和成本匹配的少样本基线进行比较；同时进行消融分析（移除路由层、验证集路由调优、置信度模型替换等）。
AI.result: QueryProof 在 Business Truth Rate 上以 +0.237 [0.112, 0.375] 超越直接提示的 32B 基线，且每正确答案成本降低 71%；对成本匹配的少样本基线，准确率优势保持但成本差异不显著。错误成功从 0.754 降至 0.351，可回答任务上 0/24 返回错误数字（但有 13 个答案进入需澄清或弃权的问题）。移除路由层影响很小（0.562 vs 0.537），路由在测试集上过弃权，置信度模型不如启发式。按模板族重抽样时置信区间包含零，支持方向但不确定幅度；增益主要来自确定性层，尽管未做组件消融。
AI.conclusion: 面向生产可靠性的 LLM 分析代理评估需要超越执行匹配指标。通过语义层规则和确定性后执行检查实现的高可靠性代理在准确性和成本效率上优于规模更大的基线，错误成功大幅降低。主要增益来自确定性层而非动态路由，但效果幅度需更严谨的消融与重抽样设计加以确认。

title: Branch2Skill: Efficient Skill Evolution Through Reasoning Trees
summary: Skill evolution improves agent skills through feedback over time, with failed trajectories often providing informative signals by revealing incomplete or misleading behaviors. However, existing methods mainly rely on single trajectories, where early reasoning errors can propagate through subsequent steps and weaken the feedback available for skill refinement. Consequently, improving skills requires repeated cycles of rollout, diagnosis, and update, incurring substantial token costs. To address this challenge, we introduce Branch2Skill, an efficient framework that transforms a single reasoning tree into dense supervision for skill evolution. For each task or problem, Branch2Skill performs Monte Carlo tree search under a fixed budget to obtain diverse reasoning trajectories, then compares an elite path with sibling alternatives sharing the same prefixes to extract step-wise evidence about which reasoning patterns to retain, revise, or avoid. Finally, Branch2Skill distills multi-step evidence into reusable updates, allowing one reasoning tree to provide supervision across multiple reasoning steps and reducing the need for repeated rollout-update cycles. Across six benchmarks covering reasoning and agentic tasks, Branch2Skill consistently improves task performance while enhancing skill evolution efficiency. For example, with GPT 5.5 as the target model, Branch2Skill uses 73.2% fewer tokens than SkillOpt, while achieving superior performance. These results demonstrate that reasoning trees can support not only more effective trajectory search, but also richer supervision for more efficient skill improvement. Code will be published.

AI.tldr: Branch2Skill是一个高效的技能演化框架，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索在固定预算下构建推理树，将单棵推理树转化为密集的逐步监督信号，减少了对重复rollout-update循环的依赖，从而大幅降低token成本（比SkillOpt少73.2%的token消耗）并提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有技能演化方法主要依赖单条轨迹进行反馈，早期推理错误会传播到后续步骤，削弱可用于技能改进的反馈信号。这导致需要反复进行"rollout-诊断-更新"的循环，产生高昂的token成本。作者希望从单次推理过程中提取更丰富的监督信号，提高技能演化的效率。
AI.method: Branch2Skill框架包含三个步骤：(1) 在固定预算下使用蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)生成多样化的推理轨迹；(2) 将精英路径(elite path)与其共享前缀的兄弟替代轨迹进行对比，提取逐步的证据，辨别哪些推理模式应该保留、修正或避免；(3) 将多步证据蒸馏为可复用的更新，使单棵推理树能为多个推理步骤提供监督，减少重复rollout-update循环的需求。
AI.result: 在涵盖推理和智能体任务的六个基准上，Branch2Skill一致地提升了任务性能并提高了技能演化效率。以GPT 5.5为目标模型时，Branch2Skill比SkillOpt节省73.2%的token，同时获得更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理树不仅能支持更有效的轨迹搜索，还能提供更丰富的监督信号以实现更高效的技能改进。这一发现表明，将单条轨迹的线性演化扩展为树形结构的多路径对比学习，是提升智能体技能演化效率的有效途径。

title: OccAnyScene: Towards Unified Indoor-Outdoor 3D Occupancy Predictio
summary: 3D occupancy prediction is fundamental to scene understanding, yet existing 3D semantic occupancy methods are typically specialized to fixed scene types and occupancy protocols. We introduce Cross-Scene 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction, a new task setting which requires a single model to handle heterogeneous indoor and outdoor scenes with varying cameras, spatial ranges, voxel specifications, and semantic taxonomies. This setting poses a fundamental challenge: achieving metric-consistent yet scene-adaptive image-to-3D lifting across varying camera configurations and scene scales. To address this challenge, we propose OccAnyScene, a pixel-frustum-centered Gaussian framework built upon a pretrained depth foundation model. Specifically, the framework employs Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation to construct a camera-aware frustum query for each feature pixel, and Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction to decode each query into multiple Gaussians whose positions and sizes are constrained by the predicted pixel depth and corresponding frustum geometry. OccAnyScene sets new state-of-the-art results, achieving 59.92% mIoU on the indoor Occ-ScanNet and 23.06% mIoU on the outdoor SurroundOcc-nuScenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨场景3D语义占用预测新任务，并设计了基于像素-截锥体中心高斯框架的OccAnyScene模型，在室内外异构场景中均取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D语义占用预测方法通常针对固定场景类型和占用协议设计，无法处理室内外异构场景中相机配置、空间范围、体素规格和语义体系各异的情况，缺乏统一的跨场景建模能力。
AI.method: 提出OccAnyScene框架，采用像素-截锥体中心的高斯表示。包含两个核心组件：像素对齐截锥体特征聚合（Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation）用于构建相机感知的截锥体查询；截锥体参数化高斯构建（Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction）将每个查询解码为多个高斯，其位置和大小由预测的像素深度及对应截锥体几何约束。
AI.result: 在室内Occ-ScanNet上达到59.92% mIoU，在室外SurroundOcc-nuScenes上达到23.06% mIoU，均刷新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过预训练深度基础模型与像素-截锥体中心高斯框架的结合，实现了度量一致且场景自适应的图像到3D提升，有效解决了跨场景3D语义占用预测的异构挑战。

title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons
summary: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic evaluation alone cannot detect infeasible orders, invalid coupon combinations, or incorrect payments. We introduce ComboShoppingBench, an agentic shopping benchmark for open-ended yet verifiable basket construction in a simulated commerce and takeout environment. During task synthesis, an exploration agent constructs a feasible and semantically coherent basket of purchasable products; this witness guides the generation of coupons, budget constraints, user queries, and aligned evaluation rubrics. During evaluation, LLM judges assess semantic satisfaction, response quality, and claim faithfulness, while deterministic validation checks product-ID validity, budget compliance, and coupon optimality. Experiments with diverse LLM agents demonstrate that even strong agents struggle on ComboShoppingBench, highlighting substantial room for improvement in reliable, constraint-aware combo shopping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ComboShoppingBench，一个用于开放但可验证的组合购物任务的智能体购物基准测试，在模拟商业和外卖环境中评估LLM智能体的组合购物能力。
AI.motivation: 现实购物常需要构建互补商品的组合篮（如设备搭建、餐饮准备、活动策划、团购外卖），而非检索单一产品。这需要联合推理商品兼容性、库存、店铺要求、配送费、优惠券和预算。由于多个篮子可能满足同一请求，精确匹配指标不适用；而仅用语义评估无法检测不可行订单、无效优惠券组合或错误支付，因此需要一个结合语义评估与确定性验证的基准。
AI.method: ComboShoppingBench包含模拟商业和外卖环境，通过探索智能体（exploration agent）生成可行且语义连贯的可购商品篮作为见证（witness），据此生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和对齐的评估准则。评估时，LLM评判器检查语义满意度、响应质量和声明忠实度，确定性验证检查商品ID有效性、预算合规性和优惠券最优性。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使强大的LLM智能体在ComboShoppingBench上表现挣扎，凸显了在可靠、约束感知的组合购物方面仍有巨大的改进空间。
AI.conclusion: ComboShoppingBench有效揭示了现有LLM智能体在组合购物任务上的短板，为构建约束感知、可靠的多商品采购智能体提供了有价值的评估平台。

title: A Structural Dynamics Graph World Model: Unified Modeling, Constrained Rollout, and Interpretable Calibration
summary: The state evolution of a complex system arises jointly from object laws, relational propagation, domain conservation, and unmodeled error. Forcing all sources into one black box makes mechanism attribution and constraint preservation unauditable; forcing every mechanism into one equation family discards mature domain solvers. We propose SD-GWM, a Structural Dynamics Graph World Model as an executable structural contract: nodes declare self-dynamics S, edges declare neighbor graph-coupled dynamics N---both fixed-form mechanism assets (rules, ODEs, solvers) calibrating only authorized parameters. An optional bounded residual R concentrates learnability, while a global projection maps states to feasibility, enforcing constraints without guaranteeing accuracy gains. On eight pre-registered research questions, SD-GWM delivers (i) heterogeneous integration: rules and solvers plug in natively; (ii) semantic fidelity: disabling R preserves source semantics bit-for-bit, with four theory properties under explicit proof/empirical boundaries; (iii) auditable governance: stepwise traces enable counterfactual fault localization (top-1 = 1.0) without post-hoc approximations. On a semi-synthetic flood testbed and USGS streamflow, SD-GWM reduces constraint violations to floating-point tolerance in analytical tests and to zero in semi-synthetic and real-data cases. Persistence matches SD-GWM in calm periods, but during a 254-day extreme-flood shift persistence and all neural baselines collapse (90-min RMSE 892-3007 cfs) while SD-GWM holds at 108 cfs (8-28x gain). The bounded residual cuts RMSE ~50% only under backbone bias. We position SD-GWM not as a universally superior forecaster, but as a verifiable substrate for auditable, constraint-safe spatiotemporal mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SD-GWM（结构动力学图世界模型），一种将机制知识与可学习残差结合的、可审计的结构化合约框架。它通过节点自动力学、边图耦合动力学、有界残差和全局投影四部分解耦复杂系统状态演化，在洪水测试与USGS径流数据上实现约束零违规，并在极端洪水期间较持久性基线和所有神经基线提升8-28倍。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统状态演化由对象定律、关系传播、域守恒和未建模误差共同驱动。将全部来源混入一个黑箱会使得机制归因和约束保持无法审计；而将所有机制强行纳入单一方程族则会丢弃成熟的领域求解器。现有方法无法同时满足机制透明性和约束安全性，亟需一种结构化可验证的建模框架。
AI.method: SD-GWM将系统建模为可执行结构合约：节点声明自动力学S，边声明邻居图耦合动力学N，两者均为固定形式的机制资产（规则、ODE、求解器），仅校准授权参数；可选的有界残差R集中可学习能力；全局投影将状态映射到可行域，强制约束满足但不保证精度提升。
AI.result: 在八个预注册研究问题上：异构集成支持规则与求解器原生接入；语义保真度上禁用残差可逐位保持源语义，四项理论性质有明确证明/经验边界；步进追踪实现反事实故障定位（top-1=1.0）。在半合成洪水测试与USGS径流数据上，约束违规降至浮点容差（解析）及零（半合成与真实数据）。254天极端洪水期间持久性与所有神经基线崩溃（90分钟RMSE 892-3007 cfs），SD-GWM保持108 cfs（8-28倍改进）；有界残差仅在骨干有偏时降低RMSE约50%。
AI.conclusion: SD-GWM并非追求普遍优于所有预测器的万能模型，而是定位为可验证的底层基座，支持可审计、约束安全的时空数据挖掘，在机制归因透明性与约束保持之间取得平衡。

title: SRE-FER: Regional residual evidence learning for mitigating local evidence dilution in fine-grained facial expression recognition
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures.Accepted at the 9th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Pattern Recognition (AIPR 2026)
summary: Fine-grained facial expression recognition (FER) hinges on capturing subtle muscular cues that distinguish adjacent emotions. Yet capturing these cues presents a dilemma. Detector-based methods depend on fragile landmark pipelines, whereas we find that directly transferring foundation models such as DINOv3 under conventional global readouts can cause local evidence dilution: early global aggregation washes out sparse muscular signals and leaves persistent confusion between categories such as fear/surprise and sad/neutral. To recover this evidence, we propose SRE-FER, a readout-level regional residual evidence learning framework. Its core module, RERA, adds zero-initialized residual logits that refine class boundaries while preserving the backbone's global prediction. Training-time action unit (AU) guidance steers regional features toward expression-relevant areas using Facial Action Coding System (FACS)-based anatomical priors, without requiring an external facial pipeline at inference. An optional Full setting further routes sample-specific non-redundant tokens. On three benchmarks, SRE-FER attains 92.76% on RAF-DB, 91.32% on FERPlus, and 67.78% on AffectNet-7, demonstrating highly competitive performance compared to existing FER methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRE-FER，一种基于读出层区域残差证据学习的细粒度面部表情识别（FER）框架。其核心模块RERA通过零初始化残差logits细化类别边界，同时保留骨干网络的全局预测；训练时利用基于FACS的解剖学先验进行AU引导，使区域特征聚焦于表情相关区域，推理时无需外部面部管线。在RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet-7上分别达到92.76%、91.32%和67.78%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 细粒度面部表情识别需要捕捉区分相邻表情（如恐惧/惊讶、悲伤/中性）的细微肌肉线索。然而现有方法存在两难：基于检测器的方法依赖脆弱的关键点管线；而直接将DINOv3等基础模型用于常规全局读出时，早期全局聚合会稀释稀疏的肌肉信号，导致类别混淆。因此需要一种无需外部人脸管线、同时能恢复局部证据的方法。
AI.method: 提出SRE-FER框架，其核心是RERA模块：通过零初始化残差logits来细化类别边界，同时保持骨干网络的全局预测能力。训练阶段使用基于FACS的解剖学先验进行动作单元（AU）引导，将区域特征导向表情相关区域；推理时无需外部人脸管线。可选Full设置在推理时进一步路由样本特定的非冗余token。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上取得SOTA级性能：RAF-DB上92.76%、FERPlus上91.32%、AffectNet-7上67.78%，与现有FER方法相比具有高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SRE-FER证明了读出层级别的区域残差证据学习策略能有效恢复被全局聚合稀释的局部肌肉信号，在不依赖外部人脸管线的前提下显著提升细粒度表情识别性能，为基础模型在人体细粒度视觉任务上的适配提供了新思路。

title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM) is essential for agent interactions, yet existing evaluations either rely on static scenarios that oversimplify mental-state reasoning or interactive settings that provide limited diagnostic insight. We present Avalon-ToM-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark that operationalizes ToM through the asymmetric-information mechanics of The Resistance: Avalon. Rather than evaluating end-to-end gameplay, it decomposes ToM into a 2$\times$2 taxonomy -- epistemic versus motivational reasoning crossed with inference versus action -- using human-crafted, perspective-constrained queries. Benchmarking 28 LLMs reveals three insights: 1) Reasoning, not knowledge. Models show strong game-rule comprehension but markedly weaker ToM abilities, isolating failures to social reasoning rather than missing domain knowledge. 2) Expression, not representation. Mechanistic analyses via linear probing and activation steering show that models frequently represent correct mental-state inferences in their hidden states but fail to express them during generation -- linear probes recover 77-82% accuracy versus 62-70% from the models' own chain-of-thought. 3) Policy, not deliberation. Dedicated reasoning training yields substantial improvements whereas test-time chain-of-thought provides only marginal gains (+11.0 versus +1.1 points on average), suggesting that robust ToM depends on a learned reasoning policy rather than increased inference-time deliberation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Avalon-ToM-Bench，一个基于《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》不对称信息机制构建的细粒度心智理论（ToM）基准。它通过2×2分类法（认知vs动机推理 × 推断vs行动）分解ToM，并用人类精心设计、视角受限的查询进行评测。对28个LLM的基准测试揭示了三个关键发现：模型具备游戏规则知识但ToM能力薄弱；线性探针可从隐藏状态恢复77-82%的正确推理而模型自身思维链仅62-70%，表明模型"能表示但不能表达"；专门的推理训练带来显著提升（+11.0分）而测试时思维链仅微增（+1.1分），表明稳健的ToM依赖学习的推理策略而非推理时的更多思考。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM评估要么依赖过度简化心智状态推理的静态场景，要么缺乏诊断性洞察的交互式设置。需要一个既能分解ToM各个组成维度、又能提供细粒度诊断信息的基准来系统评估和定位LLM的ToM能力缺陷。
AI.method: 基于《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》的不对称信息机制构建Avalon-ToM-Bench，将ToM分解为认知vs动机推理与推断vs行动的2×2分类法，使用人工构建的视角受限查询进行评测，并结合线性探针和激活引导等机制分析工具，对28个LLM进行系统性基准测试。
AI.result: 28个LLM的基准测试显示：1）模型游戏规则理解强但ToM能力弱，表明失败源于社交推理而非领域知识缺失；2）线性探针从隐藏状态恢复77-82%正确推理，而模型自身思维链仅62-70%，表明模型能表征正确推断但生成时未能表达；3）专门的推理训练带来+11.0分提升，而测试时思维链仅+1.1分，表明学习到的推理策略比推理时的更多思考更有效。
AI.conclusion: Avalon-ToM-Bench提供了一个细粒度的ToM评估框架，揭示了LLM的ToM缺陷本质上是"表达层"而非"表征层"问题，且ToM能力的提升更多依赖推理策略的学习而非推理时的额外计算。这为未来LLM社交推理能力的训练和改进方向提供了重要启示。

title: EnergyBridge: Benchmarking Household Energy Management, User Participation, and Grid Flexibility
summary: Residential virtual power plants (VPPs) can provide grid flexibility by shifting household demand, but physical flexibility becomes dependable capacity only when residents authorize a plan and the promised response is delivered. Existing benchmarks evaluate control but omit event-specific authorization. We present EnergyBridge, a benchmark and agent framework connecting capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution. It combines region-specific EnergyPlus environments for Tianjin and Berlin with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator. Against 584 persona- and event-matched human role-play judgments, the LLM-based User Participation Simulator preserves method ordering with a 5.3-point mean absolute acceptance error. Across conventional controllers and agent baselines, EnergyBridge achieves the highest simulated authorization, lowest event-window energy, and the most reliable capacity commitment in both regions. We release human data and codes for reproducible human-centered grid-flexibility research: https://github.com/Agentic-Intelligence-Lab/EnergyBridge.

AI.tldr: EnergyBridge是一个连接容量报告、用户授权与物理执行的住宅虚拟电厂(VPP)基准与智能体框架，通过LLM驱动的用户参与模拟器评估从柔性到可靠容量的完整链路。
AI.motivation: 现有VPP基准仅评估控制层面，忽略了事件特定的用户授权环节，而物理柔性只有获得居民授权并兑现承诺响应后才能转化为可靠的可用容量，因此需要一个端到端的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建EnergyBridge框架，整合天津和柏林两个地区的EnergyPlus建筑仿真环境，以及基于LLM的用户参与模拟器；模拟器经过584个persona与事件匹配的人工角色扮演判断数据进行校准与验证。
AI.result: LLM用户参与模拟器在5.3点平均绝对接受误差内保持方法排序一致性；在传统控制器和智能体基线中，EnergyBridge在两个地区均获得最高的模拟授权率、最低的事件窗口能耗和最可靠的容量承诺。
AI.conclusion: EnergyBridge验证了将用户授权纳入VPP评估的必要性，并提供了可复现的以人为中心的电网灵活性研究工具与数据资源。

title: Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation
summary: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了视觉语言模型在3D CT放射学报告生成中的视觉token预算分配问题，评估了四种视觉编码器、五种token压缩投影器和五种指令微调LLM，发现区域裁剪是最稳定的策略，最佳配置在CT-RATE和Merlin上分别达到49.5和49.0的临床macro F1，达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型应用于3D CT体积时，基础视觉编码器会产生数万个视觉token，成为LLM的计算瓶颈。视觉到语言投影器可以压缩序列但可能丢失临床细节。如何在不同输入视野、空间分辨率和视觉-语言投影之间分配视觉token预算，是一个开放的设计问题，亟需系统研究。
AI.method: 系统评估了多维度组合：四种异构视觉编码器（CNN和ViT）、五种token减少投影器（最高64倍压缩）加非压缩MLP投影基线、五种指令微调LLM（1.7B-4B参数），在两个大规模CT报告数据集（CT-RATE和Merlin）上进行实验。在匹配LLM token预算的条件下，比较了解剖引导的区域裁剪策略和不同输入分辨率方案。
AI.result: 解剖引导的区域裁剪是最一致的策略，在20个设置中有19个提升临床macro F1，对3D ViT Primus编码器平均提升+3.7点，对基于切片的2D ViT Curia编码器平均提升+1.1点。增加输入分辨率高度依赖投影器：PerceiverResampler配合高分辨率Curia特征在两个数据集上均取得最优配置。最佳配置在CT-RATE上达到49.5，在Merlin上达到49.0的临床macro F1，均为SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token预算的分配方式是3D CT放射学报告生成的关键设计维度。区域裁剪作为解剖先验有效地提升了性能，且优于盲目增加分辨率。投影器选择与输入分辨率之间存在强交互效应，PerceiverResampler在高分辨率下表现最优。该研究为视觉语言模型在3D医学影像领域的部署提供了系统的设计指导。

title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
summary: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft model is contained within the verifier. We validate our approach by training a Matryoshka suite comprising 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models. Our suite is on par with independently trained baselines on benchmark performance and validation and out-of-domain perplexities, while using 36% less training compute and improving the throughput of speculative decoding by 14-26%. We also ablate key architectural choices, offering guidance for building strong Matryoshka LM suites.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个Matryoshka训练框架，将多个不同规模的子模型堆叠到单一嵌套架构中端到端训练，同时提升训练与推理效率。该套件（500M/1.5B/3B）在基准性能和困惑度上与独立训练基线持平，但节省36%训练算力，并将投机解码吞吐量提升14-26%。
AI.motivation: 传统方法训练一个语言模型套件需要分别训练每个模型并独立部署，导致训练和推理成本都很高。作者希望同时改进训练和推理效率，利用嵌套架构的共享参数和蒸馏机制来降低总体开销。
AI.method: 1) 将不同规模的子模型堆叠进单一嵌套架构中，端到端联合训练；2) 每个训练步骤中，从最大的子模型向所有较小的子模型进行低成本知识蒸馏；3) 利用嵌套结构使草稿模型（较小子模型）内嵌于验证模型（最大子模型）中，天然适配投机解码。
AI.result: 训练的Matryoshka套件（500M、1.5B、3B）在基准性能和验证/域外困惑度上与独立训练的基线模型相当，同时减少36%的训练计算量，并将投机解码的吞吐量提升14-26%。
AI.conclusion: Matryoshka训练框架能够以更低的训练成本获得与独立训练同等的模型质量，并能显著提升推理效率。作者还通过消融实验揭示了关键的架构选择，为构建强Matryoshka语言模型套件提供了指导。

title: PluginEval: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained Error Attribution in Function Calling
summary: Reliable evaluation of tool routing is critical as Large Language Models increasingly operate as autonomous agents. Current benchmarks face three structural limitations: data distributions that follow a power law leave rare scenarios underrepresented; the absence of adversarial hard negatives obscures performance differences across models; and annotation pipelines depend on LLM judgments that have not been validated through execution. In this paper, we introduce PluginEval, a benchmark constructed through a two-stage framework that systematically mitigates these limitations. First, we formulate tool routing as a sequence of three decisions and separate generation from verification. LLMs propose candidate calls, while deterministic validation and real API execution provide reliable quality signals. Second, we decompose each plugin by capability, intent, and boundary to identify trigger and exclusion scenarios. We then generate queries at different difficulty levels to fill coverage gaps, including adversarial negatives targeting three failure modes, and return them to the first stage for annotation. This process creates a closed loop that iterates until coverage converges. For evaluation, we move beyond aggregate accuracy. An LLM judge anchored to gold annotations classifies failures as missed calls, spurious calls, or parameter errors, producing a detailed error profile for each model. We evaluate five model families, including proprietary models and models with open weights, analyze their performance across difficulty levels and error categories, and validate the judge through agreement with human annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PluginEval，一个通过两阶段闭环框架构建的工具路由评测基准，克服了现有基准在数据分布、对抗困难负样本缺失和LLM标注不可靠三方面的结构性缺陷，并提供细粒度错误画像评估多模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有工具路由评测基准存在三个结构性局限：1) 数据分布遵循幂律，稀少场景代表性不足；2) 缺乏对抗性困难负样本，难以区分不同模型间的性能差异；3) 标注流程依赖未经执行验证的LLM判断，可靠性存疑。这些问题导致评测结果不可靠，无法准确反映大语言模型作为自主代理时的真实工具选择能力。
AI.method: PluginEval采用两阶段框架：(1) 将工具路由建模为三个决策序列，分离生成与验证——LLM提出候选调用，确定性验证和真实API执行提供可靠质量信号；(2) 按能力、意图和边界三个维度分解每个插件以识别触发与排除场景，在不同难度级别生成查询以填补覆盖空白，包括针对三种失败模式的对抗性负样本，再返回第一阶段进行标注，形成闭环迭代直至覆盖收敛。评估时，锚定黄金标注的LLM评审将失败分类为遗漏调用、虚假调用或参数错误，生成细粒度错误画像。
AI.result: 评估了五类模型家族（含专有模型和开放权重模型），分析了它们在难度级别和错误类别上的表现差异，并通过与人类标注的一致性验证了评审机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PluginEval通过系统性克服现有基准的结构性缺陷，提供了更可靠、更具区分度的工具路由评测方案，其多维度错误画像展现了对模型行为更深入的理解，为后续代理系统评估提供了新范式。

title: High-Quality Exposure Correction with Diffusion-Based Image Generation Priors
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: Although most existing exposure correction methods achieve high fidelity, they often place excessive focus on overall pixel-wise accuracy, making it challenging to effectively model extreme exposure regions, which results in suboptimal perceptual quality. Recently, diffusion models have received significant attention due to their remarkable performance in the realm of image generation. However, their successful application to exposure correction remains a challenging and open question. The key challenge lies in generating accurate image structures and maintaining high image fidelity during stochastic diffusion processes. In this paper, we propose DPEC (Diffusion Prior-based Exposure Correction), a novel framework for image exposure correction that utilizes diffusion-based image generation priors encapsulated in pre-trained large-scale diffusion models. Specifically, we first propose an efficient fine-tuning strategy to derive an exposure corrector from pre-trained models, enabling the generation of enhanced images in a single-step denoising process. Moreover, we seamlessly combine the strengths of diffusion models and regression models, and design a joint cross-attention module to integrate multi-scale diffusion prior features, thereby effectively preserving high-frequency details and minimizing random artifacts. The diffusion model focuses on dealing with low-frequency content rather than all the intricate texture details. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DPEC method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on multiple exposure correction datasets, whether in terms of fidelity, perceptual quality, or visual effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPEC（基于扩散先验的曝光校正）框架，利用预训练扩散模型中的图像生成先验，通过高效微调策略和联合交叉注意力模块，在单步去噪过程中实现高质量曝光校正，同时结合扩散模型与回归模型的优势，在保真度、感知质量和视觉效果上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有曝光校正方法过度关注整体像素级精度，难以有效建模极端曝光区域，导致感知质量不佳。扩散模型在图像生成领域表现卓越，但其在曝光校正中的应用仍具挑战，关键在于随机扩散过程中生成准确图像结构并保持高保真度。
AI.method: DPEC框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 提出高效微调策略，从预训练扩散模型派生曝光校正器，实现单步去噪生成增强图像；(2) 设计联合交叉注意力模块，无缝融合扩散模型与回归模型的优势，集成多尺度扩散先验特征，有效保留高频细节并减少随机伪影。扩散模型专注于处理低频内容而非所有复杂纹理细节。
AI.result: 在多个曝光校正数据集上，DPEC在保真度、感知质量和视觉效果方面均一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DPEC证明了将预训练大模型扩散先验有效应用于曝光校正任务的可行性，通过让扩散模型负责低频内容而避免处理全部纹理细节，实现了保真度与感知质量的平衡，为曝光校正提供了新思路。

title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens are generated by the student but assigned near-zero probability by the teacher; their log-ratio corrections grow unbounded and destabilize the update. Student-deficit tokens, in contrast, are preferred by the teacher but rarely sampled by the student; their absence blocks the transfer of the teacher's reasoning patterns. To tackle these mismatch directions, we propose TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction), which applies bounded Hellinger shaping to suppress the most severe sampled excesses and an analytic teacher top-$K$ injection to restore deficient probability mass without requiring deficit tokens to be sampled. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with multiple Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, TIDE consistently outperforms standard OPD and recent token-selection and reward-shaping baselines. Moreover, the gains of TIDE are more pronounced under strong teacher-student mismatch, where it improves Avg@8 from 6.9% to 20.3%, reduces average response length by a factor of 3.6, and substantially reduces formatting failures. Code is available at https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了on-policy蒸馏（OPD）中的一种失败模式——退化一致性（degenerate agreement），并提出TIDE（Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction）方法，通过有界Hellinger整形抑制学生过剩token、通过解析教师top-K注入恢复学生缺失token，在数学推理基准上显著优于标准OPD及现有基线。
AI.motivation: OPD已成为LLM后训练流水线的核心组件，但作者发现其在教师-学生蒸馏中存在一种失败模式：学生通过重复循环（repetitive loops）实现与教师近完美的token级别一致，但全局响应却是错误的（即退化一致性）。现有的以一致性为目标的优化忽视了这种表面一致掩盖实质错误的陷阱，因此需要转向关注教师-学生之间的"不匹配"（mismatch）来识别和解决真正的学习障碍。
AI.method: 作者将不匹配token分为两类：1）student-excess tokens：学生生成但教师赋予接近零概率的token，其log-ratio修正项会无限增大导致更新不稳定；2）student-deficit tokens：教师偏好但学生很少采样的token，其缺失阻碍了教师推理模式的迁移。据此提出TIDE，包含两个核心组件：a) 有界Hellinger整形（bounded Hellinger shaping）用于抑制最严重的采样过剩token；b) 解析教师top-K注入（analytic teacher top-K injection）用于在不要求缺陷token被采样的前提下恢复缺失的概率质量。
AI.result: 在多个Qwen3教师-学生配对上的数学推理基准中，TIDE一致性地优于标准OPD以及最近的token选择和奖励整形基线。在强教师-学生不匹配场景下，TIDE将Avg@8从6.9%提升至20.3%，将平均响应长度减少3.6倍，并大幅减少格式失败。
AI.conclusion: 从"一致性"转向"不匹配"是提升蒸馏质量的关键视角。通过分别处理两类不匹配token，TIDE不仅能提升准确率，还能显著缩短响应长度并减少格式错误，且在不匹配更严重时优势更大，证明该方法有效解决了OPD中的退化一致性陷阱。

title: AI Evaluation Should Measure Verification Cost, Not Correctness Alone
summary: The reliability of AI generative models is typically measured by output correctness, yet in practice it depends on the effort required to verify those outputs. We argue that current evaluation metrics overlook a critical failure mode: Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs), defined as incorrect input-output pairs that a declared fraction of the verifier population fails to identify within the verification budget available in a given deployment context. Unlike standard notions of "hallucination", VCEs are defined operationally, by the failure of correct identification within budget rather than by any property of the output itself. Plausibility and authoritative presentation are hypothesised contributors to that failure, not defining conditions. To capture this asymmetry, we introduce the notion of verification cost relative to a deployment budget as an operational dimension that current evaluation does not routinely capture. The quantity is presented as a conceptual instrument rather than a finalized metric. Evidence from code generation and multi-modal document understanding shows that high benchmark accuracy can mask significant verification effort in practice. We therefore take the position that correctness alone is insufficient as a measure of reliability. AI evaluation should explicitly account for verification cost, reflecting whether errors can be detected under realistic resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证成本错误"（VCEs）概念，指出AI生成模型的可靠性不仅取决于输出正确性，还取决于在给定部署预算内验证输出的成本。作者认为当前评估指标忽视了这一关键失效模式，并主张评估应显式纳入验证成本维度。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成模型的评估主要关注输出正确性（如基准测试准确率），但实际部署中可靠性取决于用户验证输出的努力程度。作者认为存在一种被忽视的失效模式：即使输出在"事实上"正确，若验证者无法在预算内确认其正确性，该输出在操作层面同样不可靠。正确性指标与部署实际可靠性之间存在系统性偏差。
AI.method: 作者提出"验证成本错误"（VCEs）的操作性定义：在给定部署预算内，声明比例的验证者群体未能识别出错误输入-输出对。区别于"幻觉"，VCEs以识别失败（而非输出属性）来定义。作者引入"相对部署预算的验证成本"作为操作维度，并作为概念性工具而非最终指标提出。通过代码生成和多模态文档理解两个领域提供证据支持。
AI.result: 在代码生成和多模态文档理解中，高基准准确率可能掩盖实际部署中显著的验证努力。实验证据表明，基准测试分数高并不必然意味着验证成本低，可能存在"高准确率、高验证成本"的组合。
AI.conclusion: 作者持立场认为：正确性单独不足以衡量AI可靠性。评估体系应显式包含验证成本，反映错误能否在现实资源约束（时间、人力、计算资源）下被检测出来，从而使评估更贴近实际部署场景。

title: TomaMMU: A Comprehensive Multimodal Understanding Benchmark for Tomato Leaf Diseases
summary: To address this gap, we introduce TomaMMU, a large-scale Tomato leaf disease MultiModal Understanding dataset, alongside TomaBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on tomato disease understanding. TomaMMU comprises 28,808 high-quality images spanning 15 categories and 213,119 human-annotated visual question-answer pairs, generated through a three-stage pipeline comprising Data Collection, Human Annotation, and Question-Answer Generation. Building on this foundation, TomaBench organizes seven agricultural tasks into a hierarchical three-level taxonomy spanning Basic Perception, Pathology Understanding, and Expert Diagnosis, which together enable systematic evaluation from low-level visual recognition to high-level diagnostic reasoning. The tasks assess visual symptom recognition, taxonomic relationships, and diagnostic reasoning, offering a comprehensive view of how well models grasp plant pathology. Our results pronounced gaps in fine-grained recognition and factually grounded reasoning with 14 state-of-the-art VLMs, consistently underperforming on both challenging MCQs and open-ended questions. These results suggest that current VLMs struggle to translate visual perception into reliable diagnostic knowledge, motivating the need for targeted domain adaptation. Simple fine-tuning on TomaMMU substantially narrows this gap, boosting accuracy on challenging MCQs to 96.09%, outperforming recent VLMs, and pointing toward promising directions for future work. All data and code is available in https://huggingface.co/datasets/enalis/TomaMMU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TomaMMU——一个大规模番茄叶部病害多模态理解数据集，包含28,808张图像、15个类别和213,119个人工标注的视觉问答对；同时提出TomaBench基准，将7项农业任务组织为三级层次化评估体系。实验发现14个SOTA视觉语言模型在细粒度识别和基于事实的推理上表现不佳，而基于TomaMMU的简单微调可将挑战性MCQ准确率提升至96.09%，显著缩小这一差距。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型(VLM)在农业植物病害诊断等专业领域缺乏系统性的评估基准和大规模标注数据，特别是在细粒度视觉识别与诊断推理能力方面存在明显不足，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建TomaMMU数据集，采用包含数据收集、人工标注和问答生成的三阶段流水线；提出TomaBench基准，将7项农业任务按"基础感知-病理理解-专家诊断"三个层次组织成层次化分类体系，系统评估从低层视觉识别到高层诊断推理的能力。
AI.result: 14个SOTA VLM在挑战性选择题和开放性问题中均表现不佳，暴露出细粒度识别和事实性推理的显著差距；在TomaMMU上进行简单微调可将挑战性MCQ准确率提升至96.09%，超越现有VLM。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM难以将视觉感知转化为可靠的诊断知识，需要针对农业领域的定向领域适应。TomaMMU数据集的构建和微调实验验证了领域适配的有效性，为未来农业AI诊断系统的研究指明了方向。

title: Agentic Auto-Research is Fuzz Testing
summary: Autonomous research agents can generate experiments faster than researchers can validate them.
